The resonant network presented in this paper is based on an LCL (inductance-capacitance-inductance) immittance converter, and is improved of the basic SS compensation network. First of all, the operational principle and the frequency characteristics of the LCL-SS resonant network are discussed. Then, output characteristics of the LCL-SS and the SS compensation network are analyzed in a simulation model, and the simulation results illustrate the advantages of the proposed resonant converter. At last, an experimental prototype, delivering 254W power to a resistive load at the distance of 15cm, is constructed based on this resonant converter. The theoretical analysis and the feasibility of the proposed method are verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Smart energy hub — Modularized hybrid AC/DC microgrid: System design and deployment
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hybrid AC/DC microgrid exhibits better compatibility with renewable energy sources, energy storages and various loads. The conventional smart grid system are building based and require customized system design, which is costly and time-consuming. In this paper, smart energy hub, which is the modularized microgrid system design, is proposed to simplify system deployment. In order to realize the three-level hierarchical control to ensure both speed of response and system control accuracy, different sub-systems have been designed and developed. Multi-mode operation of the power electronic converters is enabled to cater for system operation in different scenarios. Resource manager serves as a super smart meter + relay controller to simplify the SCADA system design and enhance the speed of response. Microgrid operating system is designed to coordinate all the function blocks to realize hierarchical control in robust manner. Prototype of the proposed energy hub has been designed and developed to integrate all the sub-systems (both hardware and software).

articleTitle: The real time generation scheduling model considering automatic generation control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the operational level of dispatch department and integrate the real-time generation scheduling and the automatic generation control, this paper presents real-time control mode conversion mechanism to establish coordinated operation mechanism of real-time generation schedules and automatic generation control. The units are divided into three control types: automatic generation control unit, the transitional unit and planning unit. The three types of units are modeled separately. Automatic generation control unit and the transitional unit control mode can be converted to each other, and the reserve is dynamic allocated between three types of units. The IEEE 118-bus system for the model is tested. The results show that the model is feasible and effective to schedule the real-time generation plan considering the automatic generation control, which can allocate the reserve legitimately, reduce the pressure of automatic generation control and use the reserve effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of probabilistic energy flow for integrated electricity-gas energy system with P2G based on cumulant method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the wide application of gas turbine and power-to-gas (P2G) equipment, the electricity network and natural gas network are coupled more tightly. With the continuous improvement of new energy penetration, the variables are needed to be investigated in the coupled system considering random fluctuations emerge. In this paper, the probabilistic energy flow model of the integrated electricity-gas energy system (IEGES) with wind power is established. Considering the influence of various uncertain factors, the distribution of state variables are obtained by using the cumulant method and Gram-Chailier expansion. The validity of the proposed model and the cumulant method are verified by the analytic results of the case. In the IEGES, P2G technology can promote the consumption of wind power from grid by conversing it to natural gas stored in the gas network. So, P2G technology reduces the impact of wind power integration on power system security.

articleTitle: Long-term wind accommodation of interconnected power grids via HVDC tie-line based on aggregate unit model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the interconnected power grids, the wind energy can be accommodated in the wider area by optimizing the tie line power flows and coordinating the multi-area generation resources. Therefore, a sequential simulation method considering the flexible operation of high voltage direct current (HVDC) tie lines is presented in the paper to analyze the wind accommodation in the long-term horizon. To speed the computation for long-term simulation, the aggregate unit model is considered to reduce the number of integer variables by clustering a large number of individual units into a few of unit groups. In addition, a rolling calculation strategy is adopted for the simulation of a year. In the end, a case study is conducted to show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Load disaggregation in non-intrusive load monitoring based on random forest optimized by particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fine-grained load disaggregation based on smart metering plays an important role in energy consumption optimization on appliance level. This paper proposed a load disaggregation in non-intrusive load monitoring based on random forest optimized by particle swarm optimization(PSO-RF) in order to real-time monitor and recognize the type and working state of smart appliances in the smart grid user side. The method was mainly based on event detection and multi-feature classification system to do load disaggregation. Firstly, the method of identifying the switching state of power fluctuation signals based on the power difference was proposed. Then, the multi-feature parameters of the switching events were extracted to train the PSO-RF in order to identify the type and switching the state of the appliance. The experimental results showed that the recognition accuracy can approach to 98.9% for switched-on state and 97.5% for the switched-off state, which are both higher than GA-BP and GA-SVM.

articleTitle: Research on application of battery energy storage system based on MMC in wind power integration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A battery energy storage system based on MMC (MMC-BESS) is discussed, the system has active and reactive comprehensive compensation capability. The MMC-BESS is applied in wind farm integration, which can smooth the power fluctuations and improve voltage of bus effectively. Bidirectional DC/DC link is used to parallel the batteries with DC side of submodule, the state of charge (SOC) balance control strategy and control strategy of MMC-BESS are proposed. The reactive power compensation capacity is expanded in application of wind power integration, a coordinated control strategy based on transient reactive power capacity is proposed when bus voltage is unusual. The feasibility of topology and proposed control strategy is validated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on load classification based on user's typical daily load curve
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the characteristics that the load nodes of park is concentrated, the paper first introduces the hierarchical clustering method, then choose typical park users to get the daily load curve, and use this method to do a cluster with typical daily load curve. The clustering result shows that the classification method can simply show the load characteristics of each user and provide guidance for the park energy supply.

articleTitle: Distribution system state estimation considering the uncertainty of DG output
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The penetration of DGs in modern distribution system brings more uncertainty. GMM (Gaussian Mixture Model) provides an effective way to represent the output distribution of DGs. The current used state estimator is based on WLS method which assumes the error information is Gaussian distributed. To successfully conduct the WLS based state estimation with GMM output, weights information of all the measurements is required. An effective approach to set reasonable weights for the measurements information is proposed in this paper with the purpose to improve the estimation quality with scarce real-time measurements. A simulation is conducted with ukgds-95 system with matlab software to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Model and balance of flywheel energy storage system with composite flywheel and rolling bearings
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Flywheel energy storage (FES) technology has been applied to meet demands for energy quality and stability in partial application scenarios. And composite flywheel has become a hotspot for better performance in recent years. This paper introduces a 3.6MJ FES with composite flywheel and establishes shaft-support model and shaft-shell-support model. Dynamic characteristics of the two models are calculated by both transfer matrix method (TMM) and finite element method (FEM). The analysis shows little difference between two models except for the natural frequency of shell. Dynamic balance test is adopted to help the FES pass through the first three critical speeds smoothly under atmospheric condition.

articleTitle: Integrated modeling and planning of district multi-carrier energy systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an integrated modeling and planning method is proposed to solve the optimal problems in a district multi-carrier energy system. Firstly, an energy hub composed of four-tier transfer matrices is modeled to handle the coupling interconnection of multiple energies. Then an integrated planning method which minimizes the total costs of installations, maintenances, primary energy consumptions and network losses is proposed to meet the district energy demands. Three problems of optimization, i.e. optimal installed capacities, economic dispatch and optimal layout are designed for obtaining an integrated solution. The proposed method is finally verified on a 9-buses multiple energy system demanding five types of energies: electricity, hot steam, hot water, hot air and cold air. The proposed method is proved valid and practical.

articleTitle: Internet information applied in the energy internet planning: A review and outlook
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy industry and infor-mation technologies, the concept of energy Internet is proposed to prevent the energy crisis and reduce the environmental pollution. However, the planning of energy Internet is facing great challenges that there are large uncertainties of boundary conditions in the planning. The collection of Internet information can help solve the problem. This paper introduces the method of collecting objective data from the Internet, such as renewable energy sources data, climate data, and economic data, and the usage of the data for energy Internet planning. The method of collecting and processing fuzzy information from the Internet are introduced as well. The events related to the energy Internet planning can be perceived and be applied to the multi-scenario planning of energy Internet. Besides, the difficulties and outlooks of the usages are given.

articleTitle: Frequency control in distribution feeders based on bidirectional V2G converter for EV
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EV) could participate not only in the peak load shifting of power, but also in the frequency regulation of distribution system based on the technology of Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G). Through the transmission of active power between EV's battery and distribution network controlled by bidirectional V2G converter, primary frequency regulation could be achieved locally. In this paper, a two stage V2G converter and relevant control strategy is designed advanced. Then based on the bidirectional V2G converter, primary frequency regulation droop control is introduced to improve previous control strategy. Droop controller designed from EV's droop curve is used to change frequency deviation in distribution into active power deviation, and consequently the value and direction of active power transmitted by V2G converter is adjusted to regulate the frequency. Finally, simulation results verify the feasibility of the droop control for EV and the frequency deviation could be regulated back to acceptable range by V2G converter in distribution feeders.

articleTitle: A design method of MMC-HVDC physical simulation system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the growing power rating and voltage level, modular multilevel converter (MMC) is a feasible solution in the application of voltage sourced converter based high voltage direct current(VSC-HVDC) transmission. However, due to its numerous independently controlled sub-modules(SMs), it is very difficult to represent the complete internal transient process of MMC or accomplish the hardware-in-loop (HIL) test of valve based controller (VBC) using digital simulation platform. Therefore, this paper deduces the similarity criterions and the parameter calculation method for the design of low-voltage physical simulation system. Taking the Xiamen ± 3 20kV/1000MW MMC-HVDC project in China as a simulation prototype, a physical simulation system is built, based on which the type test of VBC and system operation analysis are completed. Experiment results verify the correctness of the proposed calculation method and the designed system.

articleTitle: Cyber physical power system modeling and simulation based on graph computing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an extension of Cyber Physical System, Cyber Physical Power System (CPPS) is to describe a communication, computing, control and physical coupled system for the power grid. While the computational complexity increases, it is not the best option to utilize relational database and matrix computation to implement real-time processing and analysis in CPPS. The graph computing has demonstrated its capabilities in managing large-scale data and executing the distributed parallel computation algorithms. This paper firstly uses graph database and graph computing to model and simulate the CPPS. The three-layer framework of CPPS is implemented with the graph database. The efficiency of information collection and command transmission is analyzed based on graph computing. The simulation shows that the time latency's calculation is significantly simplified by using graph computing which converts matrix computation problem to a graph traversal problem.

articleTitle: A novel location method for distribution hybrid lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve effects of time synchronization problems in double-ended traveling wave location method and achieve exact identification of reflected wave crests in single-ended traveling wave location method, a novel location method is proposed in this paper. A preliminary fault location and approximate values of fault distance are calculated by double-ended principle firstly. Then fault point reflected waves' arrival time at both sides are calculated via using approximate values. Compared with theoretical time, a time error matrix is built and the value which is closest to zero is identified as the actual arrival time of fault point reflected wave. Finally, accurate location is accomplished based on the single-ended traveling wave principle. EMTP-ATP simulation results show that the proposed fault location method is feasible in hybrid lines and fault location accuracy is improved obviously.

articleTitle: Fault isolation characteristics of the hybrid DC circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The topologies and operation principles of the hybrid Direct Current Circuit Breaker (DCCB) are present in this paper. The equivalent circuits of the hybrid DCCB in different period of the current breaking process are obtained. Then the fault current path of DC double pole short-circuit fault, monopole grounding fault, single phase to ground fault and the fault isolation characteristics of the hybrid DCCB during these fault are analyzed. The hybrid DCCB can isolate the fault lines from the converter stations, and can isolate the converter station if fault occurs in the AC side or in the converter, avoiding influences on another converter station. During current interrupting, the transient breaking voltage of the hybrid DCCB is added to the DC line voltage, then the insulation requirements of the DC line and DC equipment increase. Finally, simulations about hybrid DCCB isolating fault effect are carried to verify the analytical results.

articleTitle: Optimal day-ahead scheduling of electricity and natural gas system at the distribution level considering uncertainty of natural gas load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the widespread of micro-turbines (MT) in the distribution network, the interaction between electricity and natural gas system is intensified. Compared with scheduling separately, the joint scheduling of the electricity and natural gas system is more economical and reliable. In this paper, we present an optimal day-ahead scheduling model of the electricity and natural gas system based on alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) to handle the opacity of the information between the electricity network and natural gas network. Besides, with consideration of the uncertainties of distributed generation (DG), the variations of the consumption in electricity network and the natural gas network, the worst case of the system is obtained by column-and-constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm and the natural gas flow model is processed by adopting incremental piecewise linear method (IPLM) which alleviates the difficulty of problem-solving. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is validated by the case study.

articleTitle: Impact analysis for high-penetration distributed photovoltaic generation integrated into grid based on DIgSILENT
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The introduction of distributed power generation makes the distribution system change from radial passive network into active network with small and medium-sized power supplies. And the reverse flow generated by high penetration distributed power supplies will bring great challenges to voltage management and equipment protection system of distribution network. This paper presents a quantitative expression of penetration as well as evaluation indices which reflect the influence of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation on grid voltage, network power loss and network elements loading. Besides, it also analyzes the maximum accessible PV capacity of the test grid, and proposes the critical point of high penetration. Then, by continuous load flow calculation, the impacts of highpenetration distributed PV generation on the grid voltage, network power loss and network elements loading are analyzed.

articleTitle: Affinely adjustable robust optimal dispatch for island microgrids with wind power, energy storage and diesel generators
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an affinely adjustable robust optimization (AARO) approach to account for the uncertainty of wind power in microgrid optimal dispatch. It proposes an affinely adjustable robust optimal dispatch formulation where the base-point generation of energy storage system (ESS) and diesel generators is calculated to serve the forecasting load which is not balanced by wind power in island microgrid. The affinely adjustable robust dispatch framework is solved using the second-order cone programming, and the optimal base-point output and participation factors of energy storage and diesel generator in each dispatch interval are obtained on the wind fluctuation according to an uncertainty set. Numerical results show that the optimal operating cost increases slightly with the increase of wind power output uncertainty with higher operating costs using AARO method, but the more robust dispatch scheme, compared to deterministic cases. AARO can effectively cope with wind power prediction errors with a high success rate in day-ahead dispatch, especially when it lacks short-term renewable energy forecast data.

articleTitle: Electromechanical modelling of modular multilevel converter based HVDC system and its application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces the electromechanical modelling method of modular multilevel converter based high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) system and studies the Chongqing-Hubei project based on the model. Firstly, the steady load flow model is established in this paper. Then, the transient stability model, which includes the AC side model, DC side model and control system model, is described in detail. For improving the transient stability, an additional control method, which combines a frequency controller and emergency power support strategy, is added on the control system model. Moreover, the modulation model is studied and discussed in case of fault conditions. The model is implemented on PSASP and its validity is verified through comparison with electromagnetic model. At last, the simulation is carried out based on the real grid date. The simulation results demonstrate the benefits of MMC-HVDC and the improvement in transient stability by applying the additional control method.

articleTitle: A passive islanding detection method based on interharmonic impedance
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a passive islanding method based on PCC point interharmonic impedance measurement is proposed to solve the problem that the passive passive islanding detection method is too large to detect the dead zone. Which also overcomes the problem that the traditional impedance measurement method increases in the non-detection area (NDZ) when the multi-inverter is juxtaposed, and avoids the power quality problem caused by the active detection. Finally, the accuracy of this method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Stability analysis and operation control of photovoltaic generation system connected to weak grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) generation system is an important way to promote energy transformation and to cope with environmental challenges, firstly, based on the steady-state power flow equations of the PV system AC side connected to weak grid, the influence of power grid structure parameters on their maximum transmission power is studied, which provides a theoretical basis for the design of subsequent virtual impedance; secondly, a time-domain small-signal model for PV system connected to weak grid is established, and based on the proposed small-signal model, eigenvalue analysis is employed to study the stability of PV system connected to weak grid within different grid strength. The results show that: in the case of a given SCR, the smaller the impedance angle is, the greater the maximum transmission power of the system is; when the output power of PV system is rated, the smaller grid impedance angle makes the PV system can operate under the weaker grid conditions; with the decreasing of the grid strength, the PV system prone to power oscillation Finally a virtual resistance control strategy is proposed to improve the operation stability of PV system The validity of the theoretical analysis and the feasibility of the control strategy are verified by time domain simulation.

articleTitle: Virtual inertia control strategy at energy-storage terminal in DC microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the low inertia of DC microgrid system, the DC bus voltage oscillation is easily resulted by the large power gap of the system. Therefore, the virtual inertia control strategy at the energy-storage terminal in DC microgrid is proposed. The strategy sets the droop coefficient at the battery terminal as a function, which takes the voltage variation rate as the variable; When the DC microgrid system is disturbed, the battery provides additional inertia power, equivalents to increasing the capacitance on the DC side. In addition, to meet the requirement for response speed of the DC microgrid system under different voltage variation rates, this paper proposed a virtual inertia control strategy with droop coefficient a piecewise function. Finally, to verify validity of the proposed strategy, simulations based on Matlab/simulink are conducted and the results verify the effectiveness of the strategy.

articleTitle: Ordered charging strategy for electric vehicles based on load balancing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a charging strategy for electric vehicle based on load balance aiming at the different timeliness of household electricity consumption and the three phase imbalance of power distribution system caused by charging of electric vehicle. Firstly, the three-phase imbalance of the distribution system is reduced by adjusting the charging time of the electric vehicle, the size of the charging power, and the amount of charging loads inserted to per phase of the power distribution system. Secondly, the bilayer particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the charging strategy. Finally, the simulation study of a residential area is carried out. The results show that the charging strategy proposed in this paper can not only ensure the voltage quality of the distribution system, but also can decrease the three-phase irregularity of the district power distribution system effectively and ensure the stable and reliable operation of the system.

articleTitle: An interval state estimation for electricity-gas urban energy systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Increasing interdependency between urban electricity and gas networks requires an integrated analysis for both networks. We propose an interval state estimation framework, which can provide the comprehensive interval information for the urban energy network real-time monitoring and control. An op-timization-based approach is employed to produce the upper and lower bounds of state variables. Moreover, we introduce an un-certainty budget for pseudo measurements considering the fact that pseudo measurements cannot be simultaneously valued at their upper/lower bounds Test results on the IEEE 13-node sys-tem and a 9-node gas system indicate that the proposed interval state estimation approach produces an exact interval result. In the meanwhile, the consideration of measurement uncertainty budget contributes to providing a tighter interval solution.

articleTitle: Design of preventing electricity-stolen intelligent video surveillance terminal based on 4G network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The current common preventing electricity-stolen technology and existing defects is analyzed, the key technologies such as 4G communication module, intelligent video forensics are proposed, a intelligent video monitoring terminal basing on 4G network and integrating electricity larceny prevention and live video monitoring, is developed, it provides the important means for combating power theft in accordance with the law. The overall design scheme of intelligent video monitoring terminal basing on 4G networks electricity-stolen prevention is proposed, the terminal system hardware, MPU, each function module and the peripheral interface are designed, terminal image acquisition and image compression technology, up image data transmission and 4G communication technology is studied and implemented. The design methods of terminal system software architecture, software function, and the related system interface are proposed, the image acquisition process of electricity larceny prevention device is emphatically designed, the design schemes of gate node switch trigger and infrared pyroelectric detect trigger camera are proposed. The device can timely find the scene of the various power theft, and to obtain evidence, can effectively solve the difficulty of electricity larceny evidence collection, has a strong practical value and broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Junction temperature estimation in IGBT power modules based on Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) were widely used in energy field, its reliability has become the focus of industry. Temperature is the main reason for the failure of power electronic converter, and the accurate estimation temperature of IGBT module is an important basis for its reliability evaluation. Currently the main methods of extracting junction temperature are thermo sensitive electrical parameter method (TSEP) and the thermal impedance model method, due to the TSEP method requires additional auxiliary circuit and it is susceptible to electromagnetic interference, does not necessarily apply to the applications. In this paper, a junction temperature estimation method depends on thermal impedance model is proposed, it fuses Kalman filter and IGBT modules' NTC thermistor reflects indirectly junction temperature. Proposed method estimation procedure does not need to store large amounts of data, does not take up too much memory and accurate estimation of junction temperature, it is also easier to realize the IGBT reliability evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the installation location and parameter configuration method of UPFC in energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power grid interconnection is helpful to the realization of hydro thermal exchange and regional complementary, and achieves more rational utilization of energy. Research indicated that the transmission capacity of most interprovincial sections is mainly limited by the thermal stability limit and cannot take full advantage of the transmission capacity of the line. When a three-phase short-circuit fault permanently happened on the heavy load line, the power is transferred to other lines on the same channel or a line with a relatively close electrical distance, causing heavy load or overload. As a type of Energy Router, through the research on the control mechanism of UPFC device, this paper puts forward the selection of UPFC installation location and the method of parameter configuration. Based on the research on control mechanism of UPFC device, this paper proposes the scheme selection of UPFC installation location and its parameter configuration method. The heavy load lines of interprovincial section are screened by power flow analysis, and then the corresponding installation sites of UPFC are determined. Active power of line is controlled accurately by using proper configuration parameters and applying the control function of UPFC device. Furthermore, the balanced distribution of power flow in sections and the purpose of improving transmission capacity are achieved. Taking the Shanxi-Hebei section of actual power grid operation as an example, the validity of proposed method is verified by PSD-BPA simulation.

articleTitle: Research on voltage quality analysis system based on kernel density estimation for power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The voltage quality analysis and evaluation are the important means to characterize power system operation and provides key parameters for power system stability control and optimal operation. In view of massive and heterogeneous data of the present power system, the article summarizes and analyzes the defects of the traditional evaluation method of voltage quality and the existing bottlenecks of power system data analysis software. In the current voltage quality analysis is method, the kernel density estimation is introduced to solve the problem that the existing methods can not reflect the voltage fluctuation in the voltage quality analysis. R language analysis tool is used to develop and implement the software, which adds 3 new indexes, such as standard deviation, kernel density distribution and violin distribution. Through the examples of the kernel density estimation with distribution curve can correct response voltage on the voltage of the year, can realize the voltage violin daily kernel density estimation for abnormal distribution based on screening.

articleTitle: The research on cyber-attack testbed with hardware-in-loop
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of smart grid will depend on the increased developments of communication technology and advanced measurement technology to support observation and control function. Unfortunately, this also increase the risk from cyber-attacks in communication network and second power equipment. Designing the cyber-attack testbed with hardware-in-loop provides technical support for theoretical research and operational strategy formulation of power cyber-physical system (CPS). This paper provides an overview of smart grid co-simulation platform, including system structure and synchronized methods. It then introduces the classification of cyber-attack. The cyber-attack testbed with hardware-in-loop is then introduced, including the architecture, modeling process, applications, and novel capabilities, such as RT-Lab, OPNET, and the security and stability control device. Finally, several attack scenarios are evaluated using the testbed to explore cyber-physical impacts. In particular, availability and integrity attacks are demonstrated with both isolated and coordinated approaches, these attacks are then evaluated based on the power grid's voltage stability.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of multiple energy system considering power to gas unit
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy society, energy shortage and environmental pollution are urgent problems we need to tackle. Electricity, natural gas, cooling, heating and other different energy carriers in multiple energy system can be transformed between each other. The operational cost of whole energy system can be reduced and energy utilization efficiency can be improved with coupling relationship among different multiple energy carriers. In integrated energy system, power to gas (P2G) unit has received considerable attention worldwide recently because it can transform power into natural gas or hydrogen, which can better utilize electricity such as extra wind power during off-peak load period and decrease the operational cost for natural gas and peak-period load. Therefore, this paper pays attention to optimal scheduling of multiple energy system considering power to gas unit. It first briefly introduces the general concept of multiple energy system, which can be divided into energy hub and combined power and gas network. Then it elaborates the characteristics and modelling of energy hub considering power to gas unit including typical energy conversion and energy storage units. Based on that, an optimal scheduling problem for multiple energy system with power to gas unit is proposed. Finally, numerical analysis is conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on application of integrated energy planning for island
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Micro-grid technology is becoming widely used in island power supply. And micro-grid applications are often considered for single energy-electricity energy. The research in island energy systems plan becomes an urgent requirement. In this document, a kind of energy configuration method is introduced. Based in variety of energy requirement, this integrated method compare with several scheme, evaluate of the indicators of whole system. Method of micro-grid of island design and evaluate is introduced. In this paper, the related micro-grid system is analyzed the operation of various energy sources, to achieve an integrated application of energy on the island.

articleTitle: Stackelberg game based energy operator operating scheme and energy management
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy operator who can supply electricity, heat and gas to users as an emerging operating entity will play an important role in the future energy market. How to develop energy operator pricing strategy and achieving operator and community users win-win situation has become an important issue. In this paper, the community energy internet, which includes PV, gas turbine and electric vehicle, aims to maximize the interests of both energy operator and users. Based on the Stackelberg game, this paper proposes an operator pricing, user load response, electric vehicle charging and discharging strategy, and the genetic algorithm is used to obtain the equilibrium solution. Finally, simulation results shows that the model can give full play to the potential of electric vehicle and controllable load, and verify the effectiveness of the model in coordinating the benefits of multi-stakeholder and improving the system load characteristics.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling and control optimization for energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of Energy Internet in recent years, the rapid promotion of new energy emerging facilities highlights the trend of the future energy interconnection. Under the system architecture, renewable energy and grid, energy storage, energy deployment and transportation problems require a flexible grid scheduling strategy to deal with complex consumer tasks. The optimization of electric-gas-thermal mixed energy supply system is an effective way to solve the rational allocation of energy. Optimizing the network power flow can not only improve the efficiency of energy utilization, Optimizing the network power flow can not only improve the efficiency of energy use, but also minimize network redundancy through the high degree of coupling. In this paper, the mathematical model of multi-energy load is established under the framework of advanced measurement system and energy Internet. Based on the load forecasting of LMBP algorithm, an optimal genetic algorithm is used to solve the establishment of an example to achieve optimal allocation of multi-energy flow and capacity allocation.

articleTitle: Energy & cost efficient auto start/stop kit system for motor bikes: An eco-friendly technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent few decades' energy conservation and to cut down greenhouse gases are the most center of interest. In this scenario reducing energy consumption in public transport will provide sustainable cost saving. A large amount of work and research is being done on the idle reduction of heavy-duty vehicles. Along with heavy-duty vehicles, passenger vehicles and personal vehicles also contributes towards emissions and fuel wastage during idling. In current scenario in case of Pakistan, there is a huge number of motorbikes running on the roads and approximately 1,358,643 units/year are being added to it. These motorbikes are one of the main contributors to air pollution and fuel consumption. In this study, an energy and cost-effective approach for motorbikes is suggested. The approach was applied to 150 cc motorbike.

articleTitle: Benefit analysis of coordinated operation of distributed energy storage: The distributed network operator's perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage systems (ESSs) play an important role in addressing the increasing demand for flexibility in the power system, due to the increased penetration of renewable energy sources. Moreover, ESSs are also a cost-effective solution to network and system capacity shortages. In this setting, this paper analyzes the potential of ESSs to support the adequate operation of distribution networks by providing capacity services. Particularly, the ability of multiple ESSs to provide security of supply through a coordinated operation. The proposed solution was compared against traditional methods and assessed in two case studies: different demand conditions and reactive power capability. In addition, a sensitivity analysis, regarding ESS power and energy capacity, was carried out. The results demonstrate that a coordinated operation of multiple ESSs can further support distribution network operators (DNOs) managing peaks of demand. Furthermore, the studies have also shown that reactive power capabilities of ESSs can significantly increase the value of ESSs for DNOs.

articleTitle: Research on inventory model of smart electricity meter based on the balance of supply and demand
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the current situation of measurement business under the environment of supply chain imbalance between supply and demand, based on the premise of punctual delivery and consider Supply from multiple suppliers, and meet the demands of multiple class-2 warehouse. A mathematical model for calculating the time of delivery and the point of order for the first-class warehouse and the second-class stage warehouse is established, and the safety inventory model based on this delivery time is built. The example analysis shows that the model can solve the problem of overstock or shortage of stock equipment, and increase the turnover rate of metering equipment.

articleTitle: A simplified modeling method of new energy sources applied in relay protection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Nowadays, new energy has been massively accessed to the distribution network. Since its complex topological structure and control characteristics increase the complexity of the new energy source model, it is necessary to study the simplified modeling of new energy sources for the relay protection simulation analysis. Utilizing the modeling idea of testing and analysis and the simplified modeling method based on experimental data, the author treats the generation unit with complex architecture and control information as a black-box model in this paper. The fault current expression is depicted by means of the typical control system response; meanwhile, the relationship between the fault current expression and the fault voltage amplitude is created with sample data of the voltage drop test, the nonlinear mapping relationship between fault current and fault voltage is obtained, thus the new energy source model can be equivalent to a voltage controlled current source. Taking the Doubly Fed Induction Generators (DFIGs) as the modeling object and using fine modeling to simulate the transient fault under symmetrical short circuit conditions, the author establishes a simplified model with the consequential sample data.

articleTitle: Analysis of the circulating current characteristics of MMC in DQ frame
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to realize the design of main circuit parameter and operation optimization of the modular multilevel converter (MMC) device, it is necessary to analyze the internal operating characteristics of the MMC. On the basis of the dynamic DQ model, in this paper, the composition of the arm current is analyzed and the equivalent circuits of odd harmonics and even harmonics are proposed. The analysis result of circulating current in dq frame is obtained. Comparing with the existing steady-state analysis method, it can avoid complex trigonometric function calculation and improving the calculation speed. more specifically, the method proposed in this paper only needs one matrix operation. Based on the DC transmission test system proposed by CIGRE, a two terminal HVDC transmission system is established in PSCAD/EMTDC. Finally the theoretical analysis results are compared with the simulation results, by the comparison between the two results, the feasibility and reliability of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between electricity consumption and Troika in Fujian province based on input-output theory
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyses connections between the input and output in different economic departments. Based on the input-output theory, the relationship among consumption, investment, export data and electricity consumption is studied. Firstly, mathematical model of “Troika” leading to electricity consumption is built. Secondly, by utilizing input-output tables in 2002, 2007 and 2012 published by Statistics Bureau of Fujian and industrial electricity consumption tables in Fujian Province published by State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company, relationship and developing trends between electricity consumption and “Troika” are calculated. Study results show that pushing effect of investment to electricity consumption increases year by year, while that of consumption decreases. The pushing effect of export is the smallest. From industrial views, the electricity consumption caused by other manufacturing industry accounts for the biggest proportion, while that caused by finance represents the smallest percentage.

articleTitle: Optimal dispatch of power grid under direct power purchase by large consumers
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Direct power purchase by large consumers is a good attempt to adjust the power price by market means, which is in favor of exploring a reasonable price formation mechanism and promotes the establishment of an open electricity market. To make the wheeling price and power loss minimum as the target, the paper presents a method based on the flow tracing, tracing the source of large power users, establishing the power grid optimization scheduling model considering the direct power purchase by large consumers. This paper simulates and analyzes the power grid optimization scheduling strategy under different numbers of large consumers in IEEE 30-bus system, the results demonstrate that the model presented can achieve comprehensive optimization of power loss and wheeling price satisfying the requirements of large consumers.

articleTitle: Research on power data transmission method based on monitoring system combined with optical fiber and wireless communication network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent distribution network technology, “Optical fiber backbone network + low-power wireless communication network” becomes the most reasonable scheme for power system data acquisition. Optical fiber network access port, called “ONU” port, has been set up in the fiber backbone network at different geographical locations. In this situation, interfaces require numerous power parameters to be collected, and the ports around each “ONU” are also different. It leads to the problem that the collected data is not unified, which put forward higher requirements to the transmission method of urban electric power parameter. In this paper, there is a data transmission method based on the monitoring system combined with fiber and wireless communication network in the urban area, which can effectively solve this problem.

articleTitle: A calculation method of coupling relationship between multiple sections in chain power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Low frequency oscillation or poor dynamic stability tends to occur in long-chain interconnected power system. Factors on the source and grid side. The factors on the generator side and network side both have certain influence on the system dynamic stability, such as, generator control parameters, load characteristics, operation mode, subsystem internal structure and power flow, etc. In order to research the effect of transmission section location and power flow on system dynamic stability, in this paper, for the network made of several chain coupling structure sections, a calculation method was proposed about sensitivity and coupling degree of transmission sections, which contributes to analyze difference among influence of different sections on stability. At first, change law of system damping ratio and relative angles between the delivery end and the receiving end of interconnected system, was analyzed, based on relationship between interface power flow and relative power angle of units on both sides in chain grid. And then, the derivation was conducted, about relative sensitivity of system dynamic stability to interface power flow, following the exploration of coupling mechanism between sections power flow. Research shows that there are several factors associate with the section sensitivity, such as reactance, the angle difference and inertia time constants of sending-end units. Furthermore, the proposed method was applied in three-machine chain system model and Meng-xi chain network, and theoretical conclusion and simulation results verified the validity and feasibility of this method. When actual power grid running dynamic stably, calculation of the sensitivity and correlation of the cross section can provide a reliable basis, for the coordination control of power flow between several sections, as well as system damping improvement program.

articleTitle: Research on power quality prediction for DG integrated smart grid based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a new approach based on neural network is proposed to availably predict the power quality (PQ) for smart grid with distributed generation (DG) integration. We first analyze the various factors that have remarkable impact on the variation tendency of PQ, such as climatic variation, fluctuation of power loads, etc. Then we put forward a general prediction process for steady-state index of power quality. Three neural networks with different structures, including Back Propagation (BP), Radical Basis Function (RBF) and General Regression Neural Network (GRNN) whose feasibilities and features are contrastively analyzed are used to build the prediction models for PQ. Simulation study is carried out on the IEEE 13 node test feeder, and the results demonstrate that the proposed prediction approaches for the steady-state PQ indexes based on neural networks are practicable, in which the prediction model based on the GRNN has the best performance.

articleTitle: Research on dispersed wind generation planning in distributed systerm based on voltage maximum correntropy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The influence of dispersed wind generation(DWG) on distribution network is closely related to its location and sizing. It is very important for the planning of DWG to operate safely and economically. This paper establishes a mathematical model of the optimal voltage quality and the minimum operating cost of the grid. In order to reduce the influence of noise on some system voltage, this paper introduces maximum correntropy criterion(MCC) as the cost function, so as to better reflect the situation of the overall voltage. Aiming at the problem of nonlinear multi-objective optimization, this paper selects a new algorithm-memetic algorithm for solving the problem. The simulation experiment was carried out by using IEEE33 node system and an engineering example. The simulation results show that the proposed model and the algorithm is effective, superior contrasting with the traditional model and algorithm. and the algorithm used is fast and efficient. And the planning results agree with the actual project.

articleTitle: Distribution network restoration using mixed integer linear programming approach based on node state variable
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of mixed integer linear programming (MILP) based on node state variable optimization, aiming at achieving the optimal restoration strategy for distribution system reasonably and quickly. First, the concept of node state variable is put forward, which has node property and power source property. On this basis, the relationship between node state variable and switch state variable is expressed as a linear function, namely switch state linear model. Secondly, by using linearization method, current and voltage linear equations based on Kirchhoff's law are obtained. In the equations, state variables such as node voltage and branch current are bound by node state and switch state variables. Finally, the MILP model of optimal power flow in distribution system is built, whose objective function is minimizing both the loss of load and the number of switching operations. The simulation verifies the rationality and validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Optimal on-line energy management of building microgrid based on improved grey prediction model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the penetration rate of distributed generation is increasing on the user side, an on-line energy management system for the building microgrid based on the improved gray prediction is proposed. Firstly, the whole model of building microgrid is established, including the energy storage system model, the electric vehicle model, the interaction model with the upper power grid and the controllable load model. Then the basic gray prediction model is improved to make it predict the real-time electricity price, the photovoltaic power generation and the home loads, and also improve the prediction accuracy. And then an online energy management system is put forward for building microgrid, to solve the daily optimal electricity plan aiming at the maximum profit of home energy and stabilizing the power fluctuation of tie line. Finally, the effectiveness of the energy management strategy is verified by comparing the control effect under different energy management modes for building microgrid.

articleTitle: The research on the value of distributed resources based on the decomposition of distribution LMP(DLMP)
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of Smart Grid (SG) and Energy Internet (EI), it is essential for the system operator to provide accurate price signals in order to design an efficient incentive mechanism for distributed resources (such as reactive power compensation, demand response, distributed generation, etc.) owners in the distribution network. In this paper, a distribution Locational Marginal Price (DLMP) formulation, taking voltage constraints into consideration, is introduced. Based on decomposition of DLMP into Energy Cost Sector (ECS), Loss Cost Sector (LCS) and Voltage Cost Sector (VCS), the economic value of DR is quantitative analyzed by being spilt into energy value, loss value and voltage value. Test results show that: 1) VCS is a significant component of DLMP in the low voltage distribution network. 2) Regional high DLMP and customers' payments caused by external factors like market power can be reduced by DR conduction. 3) Great economic value, especially voltage value can be created by the introduction of DR.

articleTitle: Controller design of aggregate thermostatically controlled loads based on tracking differentiator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the problem of directly controlling thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs) in smart grid. A proportion-integral-derivative (PID) controller is reconstructed by the tracking differentiator (TD). The controller realizes the frequency regulation service in the smart grid by changing the temperature setpoint to control the TCLs. Simulation results show that the modified PID controller is effective in reducing the loads tracking errors and improving the frequency regulation service quality.

articleTitle: Reconfiguration of distribution network based on Jordan frames with energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the problem that the wind energy is unadjustable to the distribution network reconfiguration, this paper proposes a mixed-integer second order cone optimization model based on Jordan frames for the minimum losses distribution network reconfiguration with storage problem. The exact solutions of the model can be obtained efficiently. In addition, the proposal model can be solved to global optimality using available optimization solvers, such as Gurobi. Numerical results on two test networks including distributed generations show that the proposed model based on Jordan frames with storage is effective in reducing the network losses for network reconfiguration.

articleTitle: Analysis for HVDC inverter's influence on faults recovery of AC/DC hybrid grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For strong coupling of AC/DC hybrid grid, failure recovery of AC grid will be affected by the dynamic response of DC grid. In this paper, three major DC controller models are studied; main model factors influencing the failure recovery of AC grid are analyzed. A large disturbance is simulated on a regional AC/DC hybrid grid. The result shows that DC controller model and model parameters will have impacts on the fault recovery of AC/DC hybrid grid; new models are closer to the real performances of DC grid, and fault recovery characteristics are better; failure recovery characteristics can be improved by optimizing DC controller parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation tools for short circuit dynamic characteristics of photovoltaic power plants
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: One of the main trends in the development of solar photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected technology is the grid code compliance assessment for grid connection of PV power plant. But it is difficult to obtain the dynamic performance of the PV power plant under different operation scenarios through field test. In particular, it is costly to obtain the characteristics of the point of connection of PV power plant. The paper introduces support tools for simulation-based dynamic characteristics analysis of grid connection of PV power plant. Firstly, the function and flow chart of the developed support tools is described in detail. Then, the photovoltaic inverter detailed modelled. Finally, the support tools are developed based on the Powerfactory C++ API and Python package. The tools have many automation features that can be applied to online services which have be installed in the clean energy big data center. Test results have illustrated that the support tools can reflect dynamic performance of grid connection of PV power plant and can provide a decision support for the renewable energy priority scheduling.

articleTitle: Voltage control in distribution network by leveraging energy storage system in grid-tied microgrids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a control scheme to regulate voltage in the future distribution network where electronically interfaced microgrids and distributed generators (DGs) coexist with traditional voltage regulators such as on-load tap changer(OLTC) and capacitor bank(CB). Based on forecasts of loads and renewable generations in the distribution network, a voltage/var optimization(VVO) problem is formulated to minimize total power loss in the system. The reactive power injection from grid-tied microgrid is flexibly controlled by tuning the charging/discharging power of the energy storage system (ESS) within it. Furthermore, a local control scheme for ESS and interface converter is implemented in each microgrid to facilitate the power transition. The proposed voltage control scheme fully leverages the reserved energy in ESS to achieve a more flexible power exchange between grid-tied microgrid and distribution network, contributing to more satisfied voltage profile along the distribution feeders, reduced power loss in the system, and decreased cost on the construction of extra reactive compensators. The control scheme is tested on Matlab, and a genetic-based differential evolutionary(DE) algorithm is coded to solve the VVO problem. Case studies performed on a modified IEEE 33 nodes distribution network show the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: System design and development of distribution network planning quality indicator monitoring platform
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution network is an important infrastructure for people's livelihood, and it's a key link to protect the power “come down and useful”. Therefore, the rationality of distribution network planning also directly affects the regional economic development, social harmony and public safety. With the construction of intelligent distribution network, in order to further optimize the selection of distribution network planning quality index and the construction and operation of information system, this paper designs the monitoring platform of distribution network planning quality index. The grid company can achieve monitor and manage the distribution network planning quality indicators in real-time through the B/S structure of the system. The platform is more real and efficient, and it can save a lot of resources than traditional management.

articleTitle: Application of a new FP-network mining algorithm based on association matrix in power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power industry has accumulated a lot of data resources, and the research emphasis is how to improve efficiency of data mining. Aiming at the demerits of FP-tree (frequent pattern tree) mining algorithm, this paper puts forward a FP-network model which innovatively compresses data into a network diagram and it is stored by transaction-item matrix in computers. Node capacity is also innovatively defined to help mining association rules. This method can be applied to power system research and study cases of line faults is established to identify the weak links in grid. Results show that FP-network algorithm not only inherits the merits of FP-growth algorithm, but also only needs to scan the database once. And it is also easy to handle database update and maintenance, thus this method improves the efficiency of association rule mining for big data of power system.

articleTitle: Distributed three-phase load flow accommodated large scale heat pumps based on asynchronous iteration scheme
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With deployment of large scale distributed heat pumps, three-phase load flow considering heat pumps impact is a basic tool to analysis distribution network profile. Since there are numerous three-phase distribution network nodes and communication delay impact etc., centralized load flow and synchronous iterated load flow is difficult to achieve. Firstly, three-phase load flow with large scale heat pumps is proposed based on implicit node impedance method, secondly, asynchronous iterated load flow is proposed based on matrixsplit scheme. The proposed method is suitable for distribution network distributed load flow. Finally, the proposed method is validated with IEEE 123 test feeder.

articleTitle: Modeling the dynamics of fault propagation in complex dynamical network by considering the heterogeneity of nodes
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The process of fault propagation and study the dynamic behavior in complex dynamical network is modelled in this paper. A fault resistance factor and a weight factor of repair probability are defined to denote the heterogeneity of nodes. The effects of the key model parameters on the fault propagation dynamics are studied by numerical simulations with reference to the number of failed nodes, the fraction of nodes in the largest network component and the fault propagation cycle. Moreover, the node vulnerability is explored for different communication radiuses. The results obtained in the study show that the fault propagation dynamics will be affected by some parameters, such as communication radius, node density and moving speed. Hence, we should limit these parameters within a certain ranges so as to limit the fault propagation and reduce the loss caused by it.

articleTitle: Optimization model of ramp-capability reserve considering maximum fluctuation of load in short time-scale
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The grid-integration of massive intermittent renewable energy resources has a great influence on the net load fluctuations in short time-scale, which is closely related to the requirements of ramp-capability reserve of controllable generation. In this paper, an optimization model of the ramp-capability reserve is proposed by taking the maximum fluctuation of load (MFL) in short time-scale into consideration. The shortterm load fluctuation is defined as the gap between the maximum load and the minimum load in a given time interval, and MFL is the maximum one within a dispatching cycle. In the proposed method, a random error model is utilized to describe the uncertainties of MFL, and then a probabilistic model is formulated to determine the ramp-capability reserve under the given confidence level. In the case study, it is shown that the proposed method mitigates the ramp-capability shortage by optimizing the ramp-capability reserve to maintain the reliable power system operation.

articleTitle: A hybrid energy storage adaptive control strategy for PV power smoothing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distributed photovoltaics' large scale access in distribution network will bring many unfavourable factors due to its fluctuating output power. In this paper, an adaptive control strategy will be proposed based on the hybrid energy storage, by coordinating the power distribution between the battery and the super capacitor, to reach a fully use of fast responding characteristic of super capacitor. In addition, the state of charge (SOC) feedback function in proposed strategy will have a strong adaptive ability for taking into account the SOC changing, to realize the optimization of energy utilization. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy are verified using the simulation results.

articleTitle: A new type of DC distribution network and coordinated control strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Compared with the AC distribution network, the DC distribution network has the advantages of lower line losses, better power quality, higher reliability and being suitable for all kinds distributed generation and DC load access, etc. This paper firstly studies the models of PV and energy storage connected to the DC distribution network. Then, a new type of DC distribution network topology with hybrid DC circuit breaker is proposed. A coordinated control strategy is also proposed, which can control energy storage to improve the stability of the system. Finally, using PSCAD/EMTDC to model and simulate. The simulation results show that the proposed topology of DC distribution network and control strategy can quickly remove the fault, shorten the fault power failure time and ensure the safe and stable operation of the system, which greatly improves the operation efficiency and safety level of the power grid.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of substation considering uncertainties by using the multi-source information of the primary and secondary system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fast and accurate fault diagnosis of substation, it plays an important role in the operation of power system, limit the impact of power outages to a minimum. However, there will inevitably exist some uncertain and misstated information in the actual fault diagnosis. Meanwhile, most troubleshooting methods of the traditional substation only rely on the information of the primary system. Therefore, a new method is presented in this paper for substation fault diagnosis by combining the primary and secondary systems of multi-source information. Firstly, a fuzzy Petri net is developed to cope with the uncertainties. And then, a three stages fault diagnosis process will be carry out to make a comprehensive diagnosis by using the information of both the primary and secondary system. According to the fault diagnosis result of the illustrative example, the method developed can not only dealing with the uncertainties of the information, but also the overall performance of fault diagnosis can be improved by using Petri nets and find all the malfunctioned devices.

articleTitle: Standardized modeling of urban hot water heating system based on extended IEC 61970CIM
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of energy Internet, power system and thermal system combines more and more closely. But there is an information island between different systems. In order to achieve multi-energy flow management, it is necessary to break the information system between the power system and the thermal system. Taking the urban hot water heating system for example, this paper is based on in-depth study of urban hot water heating system model. The paper learns from the mature experience of power system information exchange standardization and uses object-oriented modeling method. The paper also extends classes and attributes of the urban hot water heating system and describes the topology model, the measurement model and the equipment model of the urban hot water heating system.

articleTitle: Generation and format conversion method of smart tag based on panorama configuration description
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Secondary circuits of smart substation uses more optical cables, but the tag information of optical cables which only uses previous ways cannot meet the current debugging needs. This paper proposes a smart label generation and format conversion method based on panorama configuration description, which is used to search the fiber information in the substation and get the physical circuit and logical circuit of the fiber. This method comprises the smart tag generation for the preparation stage and the format conversion for the searching stage. This method has been applied in the 220kV secondary operation and maintenance training room of State Grid Jiangsu Technician Training Center. Results show that this method can quickly and accurately search optical cable, obtain its corresponding physical circuit and logical circuit, thus, greatly improve the efficiency and accuracy of smart substation's debugging, operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Dynamic power flow calculation and open simulation of electro-thermal coupled system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper relates to the system analysis of energy internet with multi-type energy coupling complementation characteristic, the quasi-steady model of thermal system was built, and the dynamic power flow calculation method of electrothermal coupling energy system was studied. Based on Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP), the dynamic power flow calculation program was developed. Besides, open simulation was studied and the interface was developed accordingly, user-defined models could be inserted to the simulation of multi-type energy coupling system. In this paper, mature power system analysis software functions are fully used, and dynamic calculation of integrated energy network is realized, at the time, the scope of the program is extended to adapt to the situation of new equipment, components and new control strategies emerging nowadays.

articleTitle: Research on power consumption model of electric bus considering multiple external factors
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large scale operation of the electric bus (EB), the calculation of its charging load has significant impact on the operation and dispatch of EB as well as the planning of power grid. Thus, an accurate grasp of how external factors, such as the weather and the policy, affect the electric consumption is of great importance. This article firstly analyses the possible external factors that could influence the power consumption of EB. Then, a model considering various external factors is built. Furthermore, examples are given to illustrate how the proposed models could be used to forecast the electric consumptions of EB, which gives implication to forecasting the charging load as well as the operation and dispatch of EB.

articleTitle: Research on methods of non-communication protection for 20kV closed-loop distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In 20kV closed-loop distribution network, due to it has a great power supply density and short power cable line, leading to conventional current protection cannot meet the requirements of it. According to the characteristics of 20kV distribution network, we propose a new non-communication protection method. By comparing the local changing of the phase current value judges status of the remote breaker and time configuration of the accelerated protection determines the fault zone, and then accelerates trip of the local breaker. And the closed-loop operation of 20kV distribution network that occurs symmetrical fault can be chopped reliably. By PSCAD/EMTDC simulation shows non-communication protection method is reliability and speed.

articleTitle: Load transfer optimizer for high-voltage distribution network enabling high penetration of wind energy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing load has caused congestion risk of high-voltage distribution network (HVDN) due to the limited capacity density in majority of cities. The integration of urban wind farm might even deteriorate the situation because of undesired placement. Bridging the gap between insufficient planning and cost-effective operation to enable secure and clean urban power system, therefore, needs to be carefully addressed. A novel load transfer model which adequately utilizes reconfigurable ability of HVDN to facilitate optimally balanced operation via network actions is proposed in this paper. The methodology can provide a resilient operation scheme for HVDN operators to realize the reduction of load and wind power curtailment in the presence of uncertainty. A realistic case study is used to verify the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The research of sampling frequency conversion algorithm for differential protection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As prescribed in IEC60044-8 Standard, the rated values of electronic current transformer output data rate can be 1000Hz, 2400Hz, or 4000Hz (industrial frequency is 50Hz). In intelligent substations, it is necessary to convert different sampling rates to the same one when intelligent electronic devices of transformer differential protection are connected to ECTs with different sampling rates. This paper studies the sampling rate conversion mechanism with cascade connection of decimation and interpolation to realize sampling rate conversion in rational factor, and the impact on differential protection current is also analyzed. To reduce the group delay of high-order finite impulse response (FIR) in sampling rate conversion, a zero-phase filtering algorithm is designed. Combined that with the decimation and interpolation algorithm, the branch current in any different sampling rate can be converted to the same one, and the seamless connection of differential protection and ECT is realized. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the operation speed of differential protection.

articleTitle: Zonal-voltage control for active distribution network based urban energy internet with distributed static syn-chronous compensator and distributed generator
