publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration and grid-connection of large-scale distributed generations (DGs) in active distribution network (ADN) Based Urban Energy Internet brings new challenges and development opportunities to voltage control technologies. In this paper, a layered and staged voltage control frame based on the response rate of voltage control devices was proposed. The investigation focuses on the two-stage zonal-voltage control (TSZVC) scheme based on the coordination between the distributed static synchronous compensator (DSTATCOM) and distributed generator (DG) in the zonal-voltage control layer: in the primary control, only the DSTATCOM compensates the voltage with local infor-mation and the power flows of adjacent lines; in the secondary control, the DSTATCOM shifts part of the reactive power de-mands to DGs, which aims to retain the sustainable voltage com-pensation ability. Finally, simulations in Simulink software envi-ronment verifies that, the TSZVC improves the voltage quality of each point of common coupling (PCC) in the region, avoids the interaction among the voltage control devices.

articleTitle: A hybrid DSSE scheme with different kinds of measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of EI (Energy Internet), the high quality real-time state information will be more important for energy system. This paper proposes a comprehensive distribution system state estimation scheme. This scheme is promising in combining different kinds of measurements together to give real time state aware information with high resolution and a certain precision. In order to complete the requirement of this scheme, both dynamic state estimation method and WLS (Weighted Least Square) based static state estimation method are involved to deal with different measurements. The weight information is also handled subtly. Simulation with IEEE 69-bus system is conducted to show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme. Hopefully by adopting this scheme, the observability can be effectively improved and the period of state estimation can be greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Modeling of generator leading phase ability based on ant colony optimization and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: System operating overvoltage can be controlled through the generator leading phase operation effectively. However, generator leading phase operation is a nonlinear process. This paper presents that modeling of generator leading phase capacity based on ant colony optimization and support vector machine. Ant colony optimization can improve the efficiency of the operation and generalization ability of support vector machine effectively. This paper puts the active and reactive power as the input vectors of the SVM data points, and puts the generators power-angle and system or the stator voltage as the output vectors of the SVM data points. This paper used two generators as instance simulation model which rated power are 10MW and 300MW. The ACO-SVM algorithm has stronger generalization ability through comparative analysis, and ACO-SVM algorithm has the value in engineering.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of micro power
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Micro-grid is a small power grid consisting of micro power, energy storage equipment, control devices and loads. In the resource shortage, environmental problems, power grid security and many other pressures, the concept of micro-grid once put forward quickly by the country's attention, become a hot issue. At the same time, with the gradual deepening of micro-grid research, micro-grid operation and island operation has become an urgent need to solve the problem. In this paper, the dynamic simulation model of photovoltaic power generation, permanent magnet direct drive wind power generation, micro gas turbine, fuel cell and battery is established. The correctness of the simulation model established in this paper is verified, which lays the foundation for the economic optimization of micro-grid by using PSCAD / EMTDC software.

articleTitle: Residential load disaggregation based on resident behavior learning and neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy disaggregation is playing an increasingly important role in energy saving and the management of smart grids. Recently, some machine learning algorithms are applied to energy disaggregation, but the classification performance is not as well as expected. In this paper, a point-to-state energy disaggregation model based on BP Neural Network algorithm is proposed. In addition to considering the traditional electricial characteristics (e.g., current, real power, etc.), time of day that affects energy consumption behavior is investigated and analyzed as a new factor in this paper. The probability density function and K-means clustering algorithm are used to label the data in preprocessing step. A real-world energy data from AMPDs public dataset was used to examine the performance of proposed model. The result shows that the proposed model improve the recognition accuracy of energy disaggregation as well as the estimation accuracy of energy consumption markedly in the low sampling frequency case.

articleTitle: Development of a hydrogen consumption optimization based dynamic penalty control strategy for a PEMFC-LIB-SC hybrid tramway
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To meet the rapid changes in power demand, and more efficient use of PEM fuel cell power supply, the equivalent hydrogen consumption minimization (EHCM) based dynamic penalty control (DPC) strategy was proposed for the modern PEMFC-LIB-SC hybrid tramway. And an effective informed adaptive based particle searching optimization (EIA-PSO) algorithm which is more robust in terms of global search capability and local search precision was utilized to optimize the derived parameter clusters to effectively achieve the optimization of equivalent hydrogen consumption. The results demonstrated that the proposed control strategy could realize the operation stabilization of the overall hybrid power system during the simulated driving cycle. Finally, the comparisons with other control strategies verify that the proposed energy management system can achieve better performance of the overall hybrid tramway.

articleTitle: Technical and economic analysis of clean heating technologies in China
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Heating is an important way for energy subsystems, such as power system, natural gas system and thermal system, to be coupled at the terminal of energy internet. It's also a big issue for energy transformation which related to people's everyday life and need to be further studied. This paper reviews the classifications and developments of common clean heating technologies, analyzes their technical and economic characteristics based on the data of northern China, and gives some suggestions at the end.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal operation of combined cooling, heating and power microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the energy utilization rate and ensure the economic operation of the microgrid, it is necessary to optimize the configuration of the micro-power supply under the conditions of the safety, stability and reliable operation of microgrid. Firstly, take the the daily operation cost, the daily environment cost and the primary energy rate as the goals. An multi-objective optimization model is established for microgrid operation, considering the constraints of energy balances and devices output power. Then, based on the principle of maximum membership, the fuzzy optimization method is used to transform the multi-objective optimization problem into a nonlinear single objective optimization problem. What's more, a new hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed to solve the model. Finally, taking a typical summer day of a district as an example, solve the nonlinear programming model by the algorithm. The optimal outputs of each micro-source in a day are obtained, providing guidances for microgrid economic scheduling. The rationality and practicability of the model and algorithm are verified via analyzing the optimization results.

articleTitle: Analysis of inductive filtering technology based on multi-winding transformer and its typical practical application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transformer inductive filtering technology is a new filtering method through elimination of harmonic flux of transformer's core, which has important practical value and application prospect. To improve the inductive filtering system and expand the application fields, the research of inductive filtering technology based on multi-winding transformer is done in this paper. Firstly, the implementation condition and filtering mechanism of inductive filtering technology based on multi-winding transformer are analyzed; Secondly, the mathematical model and equivalent circuit of multi-winding inductive filtering transformer is calculated; Finally, the practical application of the multi-winding transformer inductive filtering technology in 12-pulse industry rectifier systems is given and the testing results validate the good harmonic suppression effectiveness of multi-winding transformer inductive filtering technology and the correctness of the equivalent circuit.

articleTitle: Current increment based DC differential protection method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large scale application of renewable energy in distribution network generates more challenges for traditional protection methods. Longitudinal differential protection is a common backup protection method of DC system. It adopts measurements at the both ends of the line, and has a good performance in most cases except faults with high grounding resistance. To improve the protection reliability of DC distribution networks, this paper proposes a current increment direction based differential protection method. First, the current characteristics of various DC faults are analyzed. Then, the protection method is descripted. Finally, a DC distribution network is modeled on the platform of MATLAB/Simulink to test the performance of proposed method. Simulation results show the proposed method can operate accurately and be immune to large variations of grounding resistances and disturbances.

articleTitle: Difference analysis of AC tie-line power fluctuation caused by different DC blocking for two-area interconnected power systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Different DC blocking even in the same region will cause different peak values of AC tie-line active power fluctuation. The reason that lead to this phenomenon is discussed in this paper based on the hybrid UHV AC/DC system for North China and Central China interconnected power grid. By deducing time-domain equation of tie-line power is deduced on two-machine equivalent system, the maximum power oscillation equation is modified considering the impact of electromagnetic mutation. It's pointed out that the farther the distance between DC fault and AC tie-line is, the smaller the electromagnetic mutation is, and the greater the peak value of the tie-line fluctuation is. Then the conclusions are respectively verified by using both two-machine four-DC equivalent system and the North China and Central China interconnected power system.

articleTitle: A general modeling approach for the MMC averaged-value model in large-scale DC grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Direct-current (DC) grid based on high-voltage direct-current transmission based upon modular multilevel converter (MMC-HVDC) and overhead lines is an effective solution for the wide-area coordination, complementarity and reliable delivery of the large-scale renewable energy sources, and therefore is an important application direction of VSC-HVDC charactered by high voltage and large capacity in the future. Aiming at the challenges of the applicability of the existing modular multilevel converter (MMC) models, such as the low simulation efficiency and accuracy when do the fault characteristic analysis of overhead lines and coordination between the line protection and control systems in DC gird, a general modeling approach for the MMC AVM (AVM) is proposed. As a result, the MMC AVMs based on half bridge submodule (HBSM), full bridge submodule (FBSM), clamped-double submodule (CDSM), hybrid submodule (HSM) and so on can be quickly built without extra difficulties. At the same time, the problem of low simulation efficiency and accuracy which is not high enough for the large-scale MMCs in DC grid is effectively solved. Finally, the precision and applicability of the MMC AVMs constructed with the help of the general modeling method proposed in this paper is verified by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of building CCHP based on a MINLP model for design and operation strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system is an effective solution to improve energy utilization efficiency and reduce emissions. This paper developed a multi-objective optimization model for CCHP system to evaluate its economic and environmental performances. The optimal capacity and operation strategy in two different scenarios were compared, and a ratio of feed-in tariff to electricity purchasing price was introduced to study the economic performances, which can help the government to make incentive policy on feed-in tariff to promote the development of CCHP system. Six assessment criteria were calculated and compared in different scenarios with various single-objectives. Furthermore, a pareto frontier was used to illustrate the multi-objective optimization. The results showed that the ratio of feed-in tariff to electricity purchasing price need to be at least greater than 0.5 in order to produce more benefits by utilizing CCHP system. Moreover, the weight coefficient of economic factor which is generally in the range of 0.6 to 1 had a significant influence on the capacity of prime mover and carbon dioxide emission of CCHP system.

Author Keywords: combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) system

articleTitle: State-space-method based stable analysis of DC distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Nowadays, with the rapid development of distributed sources and application of renewable energy, systems based on microgrids have been widely used. To connect AC and DC networks, a type of microgrid called Hybrid Microgrid has been introduced thanks to its advantage of decreasing the energy loss compared to classic microgrids. In this paper, a hierarchical control strategy is chosen to regulate the voltage and the active power in the system. Based on this control strategy, an algorithm that deduces the steady-state stability of the DC network is analyzed in detail. With this algorithm, we are able to use certain symbolic variables to characterize different parameters influencing the stability. In the end, a linear radial DC network with one load and two controlled sources model is established in Matlab/Simulink platform to verify the algorithm. The result of the simulations demonstrates that the algorithm deduces the stability of network accurately.

articleTitle: Discussion on risk assessment of energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet is a deep fusion concept consisting of electric power system, electrification transportation system and natural gas system linked by information and communication technology (ICT). It is a new focus in academia and industry. Facing its fast development stage, it is also exposed to greater potential risk. The paper introduces the recent research development status of Energy Internet, and then establishes a new Energy Internet safety risk assessment framework. The framework evaluates the risks of electric power system, electrification transportation system, natural gas system as well as the system cyber security by three-dimensional risk assessment method. It assesses the risk from three dimensions such as adequacy evaluation dimension, probability risk dimension, and the risk source dimension. Since it is still the initial stage of Energy Internet, there remains a lot of basic research to be further developed.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of concentrating solar power generation based on bifurcation theory
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To research the influences of the excitation and steam valve on the stability and the number of equilibrium of electrical system of concentrating solar power(CSP) generation, the bifurcation phenomenon and its influence on the stability are analyzed by the basic principle of bifurcation theory. In this paper, the differential algebraic equations(DAE) for describing the dynamic characters of CSP generation was established firstly. Then, the influence of single parameter and double parameter on the grid stability and stability margin of CSP generation are analyzed in the infinite system by bifurcation theory taking respectively the excitation and valve opening as control parameters. On this basis, a static feedback controller is designed to further improve the system stability. The research results show that the number of equilibrium points and stability will change along with the excitation and steam valve. Stability margin will be increased gradually with the increase of excitation voltage and will be reduced gradually with the increase of steam valve. Moreover, the static feedback can delay bifurcations in a certain range. Thus, the above mentioned researches provide a theoretical basis of the stable operation control of CSP generation.

articleTitle: Optimal dispatching method for power system load response based on operational risk
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional power system dispatching is a mode which is deterministic and does not have the ability of risk perception and control. Considering the power system risk dispatching problem, this paper carries out in-depth study. A load side response model based on risk of power system operating is proposed. Firstly, the operational risk of power system is classified. Under different risk levels, different load side response dispatching strategies are adopted to improve the security of power system. Finally, the standard IEEE 10 machine system is used to verify the advantages of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A research on characteristic of purchasing electricity energy by the energy supply system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The purchasing electricity of the combined cooling, heating and power system is a new load type of the grid company. Based on the operation result of the combined cooling, heating and power system, the characteristics of purchasing electricity of the combined cooling, heating and power system is investigated. it shows that the annual load rates of the purchasing electricity is only about 25% that is more less than 66% that is the annual load rate of the electricity load of end user, and the maximum peal-valley difference is larger than that of the end user's electricity load. The purchase electricity is negative correlation with the end users' load. The new load is obviously different from traditional electric load, new strategies must be need to meet the new type load.

articleTitle: Multivariable uncertainty quantification of transmission line field-to-line coupling based on stochastic collocation method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient statistical method for multivariable uncertainty qualification of transmission line field-to-line coupling. Random multivariable inputs cause uncertain responses at the ports of the transmission line. Both internal variables due to the transmission line geometrical parameters and external variables of the interference electromagnetic field should be taken into account. Stochastic collocation method (SC) allows a fast simulation for the multivariable uncertainty quantification and statistical analysis by polynomial approximation based on the original deterministic calculation. SC method has similar accuracy with Monte-Carlo method and is more efficiency when the dimension of the variables increases.

articleTitle: Research on on-line monitoring and accident inversion scheme of smart substation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the various characteristics of smart substation, such as digitization, integration, low carbon and environmental protection, it has been widely used in recent years. But because of its excessive reliance on the network and communications, many accidents of smart substation secondary system have been occurred. In this paper, an on-line monitoring and accident inversion scheme is proposed, which could be used to judge the health status of the substation before the accident occurs. The research result of this paper can realize the pre-accident warning, accident evaluation, post-accident inversion, and provide the quantitative basis for the whole life cycle management and state maintenance of the secondary equipment.

articleTitle: Node price model considering gas-electricity coupled in day ahead integrated energy market
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The low-carbon energy economy and high efficiencies has increased the concern about the energy system integration and integrated energy market. With the natural gas consumed of the power sector increasing, the natural gas system and electricity system have coupled strongly. In order to realize gas and electricity cleared at same time in a day-ahead market, we proposed a novel node price model for the coupled system. Considering the two markets coupled by gas-fired generations (GFG) and thermal load, we use the heat to build the link model between two markets. The applicability of proposed approach is verified by analyzing the node price of the typical nodes of a 6-bus power system with a gas system coupled at every bus. The result demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed model, which provides a convenient way for market operators to clear integrated energy.

articleTitle: Research on image amplitude acquisition and denoising based on wireless charging positioning system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Located in wireless charging system, the receiver and the transmitter coil accurate alignment is a way to improve transmission efficiency. But the noise in the image acquisition interface will interfere with the acquisition of information, affecting the process of coil alignment in the process of extraction and identification. In this paper, the clustering analysis method is used to compute the set of data points, which is divided into noise set and effective point set by mapping of composite. The data set is orthogonally transformed, polarized, sparsely formed, easy to classify, and remove noise. Experiments show that the classification method has obvious effect, and the noise is removed correctly, and the peak signal to noise ratio is improved by 5% by improving the weight processing method. In this paper, the noise distribution characteristics are analyzed, the sparse expression is realized by orthogonal transform and the noise is removed by iterative mixed weighting.

articleTitle: A new isolation control of three-port active converters for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Three-port active converter which has three full bridge ports can work as a combined charger of an on-board charger and a DC-DC converter in electric vehicles. At the time the on-board charger is working, the DC-DC converter is in isolation state. This paper comes up with an isolation control. In this isolation control, the on-board charger firstly adopts constant current charging to charge main battery. That is to say during the constant current charging state, power transfer from AC side to the main battery while the auxiliary battery is isolated. Power transmission and vector diagram is given to deduce the isolation mathematical equations. Based on the isolation equations, control block diagram is given. The results of simulation are given to verify the effectiveness of this control strategy.

articleTitle: The impact of HVDC links on transmission system collapse
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modern power systems are continually being expanded, are required to carry more power and are being increasingly interconnected. All of these increase the risk of wide area blackout. 2003 North America Blackout and 2006 Europe Blackout demonstrated that a HVDC link provides a `firewall' against the system collapse propagating through a network. However, distance relay response to overload or power swing conditions rather than true line fault which indeed contributing to voltage collapse. The objectives of the paper are to investigate contributions that integrate HVDC interconnection into AC network and the influence that HVDC link would bring to distance relay. The simulation studies were performed using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Research on interacting multiple model selection rule of power load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate load modeling has been a challenging problem of modern power system to be solved. To overcome the time-varying characteristics of power system loads, one of the effective approaches is to employ Interactive Multiple Model algorithm for load modeling. The purpose of this paper is to select a best model set for Interacting Multiple Load Modeling. The process of load model selection involves four steps: model set determination, model set initialization, state estimation and best model set determination. In terms of the errors between the actual system and load models, the Normalized Innovation Square Sum of each model is calculated, thus building the model selection mechanism. The effectiveness of the proposed load model selection rule is validated by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Research on subway energy internet based on power electronic transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a rapid development of urban rail transit, the issues of a great amount of energy consumption, serious carbon emission, noise pollution are increasingly becoming the focus of social attention. Existing subway power supply system is facing a severe challenge which is that the power system needs upgrading to a more intelligent system to adapt to the green transportation and the internet Plus. To solve these problems, a new subway energy Internet (SEI) solution based on power electronic transformer (PET) is proposed in this paper. The communication system and control mode are also descript in detail. Moreover, the advanced applications for SEI are pointed out as well. This solution can further enhance the safety of the subway power supply system, realize “Plug and Play” functions for the energy-saving equipment and distributed generators, change the DC voltage of rectifier system to achieve flexible traction, and control the flow of energy in subway power supply system precisely and quickly.

articleTitle: High performance three phase AC-DC PWM converter with decoupled controller using Matlab/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study is aimed at presenting and developing a standard procedure for design of controlled technology of a high-performance three-phase AC-DC boost pulse width modulation converter. The system consists of the three-phase boost converter (universal bridge) controlled by a decoupled controller. The developed boost converter is used due to its features of two directional power conversion and operation at unity power factor. To control the DC output voltage, voltage oriented control technique with the decoupled controller has been used. MATLAB/SIMULINK is used to simulate the complete system. The output DC voltage, active and reactive power are obtained. The comparison results show that the new model is a more promising candidate in high-performance converters, which can be used in many different power electronic converter application.

articleTitle: Research of a new type of STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High efficiency and energy saving smart grid is the trend of electric power development. For this purpose, this paper puts forward a research on T three level D-STATCOM based on the problem of large number of diode clamped three level D-STATCOM devices and large switching losses. Compared with the conventional three level inverter, the T type three level inverter has the advantages of few devices, low running loss and uniform loss distribution. The application of T type three level inverter in D-STATCOM will improve the performance of D-STATCOM to a certain extent. In this paper, firstly, the topology and performance of T three level inverter are analyzed based on the principle and topology of the traditional NPC three level inverter. The superiority of T three level inverter is proved. Then, the D-STATCOM model based on T three level inverter is built. By using hysteresis control method, the compensation effect of D-STATCOM under three modes of fixed reactive power compensation, dynamic switching and load sudden change is simulated and analyzed. The working characteristics of D-STATCOM based on T three level inverter are verified.

articleTitle: Regulate reserve optimal clearing model adapted to Chinese interim electricity market
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The regulate reserve marketization reform has become the development direction of power industry. In Chinese interim electricity market period, the clearing model of regulate reserve need adapted to the market environment. Based on the market condition of Chinese power industry and the physical characteristics of regulate services resource, a regulate services market clearing mechanism considering the restriction of energy operation is proposed, and a detailed optimization model of regulate services is established. The example analysis shows that this method can realize the optimal clearing of independent regulate services market and the clearing results meet the physical feasibility.

articleTitle: A double objective coordination control method for voltage of distribution network considering the capability from distributed energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The intermittent distributed generation (DG) has strong volatility and randomness. The DGs are usually connected to the end of the weak distribution network, which causes a weak electrical connection between the source and network. The random power output of DGs usually leads to voltage fluctuations. In order to solve this problem, a double objective coordination control method for voltage of distribution network considering the capability from distributed energy system (DES) is proposed. Based on the operation characteristics of DES, the terminal voltage fluctuations of the upstream distribution system are solved by using the interactive capability from the DES. Simulation results show that, the proposed method not only can reduce the voltage fluctuations of distribution network, but also reduce the operation cost of DES.

articleTitle: A composite estimation method for state of charge of batteries in a power station engineering
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An energy storage power station combines with photovoltaic system, and the main role of power station are following time-of-use power price and smoothing photovoltaic power fluctuations. The energy storage batteries are the main part of the power station engineering. And the important parameters of batteries are voltage, current, temperature, state of charge (SOC) and so on. Among this parameters, the SOC is the most important parameter. This paper uses a composite method to estimate the SOC, which is the Extended Kalman estimation method combine the Ah integral and the Open Circuit Voltage method. And it finally verifies that this composite algorithm has a high accuracy, and the error within 6% in a power station engineering.

articleTitle: State maintenance decision of secondary equipment of distribution automation based on neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy Internet, smart grid and its automation needs more precise maintenance. The maintenance mode of the distribution automation equipment has been changed from the traditional plan maintenance to the state maintenance. The state monitoring technology is used to evaluate the secondary equipment health status by analyzing the factors influencing the secondary equipment status of the distribution automation system. Based on the neural network algorithm, the state maintenance decision method of the secondary equipment of the distribution automation is carried out according to the evaluation results of the secondary equipment state, and then the reasonable maintenance mode is selected. In the case study, it is proved that the maintenance decision model based on the neural network algorithm is feasible and efficient by comparing with the fuzzy theory evaluation method, which provides a good decision basis for the conditional maintenance of the secondary equipment of the distribution automation.

articleTitle: An improved buck-boost converter based on pulse sequence control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Buck-Boost converters can achieve step-up and step-down easily and have been widely used in many applications because of the simple topology, easy control and can input current continuously, etc. Meanwhile, the conventional pulse width modulation (PWM) control method owns excellent steady state performance, but it cannot avoid slow transient response and difficult compensation network design. Thus, this paper combines an improved topology and a simple pulse sequence (PS) control technique to improve the performance of the system from the following three aspects. First, PS instead of PWM control technique is applied to improve the dynamic response and avoid the compensation link. Second, an improved Buck-Boost converter is put forward to effectively inhibit the low-frequency fluctuation of the PS control method when the inductor is operating in continuous conduction mode (CCM). Third, the proposed converter can achieve current sharing and reduce the energy loss of the inductor. In addition, there is almost no increase for the cost and volume. The simulation results are provided to verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Key technology and application of energy measurement data security
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy measurement data are the basic data sources of perceiving smart city and realizing energy conservation and emission reduction. The promotion and application of big data, cloud computing, Internet of things (IoT) and mobile Internet technology drive the rapid development of energy measurement, and it also brings serious challenges for the security of measurement data. The paper introduces the structure of the energy measurement data system and analyzes the current situation and application demands for the system at home and abroad. It focuses on the basic and forward-looking technologies necessary for future energy measurement development, such as the new-generation cryptographic technology, private information protection in energy information network environments, the distribution and application mode of quantum key, secure communication protocol, big data access control, information sharing and fusion, and mass data processing, analyzing and application. The application of all these key technologies in China can provide the basic scientific basis for developing the top-level design and deepening applications of the energy measurement system.

articleTitle: Research and application of interactive control technology of source and load in photovoltaic village
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power consumption of Photovoltaic village is studied, and the home energy management system is established in the paper. Followed by user agreement, according to intelligent monitoring terminal collection of photovoltaic realtime output information, make the automatic intelligent load scheduling and management, transfer load and give priority to local consumption photovoltaic power. Peak load shifting and valley filling are adopted to improve efficiency of power generation equipment, to improve the safety margin of distribution network, and to reduce the influence of intermittent and fluctuation of distributed PV on distribution network.

Author Keywords: Peak load shifting and valley filling

articleTitle: Cyber-physical joint simulation on small interference stability of power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the delay in communication process of Wide Area Measurement System (WAMS), the control effect of damping controller with wide-area signal will be affected, which thereby will have an influence on the small signal stability of electric system. Based on communication simulation tool OPNET and combining power system simulation tool MATLAB, this paper builds Cyber-Physical joint simulation platform of power network, and makes simulation study on the small signal stability of electric system, putting forward the method of stimulating random delay in reality by normal distribution of delay. Finally, the proposed method is proved to be correct and effective through two-area four-machine system stimulation.

articleTitle: Apache spark based urban load data analysis and forecasting technology research
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the complexity of data analysis caused by increasing urban load data, an Apache Spark based urban load analysis and forecasting technology is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the large-scale data processing platform is designed. Secondly, statistics of urban load data are processed by transformation and action in the form of resilient distributed datasets (RDDs). Thirdly, load forecasting model based on Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN) is built for short-term urban load forecasting. GraphX is used for graph-parallel computation. Finally, the result of load analysis is presented and forecasting results of DBN are compared with other models. The comparison outcome shows that the DBN model implemented in Spark has better accuracy in load forecasting.

articleTitle: Transmission expansion planning with wind generation considering TCSC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind energy plays an important role in achieving energy sustainability and low-carbon future. Large penetration of wind energy challenges existing transmission network, due to the intermittency and uncertainty of wind. Transmission systems need upgrades to satisfy the operation and reliable requirements of power systems with wind generation. In this paper, a novel transmission expansion planning (TEP) model considering the allocation of thyristor controlled series compensators (TCSC) is proposed to find the optimal planning scheme which minimizes the annualized investment costs and the operational costs. The planning problem is modeled as a mixed integer nonlinear programming problem with ac power flow constraints and reliability constraints. Stochastic models solve the uncertainties in wind energy output, power demand growth, etc. lines and generators failure rates, etc. Expected energy not supplied (EENS) are combined with probabilistic failure rates of system elements and contingency screening to ensure the system security and reliability. According to the numerical results on IEEE 14-bus system, the proposed model proves the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of distribution network considering network attack
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of power and information technology, the impact of network attacks on the power infrastructure has gradually become a hot issue at home and abroad. In order to measure the risk caused by network attack to power facilities, this paper proposes a risk assessment model for distribution network considering network attack. In this paper, firstly, the definition of attack object, network attack pattern and attack consequence are defined. Secondly, the risk assessment index of distribution network is put forward. And then, Monte Carlo method is used to simulate the network attack scene, that is, attack the elements in the target component set with a certain probability. Finally, the risk index of distribution network is calculated by the proposed evaluation model, and the risk assessment of distribution network is completed. The proposed model can deeply reveal the security level of power grid under network attack. The validity and feasibility of the proposed method are verified by an example of IEEE-33 node distribution system.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of DVR system for strong unbalanced voltage suppression
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For three-phase instantaneous voltage dip amplitude difference problem, a method using each independent structure of H full bridge converter circuit. Introduces the main circuit topology of the method, and the principle of the DVR system, the control strategy and the corresponding simulation results; through the experimental results show that the method is effective to solve the problem of strong unbalanced voltage suppression, and also pointed out its advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: The impact of political emergencies on global oil price
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Global Energy Internet has complex dynamic characteristics which are influenced by the international politics, economy and energy patterns and other factors. Political emergencies affect the trend of global oil price, which furthermore, influences global energy consumption and electric power distribution. This paper adopts econometric method to study the impact of political emergencies on global oil price. It describes the political emergencies with dummy variables and establishes the total intervention model with time series analysis method and intervention analysis method. Based on the proposed method, impact of political emergencies on global oil price is studied with typical cases such as Gulf War and 911 Event. This paper is aimed to guide the analysis of macroscopic characteristics of Global Energy Internet.

articleTitle: Parallel computing based distribution network reliability evaluation technology research
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of social economy and the expansion of distribution network scale, the demand of power supply reliability is gradually improving. However, the traditional reliability analysis of distribution network power supply is more suitable for the simplified small-scale system, which is difficult to meet the reliability calculation task of large-scale distribution network in the data age. In this paper, an analysis method based on Spark parallel computing platform is proposed, and the system reliability analysis is relied on Map-Reduce. Firstly, hash mapping the network topology data to determine every element's connection. Then the minimum cut-sets is determined by depth first search of each load point by Map-Reduce, and the reliability index is calculated according to the series parallel relationship of the components. On this basis, correcting the reliability index of the system by considering the influence of standby power supply and distribution automation equipment in network. Finally, the reliability of 10kV distribution network in a certain area is realized on the Spark platform, and the calculation speed and accuracy of the algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Capacity allocation of hybrid energy storage system based on VMD-GRGC ensemble methods
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The hybrid energy storage system (HESS) consists of energy storage and power storage, is an effective solution to smooth the fluctuation of wind power. This paper proposed a means using variational mode decomposition (VMD) and grey relational grades cluster (GRGC) to obtain power and capacity allocation of HESS. First, moving average filtering was used to obtain the grid connected power and the reference power of HESS. The reference power of HESS was decomposed into subsequences by means of VMD, and the GRGC is used to reconstruct the subsequences into low frequency and high frequency components. Then the low frequency and high frequency components are used as power instructions for energy storage and power storage respectively. Considering the state of charge (SOC) and operating life of HESS, establish the annual minimum cost model. The results verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The novel droop control strategy for low voltage microgrid without matching line impedance
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the independent operation of the AC low-voltage microgrid, differences can be existed in the state of charge (SOC) of parallel batteries because of the unmatched line impedance, which leads to the over-discharge of energy storage batteries and reduce the energy storage unit life. Therefore, an improved droop control strategy is proposed to consider the energy storage system with unmatched line impedance. Firstly, the dynamic virtual impedance is used to eliminate the influence of the line impedance. At the same time, the SOC index is reduced by the e-index droop, which reduces the impact of the error convergence process on the system. Finally, the control strategy is simulated by Matlab/Simulink, and the correctness and validity of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Active distribution network secondary coordinated voltage control based on multi-objective linear programming
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distribution network with a large number of distributed generator (DG) puts forward higher requirements for coordinated control of voltage / reactive power. Secondary voltage control is an effective method to improve distribution network voltage level under the condition of high permeable DG. Based on the basic principle of the secondary voltage control, multi-objective linear programming method is used to solve the contradiction between the safety and the economy of the distribution network, and the optimization goal construction, control strategy selection and control process realization are introduced respectively. The simulation results show that the voltage stability of the distribution network with high permeable DG can be solved by the secondary voltage control based on the multi — objective programming.

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization for distribution network based on serial and parallel iterative modes of alternating direction method of multipliers
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: We formulate the control of reactive power generation by reactive compensation capacitors in power distribution network (DN) as a constrained optimization problem that aims to minimize power losses and improve voltage profiles subject to finite capacitor capacity and upper and lower bus voltage limits. The objective function is separable enabling a distributed online implementation with node-local computations using only local measurements augmented with limited information from the neighboring buses communicated over cyber channels. A distributed approach based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is developed to realize the distributed reactive power optimization among capacitors. A serial iterative mode of ADMM based on Gauss-Seidel and a parallel iterative mode of ADMM based on Proximal Jacobian are applied respectively and the differences between the two modes in communication efficiency are discussed. Simulation studies with the modified IEEE 69-bus distribution system demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed optimization solution.

articleTitle: Decentralized operation of integrated heat-power energy systems: A market equilibrium based approach
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combined heat and power system has become a hot topic recently because of the complementarity of electric and heat power. This paper considers the interconnected power distribution network(PDN) and district heating network(DHN) through CHP units and heat pumps. Firstly, the optimal thermal flow(OTF) problem of DHN and optimal power flow(OPF) problem of PDN are formulated considering the detailed network parameters. Based on these, a market model is proposed considering the decentralized operation of power and heating systems, and the model is an interactive optimization problem, i.e., a game. Hence, an iterative algorithm is developed to solve the market model and find the market equilibrium between the two networks. Such a framework offers an opportunity to operate the PDN and DHN in a decentralized manner. The simulation results demonstrate the potential benefits of the proposed market model in terms of wind power utilization and operation economy.

articleTitle: A two-stage chance constrained programming for economic dispatch with recovery cost
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To increase the operational efficiency of power systems with high penetration of renewable energy sources, a two stage economic dispatch (ED) is proposed based on two stage chance constrained programing (TSCCP). In the first stage, the set-points and reserve capacities are optimized to minimize the operational cost. In the second stage, the real-time outputs of generators are adjusted to minimize the recourse cost. In addition, a recovery problem is proposed when the second stage problem is infeasible. By adopting the sample average approximation method, the TSCCP is reformulated to a convex mixed integer quadratic programming, which is solved by commercial software packages. Simulation results very the effectiveness of the proposed method. By introducing the recovery cost in the second stage ED, the operational efficiency can be improved.

articleTitle: Study on the evaluation index for the strength of different structural forms of AC/DC system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of the global energy Internet, the power grid interconnection across regions and countries needs long distance and large capacity power transmission. UHVAC or UHVDC is the main transmission technology. Reference to China's domestic operation experience, with the rapid development of electric power system, large capacity UHVDC construction faster and faster, if the construction of AC system is relatively lagging behind, there will be a “strong DC with weak AC” problem. Through the study, we view from the grid planning point, optimize the power grid structure to solve the problem. In this paper, based on the analysis of the interaction mechanism of AC and DC in different structural forms and the classification of safety and stability of power grid, puts forward three types of indicators for power grid strength evaluation. And through the actual grid example, the correctness of the proposed evaluation index system is verified, which provides a strong guarantee for the planning and development of power grid.

articleTitle: Review on cyber vulnerabilities of communication protocols in industrial control systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the progress of the energy system integration, industrial control system (ICS) plays a more significant role in monitoring and controlling critical infrastructures. The main function of ICS is to gather real-time data, realize device automation, and supervise the system. To achieve this goal, a number of communication protocols have been designed. However, deficiencies of protocol implementation can bring in unintentional risks. In this paper, communication protocols used in ICS are reviewed and analyzed such as DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, IEC 61400-25 as well as IEEE C37.118. Then, we present a taxonomy on cyber vulnerabilities of the protocols, along with several typical attacks and countermeasures.

articleTitle: Frontiers of DC circuit breakers in HVDC and MVDC systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of power electronics is driving high voltage (HV) and medium voltage (MV) applications based on dc technologies for power transmission and distribution, renewable energy integration, and ship and railway systems. DC circuit breakers (DCCBs) are needed to protect and improve the performance of dc or hybrid ac/dc systems during severe fault and/or abnormal operating conditions. This paper reviews the state-of-the-art of DCCBs for both HV and MV DC systems. The mechanisms and requirements of DCCBs are summarized. Various DCCB topologies and their merits and demerits are presented and critically reviewed. Future trends and requirements for DCCBs are described. This work is intended to provide a useful point of reference for this technology and to contribute to its future development.

articleTitle: An open solution for next-generation real-time power system simulation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The interconnection of power systems in conjunction with faster dynamics, caused by power electronics, increases the complexity of power system simulations for future grids. We propose an open platform as a solution which supports several important features. Grid models are stored in the Common Information Model (CIM) and the platform presents a uniform interface to several commercial and non-commercial Digital Real-time Simulator (DRTS) which can be used in parallel for co-simulation. A web-based interface is used to promote collaboration between research groups during planning and execution of simulation scenarios. Besides, this solution is designed for real-time simulation which allows the integration and testing of hardware components. Several components of the proposed platform have already been used for experiments and are available as open-source.

articleTitle: Dynamic control of MVDC link embedded in distribution network: — Case study on ANGLE-DC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution network operators are encountering varied challenges through restricted corridors for expansion, fault-level constrained by capacity increase, increased pressure on operational efficiency, and proliferation of distributed energy resources (DERs). This will in effect impose limitations in power-flow and voltage. Moreover, due to the vast installation of converter based DERs like photovoltaic, electric vehicles, an efficient approach is to minimize the AC to DC conversion so as to reduce the losses by enabling DC technologies in the distribution networks. To this end, this paper assess the performance of a 33 kV distribution network with a proposed medium voltage DC (MVDC) link between the island of Anglesey and the mainland in North Wales, UK. This project will be the first of its kind in Europe and will paves the way for a more integrated DC network for the future. Dynamic operation and control of the proposed MVDC link is tested through PSCAD/EMTDC simulations. Operation of the DC link under steady state and during a single-line-to-ground (SLG) fault was tested. Moreover, a dual control loop has been implemented to improve the operation of the proposed link under SLG fault.

articleTitle: Study on the method of transmission line foreign body detection based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Target detection methods based on region proposal are complicated and the detection speed is slow, which is difficult to meet the requirement of real-time detection of massive power inspection pictures. SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector) is simpler than the one that requires region proposal, eliminates the generation of proposals and subsequent feature resampling phases, and encapsulates all calculations in a single network. The model is more easily trained while meeting the high accuracy and real-time detection requirements. In this paper, we described the SSD method in detail, compared and analyzed the DPM (Deformable Parts Model), Faster R-CNN and SSD methods. The three methods are tested and verified by using the actual data set of transmission line foreign body, and the influence of different parameters on the identification results is discussed. The experimental results show that the SSD method can achieve 85.2% of the mAP(mean average precision) at 26FPS (GTX1050Ti), it can meet the real-time requirements while ensuring the accuracy of detection, and the feasibility of the recognition method based on deep learning is verified in real time foreign body detection of transmission line.

articleTitle: Selection of the rated frequency for fractional frequency offshore wind power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Nowadays the exploitation and utilization of the offshore wind power has won global attention. The application of fractional frequency transmission system (FFTS) in the integration of offshore wind power forms fractional frequency offshore wind power system (FFOWPS), which provides an efficient solution for large-scale offshore wind power integration. To achieve the standardized production of transmission equipment and boost the economies of scale equipment manufacturing, FFOWPS is supposed to operate at its own rated frequency, like traditional AC transmission system. Taking all the factors such as the influence of frequency on critical equipment in the system, operating experience of low frequency system from home and abroad, economic efficiency and technicality into account, this paper puts forward 50/3 Hz as the rated frequency of FFOWPS. Then an offshore wind farm case is analyzed to compare the transmission capacity of the cable and the voltage fluctuation of the integration point at 50 Hz and 50/3 Hz. The result shows that the technical performance of 50/3 Hz is much superior to that of 50 Hz. Even without shunt reactor, FFOWPS with 50/3 Hz as the rated frequency can transmit 467.6MW wind power to a distance of 364.2 km. Besides, the voltage fluctuation of integration point in the system can also meet the relevant regulations.

articleTitle: Multi-objective planning of charging stations considering vehicle arrival hot map
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Charging stations are basic infrastructure for electric vehicles, of which the siting and capacity have a great impact on promoting electric vehicles. This paper proposed an optimal charging station planning method, which can comprehensively consider the public service infrastructure, the cost of the construction of charging stations and integration to distribution network, and influence of distributed generation. First, according to the actually measured vehicle arrival hot map data, the charging load estimation model was built; second, aimed at minimizing load distance, minimizing the cost of the charging station' construction and integration to distribution network, maximizing DG installed capacity, the multi-objective planning model is introduced, in which the actual operation constraints of distribution network is considered. Then based on Voronoi method, NSGA-II was adopted to solve the model to obtain the Pareto frontier and the results are sorted by TOPSIS. Finally, the method proposed in this paper was demonstrated through a test case.

articleTitle: Review and application of situation awareness key technologies for smart grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Smart grid situation awareness technology is a monitoring system composed of advanced monitoring equipment, which can be more intuitive and predictable in the control of power grid. With the deploy of underlying measurement and communication system for smart grids, it is feasible to carry out the research of comprehensive functions of smart grids. As a novel data synthesizing and analyzing technology, situation awareness will show advantages in the implementation of smart grids. In this paper, the connotation and state-of-the-art development of situation awareness technology is analyzed deeply, and the developing direction of applying situation awareness into smart grids and key technologies needed are identified explicitly. The possible examples of applying situation awareness into power system smart scheduling are given. At last, on the base of analysis of fundamental theory research of future smart grid situation awareness, typical applications of it in the operation and control of smart grid are proposed.

articleTitle: A new method for planning of stand-alone hybrid PV/WT/BESS/diesel microgrids considering DR based on DARTP
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Stand-alone microgrids play an important role in solving power supply problems in remote areas that are not connected to the grid. Optimal planning, which is the most important issue that need to be resolved in the design stage, directly determines the economic and security benefits of microgrids. To achieve greater economic benefits for stand-alone microgrids that comprise diesel generators, wind turbine generation systems, photovoltaic generation systems and battery energy storage systems, this paper presents an optimal planning method that considers the day-ahead real-time pricing demand response (DARTP-DR). First, an optimization model that includes the DARTP-DR is established based on a price elasticity matrix. Next, a combinatorial solution algorithm that combines the genetic algorithm with pattern search is introduced to solve the model. The proposed optimal planning method is applied to a real case study, and the results show that considering the DARTP-DR in the optimal planning considerably reduces the lifetime cost of stand-alone microgrids.

articleTitle: Communications in distributed smart grid control: Software-defined vs. legacy networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To deal with the challenges of increasingly fluctuating power flows in future energy systems, distributed control using a Multi-Agent System (MAS) is considered a promising solution. However, these agents require appropriate Information and Communication Technology (ICT) infrastructures to coordinate their actions. Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is a novel approach for dynamic and flexible configuration of communication networks, which enables integration of reliability and security enhancing measures, while optimizing network load and cost efficiency. In this work, the concept of SDN and traditional networking are compared regarding their applicability for establishing distributed power grid control. In particular, we discuss the aspects of security, reliability, transmission paradigms, topology detection and configuration effort. Using a typical transmission grid scenario, derived from the well-established New England Test System (NETS), we demonstrate the capabilities of SDN to improve significantly on the reliability of MAS communications, while incurring minimal administration overhead. Overall, our study indicates clear benefits of applying SDN for distributed power grid control.

articleTitle: Flexibility evaluation of distribution network with high penetration of variable generations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to adapt requirements of accessing high penetration of renewable energy resources and meet dynamic energy balance of system in condition with strong uncertainty, it is necessary to evaluate and enhance the operational flexibility of the distribution network. A flexibility evaluation method aimed to system regulation requirements is proposed to quantitatively evaluate operational flexibility of a distribution network with high proportion of variable generations. Firstly, the operational characteristics of flexible resources are estimated based on statistical analysis of network parameters and operating data, and the time scale of evaluation is fixed according to response time of flexible resource. Then the bi-directional flexibility adjustment requirements are separated and the double-layer index system is constructed. Based on the Monte Carlo simulation algorithm and the optimal economic scheduling model, the flexibility index calculation method is proposed. At last, the evaluation result is obtained by using calculated objective weight, and the IEEE 33 node distribution network is used as the reference grid to analyze the case. This method could evaluate the flexibility of distribution network from the aspects of tolerable fluctuation ability, renewable energy consumption capacity, energy balance ability and power regulation ability. The result shows that the proposed method is scientific and reasonable, which can be used for providing reference and guidance for planning and operation of distribution network.

articleTitle: An interval based cost-emissions optimization strategy for gas-electricity integrated energy systems under uncertainty and demand response
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The natural gas network and the electricity network are tightly integrated in popular Energy Internet frameworks. This paper focuses on an operation strategy to optimize the operating cost and the emissions of gas-electricity integrated energy systems (GEIES). The wind power, pumped storage station and demand response are considered as key influence factors in the strategy. The strategy is based on interval optimization. In the presented strategy, the model of gas network and the electricity network are established, the operating cost models, emissions models and operation constrains, especially. The pumped storage station and the incentive demand response are integrated into the optimization model to optimize operational performances of GEIES. Moreover, the interval mathematics is introduced to address wind power uncertainty. Detailed experiment results demonstrate that the proposed strategy is a feasible way to reduce the operating cost and the emissions of GEIES.

articleTitle: Probabilistic power and gas flow analysis for electricity-gas coupled networks considering uncertainties in pipeline parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing probabilistic power and gas flow (PPGF) analysis for electricity-gas coupled networks (EGCN) mainly focus on the uncertainties of nodal injected power, such as wind power, electricity/gas loads. Variations of pipeline parameters and their effects on PPGF are not studied so far. Therefore, a PPGF model considering the uncertainties and correlations of the wind power, electricity/gas loads and pipeline parameters is proposed in this paper. Both normal and uniform distributions are adopted to model the uncertainties in pipeline parameters, and a probabilistic method based on Latin hypercube sampling (LHS) and Nataf transformation is developed to solve the PPGF problem. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by a set of test results with an EGCN composed of the IEEE-33 bus system and a 11-node gas network.

articleTitle: Review on interdependency modeling of integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy system is an important strategic measure to break the lack of coordination of the energy systems, whose core feature is the interdependency between the various systems. In this paper, interdependency of integrated energy systems is presented with details. Independency modeling methods, i.e., energy hub/input-output based method, energy-network based method, agent-based method, complex network method and system dynamics based method are introduced.

articleTitle: Multi-scale transient modeling and real-time simulation of AC/DC power grid with multi-terminal VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A novel method of modeling electromechanical and electromagnetic transients within the same study is presented. It uses the shifted frequency (SF) method which applies the Hilbert transform and frequency shifting to move out the fundamental frequency for a larger time-step size. Based on the real-time simulator RT-LAB, a multi-scale model of hybrid HVDC/AC power system is established, and then real-time multi-scale transient simulations are performed. The simulation results of one-terminal of HVDC grid are compared with that obtained from detailed model in PSCAD/EMTDC. In a further step, a modified IEEE 39-bus system with five-terminal MTDC is employed to simulate diverse transients such as interaction between AC and MTDC systems. Through the comparison and analysis, the effectiveness of the multi-scale modeling and simulation using the RT-LAB is verified.

articleTitle: Short-term photovoltaic output forecasting based on correlation of meteorological data
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A short-term load forecasting method of photovoltaic (PV) output based on weak correlation between meteorological date and PV output is proposed. The Pearson correlation coefficient method is used to make out the main affecting factor of PV output. Fuzzy clustering analysis method is used to attain similar days and then support vector regression (SVR) forecasting model with excellent learning ability for small sample is established. And then a two-stage parameter-determining method is carried out. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of multi energy-type coordinated microgrid considering user satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy management is the basis of multi energy-type coordinated microgrid operation, and optimization algorithm is the core of energy management system. In this paper, the trading model and optimization algorithm of solving the dynamic trade between multi energy-type coordinated microgrid and users are proposed. The dynamic trading model between the microgrid and users is established, which considers the fluctuation of electricity prices and user satisfaction, and then the solution process is proposed. Users adjust the power consumption strategy in the trade, and the microgrid adjusts the TOU (Time-of-Use) prices according to users' load and optimizes the electrical load, cooling load and heating load. Based on the typical daily loads of a community, an iterative searching algorithm is used to solve the trading model. The results show that the optimal TOU electricity pricing strategy obtained by the proposed model can decrease the peak-valley difference and the microgrid has better consumption capacity of renewable energy and obtain better economic benefits, and users have a better experience of using energy and achieve the optimal economy. The proposed model and conclusions in this paper could be applied in many other situations, which provide theoretical basis for the development and planning of microgrid.

articleTitle: Research on and application of coordinated control technology of active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Active distribution network is a development mode of future distribution network and a new power distribution system adapting to the active control and management development trend of distribution network. Therefore, this network can effectively cope with large-scale and high-permeability grid connection of distributed energy resource. The Comprehensive Demonstration Project of Active Distribution Network in Suzhou is an engineering practice of active distribution network technology application. This paper describes overview and implementation plan of the demonstration project and explains with emphasis the key technologies for coordinated control of the active distribution network from such aspects as situation awareness, flexible DC, and coordinated control of power grid, power source and load. Through construction of the demonstration project, it is able to realize flexible absorption of high proportional and distributed energy resource in the demonstration zone, intelligent allocation of high-quality electric energy, coordinated and optimized control of multiple resources from power grid, power source, load and stored energy. In addition, a new DC power supply mode has been explored and developed for the distribution network, providing a reference and example for in-depth development and engineering practice of the active distribution network.

articleTitle: A fast method for identifying bad data of massive power network data
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new fast and bad data detection and identification technology and model as the research goal, to achieve fast and accurate and efficient data detection and identification. This paper analyzes the influence of single, multiple and multi-correlation bad data on the state estimation results in the actual power grid. Based on the characteristics of its influence and the research status of the bad data detection and identification methods at home and abroad, according to the characteristics of the bad data distribution, The object of the power grid rapid partition method, and further proposed two-layer fine bad data detection and identification model and rapid solution method.

articleTitle: Smart dispatch system for integrated energy systems with demand response
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy systems (IESs) are the physical carriers of energy internet, and have many synergy benefits. Industrial consumes most of the energy in China, so there is much space for energy saving and system optimization. Many big factories in an industrial park have small energy systems and can take part in demand response. Renewable energy is usually installed in IESs, which brings much uncertainty. To deal with above challenges, a smart dispatch system is developed. This smart dispatch system deals with different energy forms, such as electricity, heating and cooling, and enables demand response. The smart dispatch system has a hierarchical framework. It consists of several modules, including situation awareness, risk assessment, optimization, virtual power plant, and demand response. Each module interacts with each other to achieve goals of the smart dispatch system. Case studies show that demand response can improve the integration of renewable energy.

articleTitle: A new customer-side demand response strategy in block bidding markets
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Customer-side demand response can effectively improve load curve and realize peak shaving in the field of energy consumption. This paper proposes a new customer-side demand response strategy in block bidding markets. For the case of a short load segment has to bear the high cost of power generation, customers' loads which take part in demand response is classified into shiftable loads and detachable loads, and an optimization model of load demands combination is proposed. To solve the problem, a modified Genetic Algorithm is used. The strategy is applied to an actual case. The simulation results show that the combination of load blocks can greatly reduce the purchase price of electricity and verify the efficiency of our proposed strategy.
