articleTitle: Study on total supply capability of integrated energy system with stochastic chance constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Total supply capability (TSC) reflects the safety and economy of power system operation. Integrated energy system (IES) is composed of natural gas system (NGS) and electricity power system (EPS), which can make full use of energy, improve energy efficiency, and promote consumption of local renewable energy, and improve the TSC. With the increase of distributed generation permeability, the uncertain output improves the uncertainty of IES operation. To this end, the TSC of IES with stochastic chance constraints model is established based on locating and sizing of gas stations. The model takes into account the main transformer N-1 and feeder N-1 constraints, the natural gas station and its pipeline flow supply constraints, the node power constraints of electricity, natural gas interconnection and the cost factor of different zones. Case study is used to calculate the TSC and the investment cost of gas station under different outputs. The result shows that the distributed power supply can effectively improve the total supply capacity of the IES. That verifies the feasibility and applicability of the model.

articleTitle: Voltage stability control for DC microgrid with energy storage
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to maintain the bus voltage stability of isolated DC microgrid, it is necessary to configure the energy storage system (ESS) to realize the balance of energy supply and demand. When there are multiple energy storage units (ESUs) in the dc microgrid, the overcharge or over discharge is avoided. Therefore, a new adaptive droop control is proposed according to the state of charge (SOC). Once the ESS is out of work due to fault or fully charged, the renewable energy source needs to switch from the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) mode to the droop control mode. Meanwhile, the demand side power is distributed automatically by renewable energy source according to its maximum output power, which can assure the bus voltage stability. The proposed strategy can be verified through real time digital simulator (RTDS) in an isolated DC microgrid.

articleTitle: A planning method for integrated energy station of energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To realize the rational planning of integrated energy stations, this paper introduce a planning method for integrated energy station which based on multiple energy system's basic planning. This planning method contains the approach which based on C-means algorithm for forecasting users' daily energy load, the approach which based on Voronoi diagram for locating new multiple power stations and the planning model which aims to reduce the annual cost (includs the costs of equipments, operation, maintenance and fuels) of the power stations for power stations' planning. The steps of locating and station planning are all included in this method. This paper solves the model with actual data. By comparing the planning results, the feasibility of the method and the economy of the integrated energy system are verified.

articleTitle: Gas and solid insulation in HVDC gas insulated switchgear
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of high voltage directly current (DC) transmission technique, DC gas insulated switchgear (GIS) is attracting more and more attentions. DC GIS has the advantages of compact size, high reliability and interchangeability. Compared with alternating current (AC), the electric field distribution of the DC GIS insulation system depends on the conductivity of the dielectric. In the insulation system, the electric field from the capacitive into resistance at the same time, the charge at the interface of gas-solid interface accumulation and change the original electric field, resulting in its flashover characteristics along the surface decreased and hence restricts the application of dc GIS in engineering. This contribution presents a numerical model that is appropriate for the calculation of field distributions and surface charge accumulation on solid insulation in a DC GIS. The model studies the charge transport process in the gas and solid insulation. Based on the model, the influence of gas ion pair generation rate, bulk and surface conductivity of solid insulation on the polarity and distribution of surface charge. This study will help improve the insulation design of the DC GIS by reducing the critical area electric field and minimizing the surface charge accumulation to optimize the geometry and material properties of the insulator and verify the changes of design.

articleTitle: Reliability prediction of distribution system based on rough set theory and neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the growing scale of power distribution system, the network frame structure is increasingly complex, and the traditional reliability prediction methods are faced with different degrees of limitations. The application of the big data technology has provided a new way to solve this problem. This paper proposes a reliability prediction method of distribution network based on rough set theory and neural network. First, according to the correlation analysis method based on rough set theory, the correlation index of information entropy was established to extract the strong correlation factors as input to the prediction model. The correlation index of information entropy is established, to extract the strong correlation factors as input to the prediction model. Then the neural network is trained by historical data samples to obtain prediction model, and the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the initial weight and threshold of neural network, in order to improve the convergence speed of neural network and realize a rapid prediction of distribution system reliability. Finally, taking Beijing yearbook data as an example to verify the method, and the results show that the method is effective and operable.

articleTitle: Research on multi-scene investment sensitivity of zone energy system under opened incremental distribution market
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the environment of electricity market reform, the zone power grid is one of the main objects of orderly open distribution network business. Providing integrated energy supply services for power users based on the urban energy system will greatly improve the market competitiveness of the power grid company. In this paper, business model of zone power grid is studied, which is applicable to different market stages and various distribution networks. The investment sensitivity analysis is carried out for multi-scene planning of incremental distribution business. The investment strategy of the zone energy system is proposed based on power internet theory.

articleTitle: Distributed optimization-based power trade strategy for we-energy in energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A novel distributed power trade strategy is proposed to address the pricing problem for we-energy-based energy internet, considering the psychological fluctuation caused by the self-decision ability of the we-energy during the process of buying and selling power. A pricing model is presented based on the distributed optimization theory, by which the minimum generation cost of the energy internet can be achieved. Furthermore, to accurately analyze the process of bidding pricing with the disturbance resulted from the psychological fluctuation of each we-energy, the multi-agent system with an uncertainty function is utilized. One example is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration of battery energy storage system for one hour independent power supply for specific loads
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the new energy power generation intensive access area, the problem that the new energy power generation has strong random and intermittent cannot be ignored. The rational allocation of battery energy storage system can play a role in absorbing new energy surplus power generation, stabilizing new energy power generation fluctuation, improving power quality, reducing power load peak and filling trough load and so on. In addition, it can provide a certain length of emergency power support when unplanned outages occur in the areas where the multi-complementary energy device is running. In this paper, the mathematical model of economic benefit of energy storage system is established with the aim of the maximum annual return on investment of energy storage system in its whole life cycle. The model is optimized by extracting the key influence factors, and the economic benefit under different configuration schemes is analyzed under the premise of one hour independent power supply for the specific loads, and the optimal allocation scheme of the energy storage system is obtained. An example is given to analyze the energy storage scheme and the annual return on investment of the Pb-C battery energy storage system at different discharge depths during the typical working days. The feasibility of the model and the solution method is verified.

articleTitle: Data mining based on DC Bias on-line monitoring system of Shanghai power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC Bias is one of the main reasons for the increase of transformer's vibration and noise. A DC Bias on-line Monitoring System is built in Shanghai power grid. The system consists of front-end monitoring units, data acquisition servers and master station servers. The neutral point dc, vibration and noise signals are collected through sensors. In this paper, DC Bias monitoring data are analyzed to acquire features when DC Bias phenomena happen. The k-means algorithm is firstly used to classify the DC bias monitoring data, which can improve the efficiency to find abnormal values and help engineers judge whether DC bias phenomena happen more quickly.

articleTitle: Study on operation characteristics and output capacity of large-scale wind power base transmission system with series compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy develops very fast in China, and China has become the largest and fastest growing country of wind and PV power in the world. But the distribution of the wind/solar energy and load center is disharmonious, with the major wind fields and the solar fields being distributed in the area which is short of load, and making large-scaled, longdistance wind and PV power transmission is imperative. The problem of stability of large-scale wind and PV power grid integrated system into the high impedance weak grid is becoming more and more important. In order to shorten the electrical distance for wind power integration, the use of series compensation technology is an economically viable approach. In this paper, operation characteristics and output capacity of large-scale wind power base transmission system with series compensation will be studied. Based on the analysis of the load flow distribution and voltage characteristics of large-scale wind power base, the influence of different grid integration impedance, wind power output level and reactive power control mode of wind turbine on the operation range of wind power base should be studied, and the paper also analyzes the influence of different series compensation capacities on the voltage stability margin of large-scale wind power output system, and studies the effect of different series compensation on the delivery capacity of large-scale wind power base integrated to weak power system through sensitivity analysis. Considering the reactive power control capability of the wind turbine, the operation range of the parallel reactive power compensation in the wind farm, and the reactive power and voltage characteristics of the system after the installation of series compensation, the reactive power and voltage coordination control of the large wind power base scheme will be proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: Voltage stability analysis of wind farms integration connected to distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing scale of wind power generation, the impact on the power flow direction, voltage stability and relay protection coordination has been widely concerned. By utilizing the measured electric data such as bus voltage phasors, line parameters, and according to the voltage quadratic equations of power flow, a new voltage stability index is proposed. Gust causes wind power to produce peak output power and leads to reduced voltage regulation capability of the feeder, which may lead to voltage collapse without sufficient reactive power support. The accurate voltage stability index (VSI) is the voltage stability margin that needs real-time quantification. In this paper, a voltage stability index suitable for distribution systems is proposed, which is only required to be measured at the root of feeders. The proposed VSI has been simulated in the distribution network with different types of fans, and the results show that the proposed VSI has the ability to quantify the node voltage stability margin in real time and effectively.

articleTitle: Research of urban energy internet's key technologies and its application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The urban energy internet is one of the most important trends of energy development. This paper puts forward the development direction of the urban energy internet from three aspects of infrastructure construction, value creation, and data platform. In the meantime, related core contents of the urban energy internet construction are discussed, which constitute an integrated system of the urban energy internet. On the basis of the Shanghai Disney Land Area's distribution network project, an application scheme of the urban energy internet is researched. The application scheme includes power supply points, networks, smart power stations, distribution automation, intelligent use of electricity, intelligent furniture, distributed energy storage and enterprise-level information platform, etc. And the customized power supply, virtual power plants, and green suites in hotels are also designed in this project, which is quite beneficial to the future urban energy network development.

articleTitle: An unified power flow method of hybrid AC/DC power system with VSC-MTDC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper deduce the power flow equation with an unified Newton method for hybrid AC/DC system with VSC-MTDC based on the VSC steady-state model and put forward a step-by-step calculation method according to the characteristics of Jacobi partial decoupling. This method take the VSC equivalent model as the AC power flow branch which can be added in the AC power flow equation easily, so the DC equation is only related to the AC nodes which only connected with VSC, then the unified power flow equation can be calculated step-by-step: AC power flow is calculated first and then DC power flow is calculated. Since coupling is not neglected during step-by-step calculation of the AC/DC equation with this method, the method has the same calculation accuracy as that of the unified solving method. Meanwhile, since calculation of the AC part is relatively independent, it is very convenient to combine it with the origin AC power flow calculation method. The calculation example verifies that the method is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Optimization configuration method for microgrid based on electric energy router
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electric energy router (EER) based on power electronic transformation technology provides a flexible and diversified electrical interface for micro-grid. This paper presents a typical microgrid model based on EER in which every electronic converter's efficiency curve is segmented according to its output level. Based on the microgrid model, an optimization configuration method to minimize the loss of the microgrid system is presented. The method uses genetic algorithm and it can configure the proportion of electric energy storage system (ESS) and photovoltaic (PV) system on the DC side and the AC side. The optimization method is compared with traditional optimization method. The results show that the proposed method is more efficient and flexible than the traditional configuration method in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Dynamic stochastic optimal power flow considering spatial correlation of wind speed based on simplified pair copula
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With large-scale wind power integrating into power grid, it's increasingly important to consider uncertainty factors into power system operation scheduling. In actual operation, wind power outputs are relatively strong correlation. It will bring larger computational error without considering these factors. Current researches are inadequate to model multiple dependent wind power outputs. Recently, presented stochastic optimal power flow models have lower computational efficiency and not able to assure the convergence. To solve these problems, a second-order cone dynamic stochastic optimal power flow model is proposed based on Simplified Pair Copula model. In this model, original non-linear models are transformed into SOCP models after constructing multiple correlated wind power outputs. Improved point estimate method and GUROBI are used to solve this model. Comparing with the program without considering the correlation of wind speed, the proposed method is proved to be effectiveness and practicability.

articleTitle: A residential end-use electric energy consumption model based on the development of household appliances
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Household appliances and lighting devices are the main terminals of electric energy in residential area. The demand of end-use electric energy is increasing with the development and innovation of household appliances. This paper analyzes the main factors influencing the terminal power consumption, provides a new method to estimate residential end-use electric energy consumption based on the purchase probability model of household appliances and lighting demand model, and optimizes the model according to the survey results in Fujian province, finally through the historical data of Fujian province to verify the model.

articleTitle: A Novel combined forecasting method for short-term distributed electric heating power load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed electric heating have become the main way to surrounding area user in winter, so it is very important to forecast short-term electric heating distribution load quickly and accurately. A novel method is proposed, in which the Back Propagation (BP) neural network algorithm is intelligently combined with ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD), and it can deal with different weather type and temperature change on the residents' heating behavior. The daily load sequence is decomposed into four series of low-to-high frequency sub-sequences and a remnant sub-sequence by EEMD method. And then, each sub-sequence, temperature data and meteorological data are input into the BP neural network to predict. Finally, the predicted components are sum up to obtain the final prediction result. EEMD-BP is applied in Coal-to-Electricity Project in beijing and the distribution network load with a large proportion of electric heating is forecast. The simulation results show that EEMD-BP method can effectively reduce the prediction error.

articleTitle: Optimal dispatch model for district heating network based on interior-point method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) and relevant research have been the focus of many scholars in recent years. The coupling between different energy systems including electric, heating and natural gas can be optimized together to improve the overall system efficiency. In this paper, we concentrate on heating system dispatch problem and proposes an optimal dispatch model for district heating network (DHN) with combined heating and power (CHP) units, which considers the thermal balance and hydraulic equations in the pipelines. This is a nonlinear optimization problem which can be solved by interior-point method (IPM). The objective is to minimize the cost of fuel consumption for the whole system. A case study based on 20-nodes DHN with 3 CHP units and 19-branches is demonstrated, proving the effectiveness of the proposed model. Moreover, convergence analysis with comparison solved by traditional IPM and primal-dual IPM is discussed and several possible future research directions are proposed.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle business model innovation study from the perspective of the energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The use of electric vehicles (EVs) has become an important part of efforts to limit vehicle emissions and improve environmental conditions by limiting air pollution. Many manufacturers of vehicles are exploring different ways to produce efficient EVs. As the EV industry expands and charging facilities are developed, enterprises that gain a sufficiently large market share will need the ability to analyze user data. A business model will be needed that optimizes the use of advertising, marketing, and big data to provide the most efficient EV business model. From the perspective of the Energy Internet, this paper analyzes the features of business model innovation in the value network of electric vehicles (EVs), discusses business models based on different value dominator, and provide a deep insight of EV business model from the vehicle-battery separation and vehicle operation pattern side. At last, this paper proposes ten types of EV business models in three categories, and provides advice focusing on business model innovation at different developmental stages of the EV industry.

articleTitle: A VAR optimization model in distribution networks with precise linear modelling for OLTC of transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a reactive power (VAR) optimization model is proposed combining the precise linear modelling of transformer on-load tap changer (OLTC) to reduce power losses and voltage deviations. In the proposed method, the distributed generator, static and discrete VAR compensators, and transformer OLTC are chosen as control variables. The nonconvex optimization model is transformed into a convex problem through cone relaxation and precise linear modelling of OLTC. The numerical tests show that the model can significantly reduce the network losses and voltage deviation.

articleTitle: Study on the stability of large wind power grid-connected system including different types of wind generators
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reactive power characteristics and control of wind generator greatly impact the stability of power grid connected with wind farm. For the wind power grid-connected system including different types of wind generators, this paper proposed a management strategy of reactive power coordination based on analyzing reactive power voltage characteristics of variable-speed constant-frequency double-fed wind turbine (DFIG). The strategy could make full use of reactive power regulation function of DFIG to compensate reactive consumption of nearby constant speed constant frequency asynchronous induction wind generator (FSIG). Simulations with IEEE_9 node standard benchmark system are studied. The results show that because the maximum reactive power output capacity of DFIG increases with stator voltage decreasing, the reactive power control strategy real-timely and effectively plays its reactive regulation capability, thus improves static voltage stability margin of the wind power system and make multi-machine system maintain better transient voltage and angle stability while large disturbance occurs.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis for multi-energy flows of energy internet: Framework and prospects
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet (EI) is an inevitable development trend of energy systems under the background of technology development, environmental pressure and energy transition. Multi-energy flow coupling is one of the key characteristics of the EI, which enhances the interoperability of different types of energy flows while consequently increases the probability of cascading failures. Therefore it is of great significance to study the multi-energy flow fault diagnosis of the EI to ensure its safe and stable operation as well as the continuous energy supply. This paper introduces the concept of multi-energy flow cascading fault of the EI for the first time. The energy internet framework for multi-energy flow cascading fault diagnosis is firstly proposed, and then characteristics of various energy networks in the EI are analyzed from the perspective of fault diagnosis. Finally, future research prospects are discussed.

articleTitle: An analytical planning approach for determining the maximum penetration of renewable distributed generation in the distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This work proposes an analytical planning approach for determining the maximum penetration of renewable distributed generation (DG) in radial power distribution systems with the consideration of wind turbines and solar photovoltaics. Firstly, an analytical approach based on a simplified set of analytical expressions is proposed for manual calculation of maximum DG penetration at individual buses in the distribution network. Then, the solution realized by analytical approach is validated against the exhaustive load flow analysis, in a 33-bus radial distribution system. Afterwards, a DG planning method is developed based on the analytical approach. The application of DG planning method is assessed in a 69-bus distribution system where the numerical results confirm its usefulness. The proposed planning method can be used as a preliminary tool for estimating the maximum allowable DG penetration in the distribution network.

articleTitle: The application of multiple texts watermarking algorithm in the transmission of power information security under the Internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important energy industry, the effective solution of the information security problem has become an important problem to be solved. In view of the information security problems in the transmission of power information documents, the multi text watermarking algorithm is introduced into the document protection of power system for the first time. Based on the Internet, taking the transmission of power equipment parameters in power system and the content authentication of sender as an example, the robust watermarking algorithm is used to communicate the parameters of the equipment, so that it can resist the various attacks during transmission. The fragile watermarking algorithm is used to verify the identity of the document to detect whether or not the document has been stolen or misused, and to tamper with the text content of the modified part. In this paper, the algorithm is simulated and attacked. The results show that the multiple watermarking techniques can be used for different purposes for data protection and implementation of covert communication, realize its value, proved the multiple watermark ability to improve the transmission of electric power information security under the internet.

articleTitle: Research on construction and application of cost index on overhead line engineering based on mass data technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the advancement and reform of the science and technology, calculation and analysis method of base line project cost are constantly changing, gradually formed a large data analysis based management model. Because of the overhead line engineering construction point spread, wide construction cost index, involving in different stages of the project and big lost of the value cost index, it is difficult to carry out the accumulation of basic data. Facing the different forms and types of basic data, how to classify the integration of existing data and form an engineering cost information platform for the construction of the query and utilization of all parties has become an important issue. Based on the case inference technology of artificial intelligence, this paper establishes the engineering cost index prediction model of the completed engineering case inference system and overhead transmission line. Has completed the project cost information to make use of computer storage, statistics, analysis and dynamic query, such as scientific management, to realize the whole process of construction projects for overhead transmission lines, omnidirectional, the whole team cost control. It is of great significance to study the cost of overhead line engineering.

articleTitle: Coordinated control stategy for DC microgrid clusters considering intelligent power allocation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed a coordinated control strategy with intelligent power function to make the operation of the DC micro power network stable and reliable. According to the bus voltage, the strategy can control different sub micro networks in parallel or independent operation, and then control the power flow between micro grids to coordinate the stable operation of the DC microgrid. At the same time, the fuzzy droop control with voltage feedback compensation is adopted in the energy storage system, which can effectively reduce the bus voltage fluctuation while automatically allocating the load power between the energy storage systems. Finally, the simulation analysis is carried out using Matlab/Simulink, and the simulation results show that the coordinated control can control the stable operation and voltage stability of microgrid.

articleTitle: An event-driven modeling and simulation method for cyber-physical power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated with advanced information technologies, traditional power grids are evolving to Cyber Physical Power Sys-tems (CPPS). Accordingly, new simulation methods are demanded, which focuses on interactions between electrical network and in-formation network. In this paper, an event-driven simulation method for CPPS is proposed. To modeling cross-network interactions, changes of component statuses are taken as CPS events. Then, a virtual timeline is created to provide time coordination for synchronizing continuous time dynamics and discrete event dy-namics concerned. By updating and processing the event queue, the event-driven simulation of CPPS is conducted in an integrated simulation platform. Two illustrative cases are presented to demonstrate the proposed simulation method as well as validate its efficacy.

articleTitle: Research on grid-connected micro grid control strategy and control method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This optimizes DG operation performance by using hybrid-energy-storage-based adjustable DG control strategy according to distribution characteristics of DG. By improving droop control, it realizes the stable operation of micro grid in islanding & connected-grid operation statuses and smooth switch between the two operation statuses. Based on multiple-agent micro grid layered control strategy, it conducts micro grid layered control in network composed of multiple micro power supplies. Finally, by using the optimized control algorithm of multiple-agent distribution theory, it studies various distribution types of power supply optimization control strategies in micro grids, puts forward strategy and method of coordinated optimization control for multiple power supplies in micro grids, solves the optimized control of power distribution network with access of multiple micro grids and improves the effective use rate of renewable energy resources.

articleTitle: Research on noise reduction method of long distance optical fiber sensor for transmission line on-line monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Sensor network can significantly improve the perception, management and operation level of energy system. Optical fiber sensors are used for on-line intelligent monitoring of equipment and environment, and send optical signal with OPGW to form a passive optical signal sensor network. In response to features of the long distance transmission line of Energy Internet such as easily be subjected to environmental factors, a noise reduction method based on laser timed frequency hopping was proposed in this paper. Firstly, the application of coherent optical time-domain reflection to long distance optical fiber sensing system was analyzed, and then the method to reduce coherent Rayleigh noise was analyzed. The method of timed frequency hopping of laser frequency controlled by software was proposed and the effectiveness of the described model and method was verified by experiments, the prospects and requirements of next stage are proposed.

articleTitle: Reliability price and compensation mechanism of distribution network with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the opening electricity market, distributed generation can be used as reserve capacity, which can help to improve the reliability of distributed network. A reliability price and compensation model for distribution network with distributed generation is proposed in this paper, where the interests of both the power supplier and the customer is fully considered, and the investment cost is apportioned according to the customer's reliability requirements to obtain the reliability price. In addition, this method considers the outage cost of unit electricity as a variable that varies with the duration of power outages, which breaks the traditional idea that the outage cost of unit electricity regarded as a fixed value. Furthermore, the value engineering theory is used to derive the formula of reliability compensation, and the reliability compensation mechanism for distribution network with distributed generation is constructed. Finally, an example on RBTS-BUS6 system is presented to show the validity and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Coordination control and start-up strategy in flexible DC urban distribution networks for smart cities
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Research on the Flexible DC Urban Distribution System (FDCUDS) is in the ascendant. Due to the lack of some key technologies, operating experience and relevant standards, the application of the FDCUDS has been limited. A multi-terminal FDCUDS topology, which contains photovoltaic cell and wind turbines, was first determined for further analysis. Secondly, key equipment was analyzed and the coordination control strategy of each terminal was verified. Subsequently, a new start-up control strategy of the FDCUDS was proposed and a hand-in-hand FDCUDS model with six terminals was built in PSCAD/EMTDC. The start-up control strategy, the normal operation, and the control-mode switch strategy with regard to the fault occurrence were analyzed. The results indicate the validity of both the start-up control strategy and the operation-mode switch method.

articleTitle: Researches on control strategy of distributed AVC for district grids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of power supply connection between the regional grids and smaller county grids, a novel distributed AVC system for district power networks is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a two-level AVC system is set up in the region and county power dispatch centers separately based on the integrated EMS both for regional wide and county wide grids. In this way, the two-level AVC system can be operated in either global or independent mode. Then the distributed AVC optimal control model is established, and the weighting factor is introduced in the objective function of the system, leading to the simplified calculation algorithm. The optimal control model would be applied to the region and county AVC system at the same time. At last, the application in Wuhu grid shows that the system optimizes reactive power flow from the perspective of the whole region and improves the voltage qualification of the regional and county grids.

articleTitle: A computational approach for modeling, evaluating and optimizing the reliability of integrated community energy systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing development of the integrated community energy systems (ICES), the interconnection among electricity, natural gas, cooling, heat and fuels systems is extremely highlighted. Based on energy hub model and Monte Carlo method, this paper proposed an optimal approach to evaluate the reliability of the ICES. By implementing the interior point method and the genetic algorithm, the proposed approach can calculate reliability index more effective in terms of calculation time and accuracy. Besides, this paper analyzes the impact of the penetration of renewable energy on the reliability of ICES.

articleTitle: An operation planning of an AC/DC hybrid integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under acquaintance with advantages of new energy resources, distributed generations are widely utilised. This paper establishes an AC/DC hybrid integrated energy system model, which promotes AC/DC flexible transformation in power system and improves comprehensive utilization of new energy resources. First of all, the paper gives an elementary analysis of the power supply characteristics according to different kind of resources, combined with characteristics of energy storage. Furthermore, based on constraints of power balance and operation, simulation of optimal operation on the model shows the beneficial in decreasing operating costs, reducing harmful gas emissions and cuting down coal consumption.

articleTitle: The evaluation of electric heating load construction based on renewable energy generation for coal-to-electricity project
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, due to deteriorating environment, coal-to-electricity project has received a lot of attention. However, coal-to-electricity project is still in the early stage of development, and the relevant standards of electric heating load connecting to distribution network are not perfect. Based on the current problems of coal-to-electricity project, in order to improve renewable energy generation (REG) integration capacities in distribution network, typical construction schemes of electric heating load connecting to distribution network are put forward in this paper. Considering reliability and economic efficiency, a two-step scheme evaluation method for construction schemes is developed including a preliminary selection and a pareto-based selection, to achieve the optimal construction schemes of associated distribution network and REG integration in different scale of electric heating load. Finally, the application case of coal-to-electricity project is introduced to evaluate the typical schemes, which lays the foundation for the large-scale promotion of coal-to-electricity project.

articleTitle: The integrated operation of multiple energy carrier used to enhance the reliability of the integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The coordination of multiple energy can be realized in an integrated energy system. Thus higher economic performance and energy supply reliability can be obtained by multiple energy optimization. In this paper, an optimization of control strategy considering economic performance and response performance is inducted. Firstly, an integrated energy system including multiple energy conversion devices and response time of cold/heat related devices are introduced. Then the constraints are inducted into form of energy efficiency matrix in which energy efficiency is used to describe the efficiency of energy conversion and storage. After this, two forms of objectives dedicate to the performance of economic performance and response performance are inducted. Combined by the constraints and objectives, a linear programing method is used to coordinate multiple energy in an integrated energy system. The results revealed that the economic optimal optimization and responsive optimal optimization are conflicted. To obtain the comprehensive optimal performance, the first step should be given to response time optimization and then exerting economic optimization.

articleTitle: Allocation of cross-regional and cross-provincial transmission cost to trade on power market directly
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the cross-regional and cross-provincial power market in which the pool and bilateral trades coexist, the transmission cost allocation considering the effect of reactive power is proposed. At first, the description framework of any complex pool and bilateral trade is designed. Secondly, based on the current response vector and power vector caused by the trade, the equivalent complex element of the trade is given, and the share of use to branch by each trade is showed. At last, the transmission cost allocation according to use of line and dependence on grid is given. This method is also verified reasonable and feasible by the IEEE 14-bus system simulation. And this method is used for the cross-regional and cross-provincial transmission pricing.

articleTitle: Data-driven based predictive control for networked nonlinear systems with energy-limited DoS attacks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper focuses on the security issue of tracking control for a class of networked nonlinear systems under energy-limited Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks. An event-triggered mechanism is considered into the system to save communication resources. By using the model-free adaptive control (MFAC) algorithm, we introduced a data-driven based predictive control method to solve the packets loss caused by DoS attacks. The given simulation shown the method we proposed was effective in deal with the energy-limited DoS attacks and reduce the communication burden.

articleTitle: Agent-based modeling of high-resolution household electricity demand profiles: A novel tool for policy evaluating
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale integration of renewable energy source into electricity grid creates new challenges to the grid stability and puts forward new demands to demand-side management. This paper adopted agent-based modeling method to build a flexible household model for evaluating different gird regulation policies. According to the different usage pattern, this study classifies the commonly used household electrical appliances into four categories: shiftable load, sheddable load, instantaneous load and baseload. Different kind of load has different characters and responses differently to regulation policies. The work proposed an agent-based model to simulate the actual operation conditions of the appliances and generate a high-resolution household energy demand profile. This could provide a helpful reference for community facility managers and energy companies in policy decision process and help them implement accurate energy consumption controlling strategies.

articleTitle: Coupled analysis of energy flow in a multiple energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Analyses about multiple energy networks are required to explore the increasing interactions among different subsystems. In this work, energy flow computation of heat and electricity networks are studied. Firstly, a steady state model for multi-energy networks is established. Then, an alternating iterative method for energy flow computation is proposed, where subsystems are analyzed individually. Moreover, the coupling patterns for heat and electricity network are compared. For each pattern, a computation method is designed. Test results validate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An MILP-based optimal energy flow of regional multiple energy network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) method is proposed for calculating the optimal energy flow in a regional multiple energy system. A basic model of a regional multiple energy network consisting of electrical distribution network, natural gas network, heat network, electrical boiler and combined heat and power units (CHP) is presented first. The nonlinear gas transmission constraints and mass flow transmission constraints of heat network make the optimal energy flow hard to solve, thus a piecewise linear approximation method is applied to manage the two transmission constraints. Meanwhile, a new variable heat quantity is introduced to combine the hydraulic and thermal calculation together to use the piecewise linear method. Finally, an 85 bus electricity-gas-heat combined energy network is served for demonstrating the proposed method.

articleTitle: A novel linear correlation clustering method for stochastic power flow studies
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Nowadays as quantities of renewable energy resources are integrated to the power grid, their fluctuation and uncertainties influence violently to power system operation. Stochastic power flow is utilized to handle this issue. However, conventional stochastic power flow did not consider correlation in renewable energies, especially wind farms, leading to errors in power flow analysis. To address this problem, this paper proposes a linear correlation clustering method, which decomposes the non-linear correlated wind power data to several linear models to solve. The data generated from the nonlinear probabilistic distribution is clustered according to similar linear property, still keeping their major features and characteristics. Through analysis in a case study, it is proved that the proposed linear correlation clustering method performs better than existing Gaussian mixture model in both accuracy and computational efficiency. It is insightful to be utilized for stochastic power flow calculation in power system planning and operation.

articleTitle: A novel method to dertermine the harmonic responsibility for power distribution network including photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on varying coefficient regression, a novel method is proposed to determine the harmonic responsibility for power distribution network including photovoltaic system. The harmonic current characteristics of photovoltaic system is analyzed firstly. The varying coefficient regression is adopted to evaluate the utility harmonic impedance due to its' adaptability to harmonic characteristics of photovoltaic system. Then, the detailed harmonic responsibility is calculated according to harmonic responsibility formula according to the superposition law. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, the simulation is carried on with IEEE 13-bus system.

articleTitle: Rapid evaluation of short-term voltage stability considering integration of renewable power generations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the capacity of grid connected renewable power generation increases, the issue of STVS should be taken seriously. Therefore, a method for rapid assessment of the STVS of power systems is proposed in this paper. To begin with, a continuous, quantified short-term voltage stability index (STVSI) is proposed to describe whether a certain voltage curve is stable or not. Secondly, a database which contains numerous cases of operational scenarios of a power system together with the simulation and analyzing results of these scenarios is established. Finally, the target operational scenario is fitted by the scenarios stored in the database, such that the STVS of this target operational scenarios can be rapidly evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on capacity configuration optimization for island microgrid based on battery's state of charge
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Making use of the characteristics of complementation of renewable energy, a new optimal control strategy for microgrid is proposed to choose the appropriate opening capacity of distributed energy such as wind power, photovoltaic, gas turbine and energy storage system. According to this strategy, this paper realizes analysis and evaluation of capacity optimization through establishing mathematical model. Then the optimal operation plan is solved by means of multi-objective optimization algorithm. Finally, a numerical example shows the applicability of the strategy. The optimal ratio of multi power supply is realized to guide engineering construction.

articleTitle: Influence analysis of the main control parameters in FVSG on the frequency stability of the system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The converter based on virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control can simulate the inertia of synchronous generator. Virtual inertia can be adjusted within a certain range, which is a significant advantage compared with traditional synchronous generator. However, the change of the control parameters of the flexible virtual synchronous generator (FVSG) will seriously affect the frequency stability of the system. It is very important for parameter selection to explore the influence of the main control parameters on the frequency stability of the system. Firstly, the VSG control strategy with fixed inertia time constant is shown and the control frame of VSG is constructed. Then, the FVSG control method based on exponential inertia is studied. Finally, the influence law of the main control parameters of FVSG on the frequency stability of the system is revealed by constructing the small-signal model, the sensitivity calculation and the root locus analysis, which provides the basis for the selection of the control parameters.

Author Keywords: influence on frequency stability of the system

articleTitle: Simulation method for voltage control and system development of a distribution network with large-scale photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the volatility, randomness and intermittent of photovoltaic (PV) output, incorporation of large scale distributed photovoltaic will have adverse effects on the long-term voltage stability of the distribution network. The power grid and the control system together determine whether the planning scheme meets the voltage constraints. Therefore, combined with the latest theoretical results of distribution voltage control, this paper designs and develops a voltage control simulation system, which is based on .NET platform of distribution network and contains a large number of photovoltaic power, provides supplementary analysis for planning decision at the same. The system is developed in Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 platform integrated with the GIS plug-in component MapX. Then, the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method is verified using the modified IEEE 33-69 case.

articleTitle: Key technology research of the multi-state monitoring on high voltage cable
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the implementation of the national “the Belt and Road” strategy, the energy internet is booming[1]. In this paper, through the PMS terminal data acquisition, cable tunnel data, cable temperature data, tower high-voltage cable terminal secondary and ground intelligent monitoring, a multi-state monitoring platform is established to provide data and promote information interconnection. This platform can integrate information of the equipment, geographical location and production management system, which is efficient to provide integrated support for the cable monitoring and emergency response. Large data communication helps achieve the sharing of multi-state data between grid companies under the energy Internet framework. The application of multi-state monitoring technology plays an important supporting role in the centralized management, unified command, integrated data sharing.

articleTitle: Comparison of IEEE C37.118.2-2011 standard and GB/T 26865.2-2011 standard based on synchrophasor data transfer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of synchronous phasor measurement technology and the improvement in the application of power systems, the relevant international organizations and country have issued and revised the synchronous phasor related standards. In this paper, we discuss the synchronous phasor data tracansmission according to IEEE C37.118.2-2011 and GB/T 26865.2-2011, including the format of the message frame, the support of the data transmission protocol and the transmission of the offline file and so on, analyzes the causes of the differences between China and international standards, and provides a reference for the international synchronization phasor measurement standard and the further improvement of our domestic standard.

articleTitle: Concept and analysis of discrete energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The future power system will be the integration of multiple energy systems, cyber-physical system, and multiple markets. This paper presents an architecture of energy-discretized multi-energy microgrids. This architecture can achieve the point-to-point (P2P)transmission of discrete energy with the physical system level, which solves the problem of energy flow tracking and measurement. In this architecture, the real-time transaction-and-control-combined mechanism can ensure the dynamic and fully customized energy supply. This paper draws the architecture of a new generation of energy supply system, and may provide an idea for the integration of energy, information, and value in energy supply system.

articleTitle: Cascading failure initially from power grid in interdependent networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The previous consideration of power grid focuses on the power system itself, however, the recent work is aiming at both power grid and communication network, this coupling networks are firstly called as interdependent networks. Prior study on modeling interdependent networks always extracts main features from real networks, the model of network A and network B are completely symmetrical, both degree distribution in intranetwork and support pattern in inter-network, but in reality this circumstance is hard to attain. In this paper, we deliberately set both networks with same topology in order to specialized research the support pattern between networks. In terms of initial failure from power grid or communication network, we find the remaining survival fraction is greatly disparate, and the failure initially from power grid is more harmful than failure initially from communication network, which all show the vulnerability of interdependency and meantime guide us to pay more attention to the protection measures for power grid.

articleTitle: Study on technology of electronic power engineering cost based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the construction of the smart grid and the collection of a large number of data, the traditional data processing and the analysis method are hard to meet the requirements. The article summarizes the mining of power system data, mainly including the application of data mining technology in the power industry in recent years. The paper lists and analyses the application situation of data mining technology in the fields of the electric power industry in recent years and the usage of data mining algorithm through the analysis of the demand for electric power system. It shows that the application of data mining technology in the power industry is the inevitable trend, especially in the cost of electric power engineering, and the development of the algorithm shows a trend of diversification. Although the data mining in the electric power industry is developing rapidly, it is still in the exploratory research stage at present and needs the further development.

articleTitle: Experimental research on communication technology of new plant based on visible light communication
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The future power generation, substation and other stations tend to be intelligent. The corresponding power communication system plays a decisive role in the intelligentization of the electrical system. This article proposes a kind of access network physical layer structure based on visible light communication (VLC) and power line carrier (PLC) technology. It can solve the problem of interference attenuation of radio frequency (RF) signal in the electromagnetic sensitive power plants and substations. The scheme avoids the shortcomings of laying communication support network which needs a large scale of cable and costs a lot. Firstly, this paper will describe the proposed model framework and the module design. Then, through the design of field programmable gate array (FPGA)-based software modules and other hardware modules, the power line carrier technology and the visible light communication technology are combined to demonstrate the feasibility of the scheme through experiments. It also can be used as a factory site positioning function. And the VLC system can transmit real-time video, voice, plant data and other signals to support the entire plant communication. It will become a safe, efficient and stable new direction for the development of power communications.

articleTitle: The probabilistic load flow analysis of power system considering the fluctuation of smelting load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, special power load represented by smelting load presents the characteristics of large capacity and high density in part of China power grid. The power fluctuation of smelting load has a great impact on power system security. The probabilistic load flow method can fully take into account the random fluctuation of these special load. Firstly, the probability distribution model is presented based on the probability density curve of the measured data of smelting load considering the power fluctuation characteristics. The Monte Carlo method is applied to the system probabilistic load flow calculation with smelting load, and the node probability distribution of voltage and the active power of branch are obtained. The variation characteristics of node voltage and branch power with system normal operation and branch outage contingency under the smelting load influence are analyzed. The results show that the fluctuating range of node voltage and branch power may be increased, and the over-limit probability of node voltage increase with the randomness fluctuation of smelting load. When the outage branch is near from the smelting load, the probabilistic distribution of the branch active power change. The method is applied to IEEE 30 node system for comparative analysis, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of it.

articleTitle: Power system weak bus identification based on voltage distribution characteristic
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the weak buses of power system are identified by voltage distribution characteristic indicators in the case of load fluctuation. First, the probabilistic load flow (PLF) based on Latin hypercube sampling (LHS) is applied to obtain random load states and voltage of each bus. The samples obtained by LHS can basically cover the whole load variation region. Combined with the N-1 fault analysis method, the collapse states of power system caused by different load fluctuation are researched. Second, the distribution characteristics of collapse bus voltage are analyzed by normal distribution probability paper test method. The result is that the collapse bus voltages obey normal distribution. Third, different voltage stability risk assessment indicators are proposed to identify the weak buses in power system. These indicators are proposed from voltage distribution characteristics, voltage change rate and voltage sensitivity point of view. Finally, the proposed method is tested on IEEE 30 bus system. The results show that the identification method of weak buses is very valuable for fast identification of weak buses in the case of load random fluctuation.

articleTitle: A probabilistic day-ahead scheduling with considering wind power curtailment
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale wind power integration aggravates the uncertainty and complexity of the day-ahead scheduling (DAS) problem. Based on the uncertainty of prediction errors, an overall system prediction error integrating with all uncertain prediction errors is put forward to reduce the number of uncertain variables into one, which effectively simplifies the DAS model. By considering the different prediction error distributions of wind output and its influence on the reserve capacity, the DAS model is further refined. What's more, wind power curtailment (WPC) as a decision variable is introduced, which makes the uncertain wind power becoming partially controlled. Thus, based on the chance constraint programming (CCP), a probabilistic DAS model with considering WPC is established in this paper. Results show that the WPC and the overall prediction error can effectively enhance the economy and calculation of the system scheduling.

articleTitle: A parallel approach for optimal power flow with transient stability constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the Optimal Power Flow with Transient Stability Constraints (OTS) model, this paper presents a parallel method to solving the shortcoming of current method on large calculation. Meanwhile, according to the swing curves of generator rotor and the characteristics of transient stability analysis, a simple and credible criteria to determine transient stability is proposed. The parallel method improved the accuracy and calculation speed of the stability assessment. Numerical results on three test systems, the NE-39 system, the IEEE 300-bus system and 703-bus systems, show that the OTS model based on parallel computation is effective in reducing the computing time.

articleTitle: Research on optimal equivalent capacity of wind farms based on probabilistic forecasting for power system planning
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Issues regarding to the benefit evaluation of wind farms is investigated. Optimal equivalent capacity of wind farms is proposed. By utilizing nonparametric conditional kernel density estimation technique, a probabilistic density distribution of wind output, which reflects the short-term changing of wind power, is formed. Furthermore, combining with production operating simulation, solution method to calculate the optimal equivalent capacity of wind farms is constructed. Proposed method fully considers the sequence and stochastic characters of wind output, and the corresponding result verifies the accuracy and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Comparison of the performance between stationary frame and synchronous rotating frame control of single-phase grid-connected inverter with LCL filter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Control strategy of a single-phase grid-connected inverter with LCL filter has been a mature research topic. But the most widely-used control method is stationary frame PI (SFPI) current control, which is unable to achieve a unit power factor (PF) and zero steady-state error (SSE) output current. In order to overcome this problem, the synchronous rotating frame PI (SRFPI) control which is widely used in three-phase inverter is applied to the single-phase inverter. This paper first sets up a mathematical model of a SFPI controlled inverter and finds out the relationship between the controller parameters and the inverter output PF and SSE. Then the paper figures out that the output PF and SSE of inverters controlled by SFPI have a maximum value. As comparison, the model of inverter controlled by SEFPI is set up, and a simplified transfer function of the double-inputs double-outputs system of the controller term is obtained to tune the control parameters. Then, the expression of the output PF is derived and proved to be 1 independently of the controller parameters. Finally, simulation and experiment is used to verify the analysis.

articleTitle: Over-voltage regulation capability analysis of rooftop photovoltaic grid-connected inverters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rooftop photovoltaic (PV) is becoming more popular these years for its economical and environmental benefits. Nevertheless, the over-voltage problem on point of common coupling (PCC) often occurs in the rural distribution network because of the PV power and load fluctuations. Aiming at the PCC bus over-voltage in rooftop PV grid-connected system, this paper, focusing on the 10kV distribution network of rural areas, analyzes the over-voltage regulation capability of the PV inverters. Two common models of the rooftop grid-connected PV inverters are established in MATLAB, both the load on grid side and the PV power supply fluctuations are all discussed to analyze the fluctuations of the PCC bus voltage. The experimental results could provide important basis for improving the voltage stability of distribution network, including the optimization of PV inverter control strategy, and the necessity of planning local reactive power compensation device.

articleTitle: A novel directional relay for HVDC transmission line based on measured surge impedance
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A directional relay based on measured surge impedance is proposed in this paper. When a fault occurs at the forward direction of convertor station, the measured surge impedance at the measuring point is the same as the impedance at rectifier backside. For faults at the backward direction of convertor station, the measured surge impedance at the measuring point is line surge impedance. Thus, according to the difference between the measured surge impedances, fault criterion is proposed to distinguish the forward faults from the backward faults. Moreover, measured surge impedances is calculated by the initial voltage traveling wave and the initial current traveling wave under specific frequencies which are extracted via S transform at the measuring point. Finally, a simulation model of a ±500kV HVDC transmission system is built based on PSCAD/EMTDC, and simulation results of different fault location and transition resistance indicate that this kind of directional relay is validity and adaptability under various fault conditions.

articleTitle: Improved dynamic phasor-based modeling and simulation of modular multilevel converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An improved dynamic phasor modeling method for modular multilevel converter (MMC) in high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system is presented, verified and applied. The model developed in this paper consists of AC interface module, DC interface module, MMC control system, circulating current suppression module and the 8-order MMC improved dynamic phasor model. When the external circuit is updated, it just needs modifying the electrical parameters of interface modules and the control strategy of the MMC, thus it is convenient for the external circuit improvement to connect to the MMC model. Since the improved method avoids the integral and convolution operation, the computational cost of the MMC dynamic phasor modeling is greatly reduced. Finally, under the steady-state and three-phase-to-ground short-circuit fault conditions, the MMC dynamic phasor model is implemented in MATLAB using the ode45 solution and the MMC electromagnetic transient (EMT) model is implemented in PSCAD/EMTDC. The comparisons of the simulation results verify the validity of the proposed modeling method. As the salient feature, the dynamic phasor modeling approach can greatly accelerate simulation speed without sacrifice the simulation accuracy, therefore the dynamic phasor modeling is expected to be more widely used in the simulation of large-scale MMC-based AC/DC power grid.

articleTitle: A fast non-unit line protection strategy for the MMC-based MTDC grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The topology of DC power grid based on modular multi-level converter is lattic or ring. When DC side fault occurs, the sudden change of the electrical quantity can be detected instantaneously at each end of the lines, which puts forward high requirements for line protection. At present, the conventional DC line protection methods do not fully adapt to the structural characteristics and fault characteristics of the multi-terminal flexible DC grid. Therefore, a novel DC line non-unit protection scheme is proposed. Analysis shows that for different types of faults on the DC side, there are obvious feature differences between the positive and negative abrupt current of the same side line, as well as between the fault line and the normal line on the same DC bus. Thus, a fault identification criterion based on the difference between the ratio of poles' current differential is constructed, and the faulted pole selection is completed according to the difference of the positive and negative voltage of the line; the identification criteria for lightning disturbance is proposed; and the fault isolation scheme based on DC circuit breaker is designed. Finally, the simulation results of the three-terminal flexible DC network verify the effectiveness of the proposed protection.

articleTitle: Wind-storage combined system optimization model considering correlation of wind speed
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the output distribution of each wind farm is combined by the Gumbel Copula function, and the output characteristics of the wind farm group are modeled in order to obtain the output distribution of it in each period. Then, the sequential power curve of the clustered wind farm obtained by Latin hypercube sampling is converted into the sustained output curve of the wind farm. On this basis, a joint optimization model of power transmission capacity and storage power allocation which can reflect comprehensive income of transmission project is constructed by considering the transmission revenue, construction cost of transmission project, storage cost and loss of abandoned wind caused by transmission congestion. The results of case verify that the optimization model proposed in this paper not only reduces the investment cost of transmission engineering, but also improves the comprehensive income of transmission project.

articleTitle: Mitigating uncertain RESs in integrated energy system considering line pack of gas
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the integrated energy system becoming a focus of research and application, its flexibility and stability has become a major issue, facing the uncertainties due to the increasing penetration of RESs (renewable energy sources). In this paper, for the electrical-hydraulic-thermal-gas integrated energy system, considering the fact that the gas can be stored in large quantities in pipelines, a method to mitigate the RESs uncertainties by utilizing the line pack storage of gas pipeline is developed. The multi-energy flow model of the electrical-hydraulic-thermal-gas integrated energy system is established, in which line pack storage of natural gas is described. A decomposed sequential multi-energy flow calculation approach is employed to calculate the energy flows. A case study of the integrated energy system illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed method for dealing with the RESs uncertainties in short-term operation by adjusting the average pressure within natural gas pipeline.

articleTitle: Study on coupling operation of multi-energy flow for integrated community energy system considering seasonal load characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to further study the coupling of three energy flows of electricity, heat and natural gas in integrated community energy system, based on the theory of energu hub, this paper has proposed the universal energy hub model for different load types in winter and summer, and established the coupling matrix and the operation mode of the model, combined with the natural gas pipeline network and distribution network steady state calculation connected to it, thus to obtain the energy allocation plan for energy hub. Taking Matlab and its Simulink as the platform, the simulation of the system was achieved, and as the calculation proves that, the proposed model and calculation method can be used to analyze the coupling degree of different energy flows in energy hub, the algorithm can reasonably reflect the characteristics of steady state in the integrated community energy system.

articleTitle: Prediction of electric vehicle market based on market segmentation and regional gradient development
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To ensure the healthy development of the electric car market, and establish a development strategy scientifically and reasonably, we need to carry out a more accurate prediction for the future of the EV market. Based on the characteristics of the regional gradient development in a long stage and public sector taking the lead of the EV market, the paper proposes a model of EVs considering the market segmentation and regional gradient development and utilizing grey theory. The quantitative analysis and prospect of EV market scale and structure in China in the medium and long term are presented. The results show that by 2020 Chinese EV ownership will reach the national planning objectives of 5 million, and by 2030 will be more than 50 million. Additionally, it will reflect a “substituting electricity for oil” benefit to ease energy and environment pressures.

articleTitle: Research on energy-saving approach of multi-modal vehicles based on traffic signal control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Nowadays, as the city traffic situation becomes more and more complicated, and the people for energy-saving emission reduction initiatives, the existing signal control strategy can no longer meet the needs of modern society. At present, the idea of use Internet of Vehicles (IoV) to improve the control of traffic lights and to make the energy consumption of the vehicles as low as possible has attracted more and more attention. Therefore, the multimodal energy efficient traffic signal (MEETS) control algorithm is designed in this paper. The algorithm uses a dynamic programming method to formulate a strict schedule for each vehicle arriving at the crossroads to minimize the overall energy consumption of vehicles passing through the crossroads. At the end of the paper, the simulation results show that the MEETS can effectively improve traffic, reduce energy use as well as supporting multi-modal traffic.

articleTitle: Microgrid optimal dispatch considering random characteristics of solar and wind
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Study on microgrid optimal dispatch has always been one of the most essential issues for microgrid operation and management.
