The paper fully considers the random characteristics of the photovoltaic power and wind turbine power output, as well as the charging/discharging characteristics of the energy storage unit in the microgrid in order to illuminate the intermittent uncertainty of power generation output, load consumption and the system equipment which will have an influence on the microgrid, and further to achieve optimal power dispatch within the microgrid. Aside from this, various levels of electricity prices of the main power grid, which are divided into crest, peak, level and valley prices according to different time periods when the microgrid is connected to the main power grid, along with the cogeneration of combined heat and electric power from a gas turbine which depends on the heat load condition when the microgrid is off-grid are both carefully taken into consideration at the same time. Furthermore, differential optimal dispatch strategies are drawn up, and a microgrid economical dispatch model with the optimization target of minimizing the operational cost considering uncertainty factors under the condition of system constraints is established. In the last part, a typical microgrid system is given as an example, which then is calculated and analyzed. The calculation results of the example have shown that the aforementioned strategies are very reasonable and much more economical than the strategies without considering these two factors.

Author Keywords: cogeneration of combined heat and electric power

articleTitle: State estimation for steam networks considering drainage and parameter uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel state estimation approach for the steam network to estimate the drainage of each pipe. An equivalent model of the steam pipe is established considering the drainage and condensation processes in steam transportation. Then the state estimation approach is developed, in which parameter uncertainties are taken into account. The proposed approach is tested with simulation data of a real steam network.

articleTitle: Dispatch of EV loads in active distribution network considering energy storage characteristic
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The secure and stable operation of power systems can be affected by the connection of a large scale of out-of-order electric vehicle (EV) charging loads, causing a much higher peak-load. With the enormous development in the field of active distribution network (ADN), vehicle-to-grid (V2G) technique and demand management technique, electric vehicles are not only passive loads, but also controllable loads and energy storage equipments, as well as backup power. On a range of residential neighborhood, a model of EV charging loads simulation is proposed at first using Monte-Carlo method based on statistical data. An optimal dispatching strategy of EV charging loads considering energy storage characteristic is also proposed, which aims at minimizing the fluctuation of load profile under the constraints of EV travelling demands. Finally, the proposed method is tested, comparing between free charging mode, coordinated charging mode and V2G charging mode. The conclusion of simulation shows that V2G charging mode considering energy stored in batteries has the best indexes of system operation.

articleTitle: Spinning reserve optimization with wind power output and electric vehicles considering the operator's risk preference
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a spinning reserve optimization model in the energy internet with gas turbines and electric vehicles to deal with wind power uncertainty. The operator's risk preference on system security and wind power consumption is taken into account in the model based on the chance constraints. The costs of expected demand loss and wind power spillage not covered by spinning reserves are incorporated in the objective function. In order to improve computational efficiency, a method is proposed to linearize the formulation of EENS and EWS. The impacts on system security, wind power consumption, and spinning reserve scheduling under different risk preferences are systematically investigated on the IEEE reliable test system RTS79. The operation characteristics of gas turbines and electric vehicles are summarized and the optimal risk-preference-related confidence levels are found.

articleTitle: An optimization method of multiple energy flows for CCHP based on fuzzy theory and PSO
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to overcome the limitation of traditional single-objective optimal operation method for the multiple energy flows system combined cooling, heat and power (CCHP), this paper presents a multi-objective comprehensive optimization model for CCHP with renewable energy resources and energy storage devices based on the fuzzy theory and PSO. The model utilizes the membership function to fuzzify each objective function. Then linearly weighted sums the objective functions with coefficient of variation method and solve the model by PSO algorithm. The simulation results based on the case of a real district show that compared with traditional optimization method, the comprehensive optimization model established in this paper can take each important performance index into account and effectively optimize the dispatch of energy resources of the CCHP system with renewable energy.

articleTitle: Research and application of 2.4G wireless precise positioning in substation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, all kinds of substations mainly rely on electrical quantity and chemical quantity for device detection. And the analysis method of accident or post-accident is unable to make early-warning for human-error accident. In this paper, different solutions of 2.4G wireless are analyzed. Based on the analysis, a precision indoor positioning method of 2.4G wireless is proposed, which accomplish the real-time position of field operator and the setup of patrol route. Human-error accidents are effectively avoided by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Demand response risk based stochastic power system scheduling considering wind farm wake effect
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing wind farm connected to power system, there is a growing need to study the stochastic power system scheduling (SPSS). This paper proposes a demand response risk based SPSS (DRRbSPSS) framework for quantifying the uncertainty of wind farm from the perspective of economic return and economic risk. In addition, the wake effect is derived by the Jensen model to estimate the wind farm power distribution. Then, an optimization algorithm, evolutionary predator and prey strategy (EPPS) is applied to obtain the optimal trade-off solution. Simulation results based on the modified IEEE 30-bus system prove the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Power supply capability evaluation for unbalanced three-phase distribution network with distributed generators
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the extensive penetration of distributed generators (DGs), especially photovoltaic generators and other intermittent DGs, the intrinsic characteristic of three-phase unbalanced condition of distribution network becomes even more prominent. It brings a new challenge to the evaluation of power supply capability (PSC) for distribution network. The evaluation model of PSC for unbalanced three-phase distribution network with DGs is proposed. In this model with the objective of maximizing the power supply load for distribution network, the operation constraints of bus voltage magnitude, branch current, transformer capacity, packet switch capacitor and three-phase bus voltage unbalance degree are taken into account. An algorithm of quantum particle swarm optimization (QPSO) was put forward to solve this problem. The algorithm uses the advantages of superposition state and probability expression, which improves the ability for global optimization. The simulation results of the modified IEEE33-bus three-phase distribution system show that the proposed model and algorithm are effective.

articleTitle: A distributed voltage stability control method for integrated transmission and distribution grids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: While a large amount of distributed generators (DGs) were integrated into the distribution grid, the transmission grid voltage stability assessment (VSA) had not been suitable to be solved independently. A distributed voltage stability control (DVSC) method for integrated transmission and distribution (T&D) grids was proposed in this paper. The objective function aims to minimize the total control costs of the transmission and distribution grids. The boundary influence factors composed by the dual multipliers are introduced to coordinate the TN VSC sub-problem and DN VSC sub-problem. Those optimal power flow algorithms, by which provide the dual multipliers are generated, are adopted in both TN and DN VSC sub-problems. The equivalent power, the influence factors and the boundary bus voltages are exchanged between the transmission and distribution grids to realize distributed computation. Simulation results on integrated IEEE30 buses transmission and IEEE33 buses distribution system show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Heating network quasi-dynamic model of multi-energy flow system based on forward method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale application of multi-energy flow system (MEFS) brings flexibility and economic benefits. To manage it effectively, analyzing the dynamic power flow and predicting the response is an important work when the mass flow rate and temperature are variable. The steady-state network model does not fully consider the dynamic process of heat transfer. To solve the problem, a quasi-dynamic network model based on forward method is proposed for the heating system in the MEFS. According to the simulation results, the quasi-dynamic model can track dynamic thermal process and transport delay.

articleTitle: A wearable computer wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The article puts forward a kind of interface using wearable computers as intelligent wireless sensor network, and describes the architecture of wireless sensor network (WSN), as well as the design can meet the demand of the network of wearable computer intelligent node, interface of the software system are studied dynamically generated, key problems such as dynamic service load, analyzes the key problems affecting the whole experiment system performance, and proved the feasibility of this wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Scheduling optimization mode of multi-microgrid considering demand response
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper examines operation modes of the multi-microgrid, aiming at unified management of the multi-microgrid through the multi-microgrid control systems (mmcs), which reveal the controllability of the microgrid as source and load in general. The paper puts forward three operation modes including the single microgrid island operation, the multi-microgrid island operation and the grid-connected operation respectively, establishing an economical dispatch model from parts to whole. Furthermore, on account of interactive coordination between microgrids and dg users, a demand response model is employed. What's more, taking a microgrid which consists of various distributed generation (dg) and battery storage (bs) as an example, the paper carries out simulation analysis in detail. The results show that in the proposed operation mode, interaction performs well between microgrids and power grids, microgrids and users, microgrids themselves; The problem of intermittent dg output is solved, which in all show favorable economical efficiency, interactivity and flexibility. Finally, reasonable proposals are suggested for further research of the interactive mode between microgrids and power grids.

articleTitle: Bi-level optimal dispatch model for micro energy grid based on load aggregator business
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Firstly, the Energy Hub model integrated power hub, heating hub and cooling hub is proposed for the micro energy grid. According to it, the specific modeling of the steady state energy flow is carried out. Then, a bi-level optimal dispatch mechanism of micro energy grid is designed with the load aggregator business model. The upper-level is the optimal dispatch layer of dispatch center and the lower-level is the power allocation layer for load aggregators. Case studies are taken on a typical summer day and the model is solved under the time of use pricing mechanism. The optimal dispatch results demonstrate that the modeling method of energy hub and the bi-level optimal dispatch model are general modeling methods for analyzing the energy flow and investigating the optimal operation problem considering demand response.

articleTitle: Simulation and optimization of power supply system based on super capacitor tram
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Super capacitor has the advantages of high power density, fast charging, long service life, and has been widely used in the tram. But the power supply system of super capacitor tram, which uses a large number of power electronic devices, has characteristics of frequently charging, short charging time, and large charging current. Thus, it will bring great harmonics to the power grid. This paper proposes a new treatment measure to decrease harmonics based on single tuned filter, and effect of the novel method is verified in simulation. In the paper, combined with Central China super capacitor tram project, the charging process is simulated, and the negative impact of super capacitor tram on the power quality of the grid is studied, which proves its efficiency. This paper has a certain guiding effect on the theoretical research and concrete implementation of super capacitor tram project in the future.

articleTitle: Optimal operation for CCHP With phase-change energy storage and demand response considerations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy internet and energy system integration with multi-energy complementation are vital developing directions of future energy supply systems. Combined cooling, heating and power(CCHP) realizes the coupling use of various forms of energy, and is one of the fundamental elements of the energy internet. During the concentrated CCHP operation analysis, due to the restriction of the fixed heat-electricity ratio, the coordination of the system and the combustion units will greatly impact the running efficiency of concentrated CCHP. In this paper, optimal operation strategy for the concentrated CCHP with the incorporation of the phase-change energy storage devices is analyzed. The flexible load participating in the demand response is also taken into consideration. On this basis, the economy objective function of CCHP is established and the units' output is scheduled. The results of an example in a micro grid applying CCHP show that the energy consumption is reduced, and the working efficiency of the system is improved.

articleTitle: An optimal operation model of energy internet considering the multi-time-scale stochastic characteristics of renewable energy sources
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources (RES) and strong coupling between electric power systems and other forms of energy, there are vast opportunities and challenges for every practitioner in energy field, especially so many stochastic characteristics to suppress, such as wind, photovoltaic and load demand. This manuscript establishes an integrated optimal operation model of energy internet considering the multi-time-scale stochastic characteristics of RES. Finally, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is applied to the optimization of the proposed model and the simulation results show that the proposed model is correct and effective.

articleTitle: The interaction of gas and electricity hybrid energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the interaction of electric power system and natural-gas hybrid energy internet. The indirect effects of wind power fluctuation on the natural-gas system are studied through the conduction of power-to-hydrogen. Hydrogen produced by electrolytic water can reduce the demand for natural gas. The power system is sensitive to fluctuations in energy prices from the results of the study, but the influence of wind power fluctuation on the natural-gas network is not obvious through the transmission of the electrolytic water device. A modified IEEE 14-bus with 20 nodes natural gas system is presented for analyzing the gas/electric interaction.

articleTitle: Hierarchical optimization control strategy for electric vehicle in active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Coordination managing and controlling the various intermittent energy, energy storage, and controllable load, active distribution network can increase the ability of renewable energy interconnection to distribution network. In this paper, considering the randomness of charging time and the fluctuation of intermittent energy output and load, an electric vehicle charging control strategy based on hierarchical optimization of active distribution network is proposed. On the decision layer, within long-time scale, optimization plan of electric vehicle charging is calculated based on the car charging information, the prediction of load and the intermittent energy on the feeder line. The optimization goal of the charging plan is to reduce the feeder exchange power fluctuation. On the terminal layer, within short-time scale, the charging pile adjusts the charging power in real time according to the feeder control error, so the feeder exchange power will keep stable near the optimal value. Eventually, a case study shows the effectiveness of control strategies.

articleTitle: Analysis and suppression of subsynchronous oscillation of wind farm with doubly fed induction generator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The subsynchronous oscillation may be induced when the wind power is compensated by series capacitor in the double fed wind farm. In order to analyze and restrain the subsynchronous oscillation caused by wind power connecting to the grid through series compensation, this paper establish a model of double fed wind turbine connecting to the grid through series compensation based on the model of the first IEEE standard. The mechanism and characteristics of subsynchronous oscillation are analyzed by eigen root analysis and time domain simulation. This paper adds a damping controller on the rotor side and obtain the frequency of the lowest electrical damping point and the compensation angle by complex torque coefficient method, and then calculate the parameters of phase shift link of SSDC, with the particle swarm intelligence algorithm used to optimize the parameters to restrain SSO and improve the stability of the system. The simulation results show that the suppression effect is very good.

articleTitle: Dynamic and fast electric vehicle charging coordinating scheme, considering V2G based var compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) are viewed as a promising solution to reduce carbon footprint in transportation. However, without proper coordination, a large scale of simultaneous EV charging activities can cause voltage collapse and frequency instability in power systems. In literature, various methods have been proposed for EV charging coordination. Nevertheless, most of them only focus on active power control. More recent researches have considered Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) based var compensation, however, they are based on heuristic methods, which are not computationally efficient and the global optimal cannot be guaranteed. In this paper, a distributed EV charging coordinating scheme is proposed for efficiently coordinating EV charging processes and computing V2G based var capacity. Case studies show that the proposed distributed coordination not only has a similar performance as central coordination in terms of gaining economic benefits, but also takes significantly less computational time than the central coordination.

articleTitle: Analysis of interaction between HVDC and offshore wind power in receiving end grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the interaction characteristics of voltage and frequency between HVDC and offshore wind farm in receiving end power grid. Based on the concept of multi infeed DC interactive influence, propose a fast calculation method for evaluating the interaction. Analyses the interaction between HVDC and offshore wind farm from the electrical distance between them, the equivalent impedance of the access point system, and the control strategy of UHVDC and offshore wind turbines. The results show that the smaller the electrical distance between HVDC and offshore wind power, the greater the equivalent impedance of the access point system, the more obviously interaction effect. It can also get that the control mode of DC inverter side, the reactive power control mode of offshore wind power and the low voltage control strategy have obvious influence on the interaction.

articleTitle: Analysis and verification of a novel current comparison pilot protection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In actual electric power system, the relay protection device plays an important role to maintain its stable operation. This paper proposes a novel current comparison pilot protection principle based on the change of current phase angle. When internal fault occurs, the change direction of current phase angle at two ends of transmission line is opposite. However, when external fault occurs, the change direction of current phase angle at two ends of transmission line is the same. Based on that, the proposed principle can determine internal or external fault correctly. Compared with traditional pilot protection principles, the proposed protection principle has several advantages. In addition, the correctness of the novel pilot protection scheme are verified by using field fault data recorded from 500kV transmission line.

articleTitle: Analysis of micro-grid integration with PV, energy storage and ground-source heat pump based on DeST simulation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, DeST (Designer's Simulation Toolkits) was applied to simulate the energy consumption of the solar heat storage micro-grid system in Shijiazhuang. Based on the mechanical loss, the heat loss, the utilization rate of the delay time, the energy consumption of the ground-source heat pump coupled with the PV array in the micro-grid system was reasonably calculated. In this case, the economic benefit will be greatly improved in the micro-grid area.

articleTitle: A robust and adaptive interharmonics detection method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the active distribution network (ADN), the interharmonic distortion level is aggravated due to the growing penetration of distributed generations and wide application of power electronic loads. The interharmonics, even at a low amplitude level, can cause power quality problems, deteriorate the measurement accuracies of the advanced metering infrastructures, and increase the possibilities of power system oscillations. In this paper, an interharmonic detection method is proposed to effectively detect the interharmonic components of the power system even with the extremely noisy signals using a totally data dependent threshold. This adaptive threshold is determined iteratively based on the statistical character of the background noise bins. Case studies show that the adaptive threshold is robust with severely noisy signal for both the steady-state and dynamic interharmonic conditions.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis of transient angle stability for grid-connected inverter considering droop coefficient
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The droop control method has been widely used in inverter-dominated power system. While the transient stability problem is becoming more prominent under this condition. The transient process of droop-controlled inverter is complex and as a consequence accurate analysis of transient stability is difficult. This paper proposes a quantitative criterion called dissipation character equal area criterion (DCEAC) for droop-controlled inverter's transient angle stability analysis. In this criterion, the complex transient process including droop coefficient's influence and current limitation are considered. As a consequent, the mentioned criterion can get more accurate results than conventional method. Simulation results verified the theoretical findings.

articleTitle: A two-stage robust operation approach for combined cooling, heat and power systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combined cooling, heat and power (CCHP) systems can supply electric and thermal energy to customers. With thermal storage units, energy usage efficiency of the CCHP systems with auxiliary boilers can be improved with low operational costs. However, uncertainty exists in renewable power generation as well as electric and thermal loads which significantly affects the CCHP system operation. Operational limit violation would occur due to errors in predictions of the uncertainty. In this paper, a two-stage robust operation approach is proposed to coordinate the operation of the thermal storage units and the CCHP units with the boilers while satisfying the operational limits. The thermal storage units are dispatched a day ahead in the first stage and the CCHP outputs are dispatched hourly in the second stage. The two-stage operation is coordinated through a robust optimization method with full consideration of the uncertainty. Thus, the second stage CCHP outputs can compensate the first stage thermal storage dispatch without any operational violation. Simulation results indicate high solution robustness against the uncertainty.

articleTitle: A combined AC-DC control strategy for commutation failure mitigation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development and maturity of DC technology, it will have great potential in modern active distribution network, smart grids, micro grids, and energy internets. Commutation Failure (CF) is one of the critical problems for DC system operations. The existing control strategies to mitigate CF focus mainly on the control of DC converters, such as directly controlling the firing angle of the inverter valves. A novel Combined AC-DC control method to mitigate CF is proposed in this study, which integrates the commutation failure preventive (CFPREV) control and DC current prediction and SVC phase separation control modules together. Simulation studies are carried out on the MATLAB/Simulink platform, the results show that the proposed combined AC-DC control strategy can effectively mitigate CFs and improve the dynamic performance of the HVDC system.

articleTitle: Secondary control strategy of islanded micro-grid based on multi-agent consistency
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The technology of virtual synchronous generator has attracted much attention in the field of distributed generation and micro-grid, as it could simulate the internal mechanism and external characteristics of synchronous generator. Affected by the new energy power generation, line impedance, local load and other factors, inverters using the droop control or VSG control (differential regulation) cannot ensure the stable operation of the micro-grid, so the secondary control of frequency and voltage of islanding micro-grid is essential. Aiming at the limitations of centralized and decentralized control, a control method of distributed hierarchical control method based on dynamic consistency algorithm has proposed. The distributed micro sources are equivalent to the agents, and each agent only use local information and adjacent agent's information interaction through the consistency algorithm, then control the P-f curve adaptively by using the PI controller's function, thus the constant frequency and power allocation have been realized. The physical simulation model of micro-grid has established on the MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform, and its performance in different operating conditions is simulated and analyzed, with the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed secondary control method are verified.

articleTitle: Real-time synchronous data visualization for wide area power systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the construction of global energy interconnection, plenty of fluctuating renewable energy access the distribution network, power system dynamic behavior is more complex. The wide-area measurement system light (WAMS Light) records the actual variation of the grid in the distribution network with high accuracy. Exploring the value of high-density, large-scale synchronous data and comprehensive visualization can efficiently reflect the behavior of the system. An open and interactive WAMS Light data visualization platform (WAMSLVP) is built with three-tier structure. WAMSLVP is designed by analysing the function requirements in multi-information fusion, multi-angle analysis, multi-layer integration, program flexible access based on the characteristics of distribution network. And WAMSLVP integrates the frequency, voltage magnitude, angle phase and other power information with the non-power information as multiple layers to compositive display based on geographic information system (GIS), facilitating the dispatchers simultaneously capture multiple information from different analysis just by a glance.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling and control of a plate heat exchanger
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Heat exchangers have a predominant role in heat transfer and constitute a key component of integrated energy systems. For instance, heating and cooling of fluids are the cornerstone of district heating systems. Thus, it is fundamental to understand the heat exchanger's dynamic behavior to design controllers which are robust to temperature variations. Following this line, this paper presents a dynamic model of a plate type heat exchanger. The model is obtained from first principles of energy transfer and fluid mechanics and describes the thermal behavior of fluids involved in the heat transfer process. Although the system is non-linear, system linearization is performed to obtain a frequency domain model suitable for control system design. The linear model is implemented in MATLAB to design a controller that regulates the cold stream outlet temperature. To assess its effectiveness, the controller is discretized, programmed in Python and implemented in Apros - an advanced process commercial simulation software. Simulation results show that the controller is capable of tracking reference temperatures while ensuring a good performance of the heat exchanger system.

articleTitle: Transmission switching considering short-circuit current limitations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the growing expansion of the power system, transmission network is now facing an increasingly serious threat of short-circuit current (SCC). This paper proposes an optimal transmission switching model considering both single-phase and three-phase SCC limitation constraints. In the model, both three-phase and single-phase SCC limitations are considered as constraints, which are formed in nonlinear formulation with sparse technology. The corresponding solution strategy is also proposed based on Benders decomposition. The mixed integer linear master problem is formed by linear relaxation of the SCC limitation constraints. The SCC violation caused by linearization error is then checked by the nonlinear subproblem. The optimal solution is obtained when the violation is diminished by iterations between master and subproblem. The applicability of the proposed model and solution method are assessed on IEEE 118-bus test system.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of integrated control instrument for micro synchronous generation unit
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Micro synchronous generation unit is a laboratory scale equipment to model the realistic behavior of a real generator set, control of which determines the operating state of the simulation system directly. This paper presents an integrated control instrument for micro synchronous generator (ICIMSG). ICIMSG integrates signal processing unit and power amplifying unit, realizing control functions such as generator starting and braking, automatic frequency regulation, automatic generator-voltage control (AVR) and automatic quasi-synchronizing paralleling. Light synchronized phasor measurement unit (PMU Light) is employed to monitor the generator set. Real-time operation information including frequency, voltage phasor and current phasor can be sent from PMU Light to ICIMSG through the internet. Appropriate software was developed on server to communicate with ICIMSG in a two-way manner through WiFi network. ICIMSG's real-time control and analysis capabilities provide a platform not only for innovative research ideas, but also for teaching general power system engineering concepts to students via physical experiments. All functions of ICIMSG proposed were tested on physical micro synchronous generator sets.

articleTitle: Research on optimal electrification selection and sequence scheme model of city's bus routes
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicle has been under much concern recently. Buses are much more controllable and easier to be studied due to centralized dispatch management compared with private vehicles and taxis. This paper firstly analyze the process of e-bus operation, and a Monte Carlo simulation method is adopted to simulate e-buses running and estimate charging load profile of a selected bus route considering some factors including temperature, traffic flow condition and weather condition, et al. An optimal electrification selection and sequence scheme model of city's bus routes is established to make electrification decision. Finally, a case study is carried out to test the performance of proposed model.

articleTitle: A research on information value in energy internet based on risk theory
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to massive information springs up during the course of running all the time in the Energy Internet, the study of the value of Energy Internet information not only helps to tap the value of information itself, but also plays a very important significance for information value-added services. This paper will firstly classify all the information above. Based on the information-value theory of information economics, a new information value assessment method is proposed. Considering different stakeholders have different value evaluation criteria and risk appetite, it is necessary to research on the value of Energy Internet information based on risk aversion theory. The selection and analysis of effective and valuable information will greatly improve the operation and management efficiency of Energy Internet. Finally, the results of simulation and tests verify the effectiveness of the proposed method of the novel. Comparing with traditional value assessment method, the novel method not only considers the risk factors of information itself, but also the risk appetite of investors, thus it has wider application scenarios.

articleTitle: Wind-CHP generation aggregation with storage capability of district heating network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The strong coupling of electricity and heat of combined heat and power (CHP) unit in cold season results in the loss of flexibility, which may cause massive wind power curtailment if they are in the same system. This issue could be handled with the thermal storage capability of a district heating network (DHN) that could supply flexibility for CHP to decouple the strong coupling of heat and electric power supplies. In this paper, a wind-CHP generation aggregation(WCGA) model is formulated, which motivates CHP to increase wind power integration by increasing total profit of the system, while considering the additional flexibility supplied by DHN. In WCGA model, DHN is formulated as an energy-storage-like (ESL) model that considers the storage capability of DHN based on dynamic characteristics of temperature and time delay effect of DHN. The potential benefits of the proposed model have been demonstrated by case study in terms of enhancing, wind power integration as well as total profit.

articleTitle: Economic analysis of multi-energy virtual power plant considering market information
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated Energy System is beneficial for promoting the distributed renewable energy (DRE) consumption, thereby alleviating environmental pollution and energy shortage. In this paper, we propose a virtual power plant (VPP) structure considering the feature of heat and electric power system integration, which is defined as Multi-energy Virtual Power Plant (MVPP). MVPP is allowed to participate in the electricity market; and price information from bulk power market can affect heating system through the coupling devices, thus optimizing the co-operation of electric and heat system. MVPP is also involved in the auxiliary service market, a penalty term is designed for the Utility to charge MVPP service fee so that power fluctuation on transmission line can be reduced. The case study proved the effectiveness of the penalty term and MVPP is able to provide reserve service for Utility in peak load hours by multi-energy flow coupling under the regulation of feed-in tariff.

articleTitle: Research on prediction of energy demand in China based on grey theory and system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy is a key material basis for economic development and social progress and an important factor affecting human living environment. It is of great significance to scientifically and rationally predict energy supply in China for the formulation of energy policy and promotion of energy strategy in China. Based on the analysis of the current situation of energy supply and demand in China, the grey prediction model is used to predict and calculate the benchmark parameters. The system dynamics of energy supply and demand in China is modeled and the baseline scenario and high-tech scenario are set; the energy supply and demand is predicted and analyzed for long-term; as technological progress is the key to solve energy problems in China, it is imperative to propose energy transformation in China and give the corresponding policy recommendations.

articleTitle: Study on power fluctuation suppression of DFIG based on super capacitor energy storage
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the renewable energy sources such as wind power, high permeability of wide time scale power fluctuations inhibition of the hot issues, this paper presents a super capacitor charge and discharge power regulation of voltage state feedback control strategy for wind power active power fluctuation in two-way quickly and accurately adjust, effectively control the output power fluctuations in short time scales; Is analyzed. Studying control combined with super capacitor voltage state, by reducing load control to set aside more than power, when the super capacitor voltage is too low or too high for auxiliary power regulation, optimization of super capacitor energy management, and realize the wide time scale inhibition of power fluctuations. Articles in by establishing consists of DFIG, dc double l/buck converter, the super capacitor energy storage unit model, on the basis of by a three doubly-fed wind power generator (DFIG) wind farm.

articleTitle: Improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to multi-objective optimization energy hub model with P2G and energy storage
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an Energy hub mathematical model with power-to-gas(P2G), energy storage, CCHP and electric energy feedback is constructed. Considering the factors such as the rate structure and uncertainty of wind power output, the energy hub model takes the minimum fuel cost of energy hub operation and the minimum interactive energy costs with power grid as the optimization objective to optimize. In order to solve the high dimension complex problem, an improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed to solve the optimization problem, with the consideration of the bad experience during the speed update, the repeated search to the worst position is avoided., the search efficiency of the algorithm is improved and the proof is carried out; By adopting the global optimal solution selection strategy based on the interval and the optimal selection strategy, it can obtain the approximate Pareto front end which is better than the convergence and diversity of the basic MOPSO algorithm. The feasibility of the model and the effectiveness of the improved algorithm are verified by an example.

articleTitle: The Kriging model based scenario generation and its application in the energy internet with high wind penetration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a scenario generation method based on Kriging model is proposed to describe the wind uncertainty in the Energy Internet. It uses the “forecast bin” method to generate a large number of scenario samples. Kriging model is used to estimate the operational cost of the corresponding scenario. Then, an importance sampling method based on the Kriging model is used to select the scenario samples. This method considered the wind power uncertainty and the influence of uncertainty on the objective function. Finally, an Energy Internet with ten units is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Compared with the probability analysis method, it can see that the proposed method has better economy, stability and reliability on the problem of Energy Internet.

articleTitle: Inverter turn-off angle control optimization of UHVDC with hierarchical connection to AC grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Advanced DC transmission technology is an important basis for building global energy Internet in the future. It is the main scheme to solve the problem of large power capacity long distance transnational or intercontinental transmission. In order to improve the receiving system of large scale power consumptive ability, The usage of UHVDC with hierarchical connection to AC grid technology has been extended in a wide range. However, due to the coupling relationship between the hierarchical DC inverter side, the traditional control strategy in inverter side easily leads to an commutation failure of converter valves on non-fault level when AC power system failure occurs on the other voltage level. This single fault causes fast conduction in different voltage levels through DC system, and the power grid will show fault characteristics in different voltage levels simultaneously, which expands the influence scope. This paper presents an improved inverter turn-off angle control strategy. Commutation failure preventive control parameters in logic were optimized through formula derivation and simulation analysis methods, which can ensure the stable operation of converter valve on non-fault level, and avoids the occurrence of simultaneous commutation failure on both voltage level. Electromechanical and electromagnetic hybrid simulation with practical planning power system is taken based on ADPSS software and the effectiveness is proved.

articleTitle: Real-time energy management in a community energy internet with CHP and PV prosumers considering the CVaR values
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper puts forward a real-time energy management model for the community Energy Internet (CEI) based on the demand side response. The community Energy Internet consists of CHP system and PV prosumers considering automatic demand response abilities. Firstly, the structure and trading mode of the CEI are introduced. Secondly, the energy management optimization model is proposed considering the stochastic characteristics of the parameters in the CEI, and the objectives consider the costs of all periods and the CVaR value in the future periods. Thirdly, a multi-scenario determination method based on probability distribution of prediction error is also proposed. In the end, the validity of the proposed model is verified from the aspects of optimizing system net load characteristic and prosumers' costs, etc., through the case study.

articleTitle: Prediction of short-term output of photovoltaic system based on generalized regression neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The accurate prediction of photovoltaic (PV) power generation is of great significance to power grid scheduling and the optimal operation of PV power plants. To improve the PV power forecasting accuracy, the paper first builds a weather category clustering identification model using Kohonen neural network method. By calculating the appropriate weights and Euclidean distance, the weather categories of data samples of the PV system are recognized. Secondly, for each weather type, the paper establishes corresponding GRNN forecasting models termed as Model 1-4 to predict the PV power output under different climate conditions. Finally, Model 1-4 are trained and tested with the four kinds of actual operation datasets. Besides, a global model named Model 5 using datasets without weather classification is also established to compare the prediction accuracy with and without weather type classification. The predicted values of the five types of models and the actual operating outputs of the PV power station are compared. The comparison results show good prediction precision and verifies the effectiveness of weather idenfication model and proves the rationality of the processing of data. Thus, the developed models combining the clustering recognition model can effectively achieve the short-term prediction of photovoltaic power under various types of weather conditions and have good applicability.

articleTitle: A source-grid-load coordinated control method considering the integration of wind power generation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The grid-connection of large-scale wind farm may affect the stability of power system because of the randomness and uncertainty, while unified power flow controller (UPFC) could be used to stabilize the system on account of its capability of power flow and demand response (DR) is capable of adjusting load capacity flexibly. This paper proposes a source-grid-load coordinated control method for wind power system. In this methodology, traditional generation units and wind power plants are integrated as source side, the UPFC is utilized to regulate the power flow as grid side and the interruptible load and incentive load response to the DR signal as load side. The UPFC structure diagram is explained and its series compensation function is served as main measure to realize the power flow regulation without considering the UPFC model of shunt side. The presented model schedules the air conditioner (AC), water heater (WH) and electric vehicle (EV) without deterioration of the consumers' comfort preferences and their aggregated demand response potential (DRP) is quantified to restrain the responsive power of interruptible load and incentive load. To verify the performance of the presented approach, simulations are performed in IEEE-RTS 79 system. The results indicate that the considerable benefits can be realized by coordinating the generation units, UPFC and DR to improve the wind power utilization and reduce the generation costs.

articleTitle: Comparison of modeling methods of dynamic economic dispatch with stochastic wind power integration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Main challenges brought by large scale wind power integration to economic dispatch model is how to deal with randomness of wind power, how to decline its influence to optimal dispatch of power system. Modeling is the core step to optimal dispatch of power system with large-scale wind integration. Therefore, we review several typical modeling methods in economic dispatch with wind power integration. Furthermore, dispatch simulation on IEEE 39-bus system and a real provincial power system is performed. Comparison study on six modeling methods of stochastic dynamic economic dispatch with wind power integration, and 3 evaluation indices are used to analysis these models. The simulation results show that a fast solution to small-sized model is enough when the accuracy requirement of dispatching not high; An accurate solution with high-performance computing clusters can be performed when the dispatch center has brilliant compiling environments.

articleTitle: Disturbance propagation in power system based on an epidemic model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Study the dynamic behavior of disturbance propagation is of great importance for the safety and stability of power system. The dynamic analysis of the disturbance of the power system attempts to use an mature epidemic model of biology and open a new path to the dynamics of disturbance propagation. In this paper, based on the analogy epidemic model and the propagation of the grid disturbance, the concept of disturbance propagation intensity was put forward. Furthermore, the complex network theory was used to analyze the complex network topology of the power system, and the random matrix theory was used to analyze the relationship between the spatial and temporal data in power system. At last, the dynamic model of disturbance propagation in power system based on data-driven was established. The simulation shows that the proposed model can effectively supplement the traditional power system disturbance propagation analysis, and can analyze the dynamic behavior of power system.

articleTitle: A transformer fault diagnosis method based on sub-clustering reduction and multiclass multi-kernel support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of big data technology to the equipment asset management helps to enhance the operational reliability of the energy system. This paper is focused on transformer fault diagnosis using support vector machine (SVM), one of the most commonly used data-mining methods. The direct multiclass SVM model is capable of obtaining a single classification function and avoids the difficulties of designing multiple groups of model parameters. However, when dealing with mass samples, the direct model will lead to low training efficiency and curse of dimensionality. To make the direct multiclass SVM-based transformer fault diagnosis not subject to the sample size limit, the sample reduction algorithm based on K-medoids clustering is introduced. Before multiclass SVM training, potential support vectors can be extracted from the large-scale training set via sub-clustering method, which improves the calculation efficiency. Multi-kernel learning is also applied to the SVM model to further boost the classification performance. The effectiveness and application prospect of the proposed method are verified in case study.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of impacts of high penetration distributed generation integration in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an effective supplement to centralized renewable sources, distributed generation (DG) will be greatly developed in the future in China. The DG penetration rate is becoming higher and higher in power system distribution network in recent years. With the high proportion of DG, the power quality, protection and control of the distribution network will be affected. The impacts of DG from five aspects, such as power supply reliability, harmonic level, line loss rate, voltage qualification rate and short circuit current level are mainly studied in this paper. To quantitatively evaluate the impacts, an index system of the impacts of high penetrative DG is adopted, and the quantitative model and calculation method of each evaluation index are proposed. Furthermore, a comprehensive assessment model based on the combination of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and entropy method is established in this paper to determine the weights of indices. Considering different penetration rates of DGs, the comprehensive evaluation model is calculated based on a test distribution system. The results are presented and analyzed to illustrate the usefulness of proposed model.

articleTitle: Coordinated optimal control strategy for multi-energy microgrids considering P2G technology and demand response
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy sources (RES) like photovoltaic (PV) power and wind turbine (WT) have the characteristics of uncontrollability and volatility. On top of that, the existence of plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) and responsive demand have greatly increased the difficulty of the power grid to control. In this paper, the microgrid optimization model is formulated, including power-to-gas (P2G) and combined cooling and heating (CHP) technique as well as highly permeable WT and PV, taking the interest of both supply and demand sides into account and minimizing the system cost as its objective function. The model employs the Monte Carlo method to simulate RES output, then reduction and integrity are conducted based on K-medoids under the stochastic scenarios to get the classic all-standing WT scenario. Test results show that regularly used PHEV works synergistically with RES in different scenarios with robustness, which can effectively reduce the system operating cost and increase the utilization of RES.

articleTitle: An integrated design platform for BIPV system considering building information
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the current practice, in order to meet the design concerns from multiple disciplines Building Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) design normally involves multiple but isolated design processes. Each process needs to maintain a fraction set of, sometimes inconsistent models of, the whole BIPV. As a result of the isolation, the seamless integration, one of the prime goals of BIPV software design, becomes very difficult to be achieved. This paper presents a software platform regarding BIPV design and analysis by expanding Building Information Modelling (BIM) with the domain-specific models regarding photovoltaic systems, The resulting software platform, i.e. Extended Building Information Model, allows BIPV, in the planning phase, to be designed with the support of an uniform model and avoids the needs to maintain the different models across the different design stages of BIPV. The designed platform provides the analysis modules when integrating photovoltaic system into building construction: shadow and radiation analysis and electrical power analysis. A practical case application is employed to testify this platform.

articleTitle: Optimal planning of building integrated photovoltaic system in urban energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Urban Energy Internet based on urban distribution network integrates various forms of energy sources and internet participants. It is crucial for different participants to agree on specific technical standards as well as planning objectives. Since the siting and sizing of BIPV system may have significant influence on its independent power producer and local electric power supply company, a coordinated planning is undoubtedly required to balance the interests of related parties. Firstly, this research carries out an analytical method based on power circle diagram to generate sets of siting and sizing solutions. Secondly, an optimal planning model is proposed considering bilateral interests of related parties to obtain the optimal capacity of BIPV and its access position. A practical case study is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on risk analysis and security testing technology of mobile application in power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)

articleTitle: Key technologies and development prospect of urban energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the expanding of city scale, the energy have become increasingly strained. The outbreak of energy crisis and environmental problem restricts the development of the city seriously, and urban energy internet emerges as the times require. It combines the energy in the city (such as coal, oil, natural gas, wind, solar, electricity and other kinds of energy) through the efficient conversion of energy and the close integration of power grid network, traffic network and natural gas network. From the point of the urban energy development, electricity-centric city energy internet model is built. From the point of planning and operating, the key technologies for urban energy internet construction including active distribution grid, clean energy and electric power replacement, business model innovation are put forward. The development direction of turban energy internet is proposed, which can provide some ideas for energy transformation of the city.

articleTitle: A framework research of power distribution equipment condition monitoring cloud platform based on RESTful web service
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of smart grid and internet of things has been promoted with the development of modern information and communication technology. Taking the internet of things technology framework as a break-through point, this paper study and design a cloud platform of internet of things for power distribution equipment condition monitoring. Here we use smart meters and smart sensors at the end of platform for real-time acquisition including operational parameters and environmental parameters of power distribution equipment, and implement the data transmission through the GPRS wireless network. Besides, we deploy the web application developed by ASP .NET Web API following the RESTful web service specification on the cloud server, which can provide advanced services such as operational monitoring, asset management and data visualization. The cloud platform we propose is fully decoupling in background and front development and super lightweight in architecture while the mobile monitoring is also considered at the same time, which is potential in improving the intelligence and management precision of distribution grid.

articleTitle: Hybrid approximate dynamic programming approach for dynamic optimal energy flow in the integrated gas and power systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid approximate dynamic programming (ADP) approach for the multiple time-period optimal power flow in integrated gas and power systems. ADP successively solves Bellman's equation to make decisions according to the current state of the system. So, the updated near future forecast information is not fully utilized. While model predictive control (MPC) as a look ahead policy can integrate the updated forecast in the optimization process. The proposed hybrid optimization approach makes full use of the advantages of ADP and MPC to obtain a better solution by using the real-time updated forecast information. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Two-stage stochastic optimization for hybrid AC/DC microgrid embedded energy hub
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To enhance the interaction between the thermal and electrical, a hybrid AC/DC microgrid (MG) embedded energy hub (EH) is proposed. In EH, electrical, thermal, i.e. heat and cooling are supplied and managed to increase the operational efficiency while meeting the energy demand. It formulates a two-stage stochastic optimization problem. In the first stage, i.e. day-ahead operation, the hourly generation, conversion, and storage are optimized to minimize the fuel cost. In the second stage, considering the stochastic nature of photovoltaic and demand, the heat and cooling supply are adjusted to realize the power balancing in the electrical system, while meeting the thermal energy demand. The two-stage optimization problem is reformulated to a deterministic optimization problem, using sample average approximation. Simulations have been carried out on the test system. Results have verified the effectiveness of the proposed method, collecting the flexibility of the thermal system to the electrical networks via EH.

articleTitle: Unit commitment considering demand response behavior based on utility maximization
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The active participation of demand side resources in power grid operation not only benefits the individual participant but also benefits the whole system. The optimal goal can promote by excavating the active behaviors of demand side. The welfare maximization of market participant is the driving force of such active behaviors. Considering the independence of each user's behavior, the consumer's utility function is selected to depict consumer's preference and demand response behavior. In order to coordinate the consumers' maximum welfare with social welfare maximization, consumers' utility function and units' operation cost are integrated into Unit Commitment (UC) model. The objective function is to maximize social welfare, by subtracting units' operation cost from consumers' total utility, and this objective can be acquired. Considering the proposed model should be solved in a distributed manner, the idea of the centralized coordination and the decentralized decision-making is proposed. Based on the Lagrangian relaxation (LR) principle and distributed real-time pricing scheme, a closed-loop feedback mechanism is constructed to reflect the relationship among generator output, price level, and load demand. The ten generating units example can illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A modelling and optimization toolkit for integrated urban energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents optimization of CCHP system on their design and operation in the integrated energy planning for an urban district of an Economic&Technological Development Zone in Hangzhou City. This district planning aims to establish a national-level smart microgrid pilot project for the application of renewable and clean energy including solar, geothermal and natural gas, etc., and four scenarios have been analyzed, based on which the answer to the question of how different types of technology mix meet the local energy service requirements under different circumstances is given. A range of technologies have been considered as alternative supply side technologies as they are thought suitably representative of the generic commercial alternatives currently available in China. Results of the optimization are described by four scenarios, showing that a potential reduction in net present value, primary energy saving and GHG emissions of up to 30.5% and 47.6% and 60.5% respectively are available by installation of roof-top PV, GSHP, natural gas-based CCHP and storage systems.

articleTitle: Demand side management in residential areas using geographical information system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Smart grid is a conventional electric grid with intelligence added to it, while incorporating IT and communication infrastructure. With the emergence of new technologies, the grid is becoming even more intelligent. Visualization techniques are one of such tools which are widely used for adding intelligence to the grid. In this paper, a distributed intelligent system has been proposed, which uses GIS for displaying data from the grid on the geographical map, in real-time scenario. A prototype of the dashboard, for a residential microgrid comprising of 7600, has been created using ArcGIS and QGIS. With the implementation of communication and IT infrastructure in electric grid, the challenges pertaining to data security and privacy issues have taken plight. The authors of this paper have also proposed a method for authentication of data and authorization of users of the system.

articleTitle: A corrective security-constrained optimal power flow method for AC/DC hybrid systems based on MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents an optimal power flow (OPF) model for AC/DC meshed networks with Modular Multilevel Converter based High Voltage Direct Current (MMC-HVDC) system. The OPF problem is formulated to minimize the total network loss of the whole AC/DC grids by adjusting generators and modular multilevel converters considering N-1 constraints and post-contingency corrective control. A practical method is proposed to handle N-1 static security constraints and corrective control with OPF more effectively. Simulations are conducted on IEEE 39-bus testing system and a practical power grid. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Research on business model and value-added services of electric power substitution
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China is energy production and consumption country, in which economic development is faced with resources shortage and serious environmental pollution, and energy security is a great threat at the same time. Actively promoting the substitution of electricity for fossil fuels such as coal and petroleum will help to improve the efficiency of energy and reduce environmental pollution. At the same time, it is of great significance for easing energy security issues. Alternative energy strategy advocates “electricity instead of coal, electricity instead of oil, and electricity consumption from far away”, which is conducive to promote energy-saving emission reduction, promote the development of new energy, reduce the energy consumption of economic development, and promote economic and environmental quality. In accordance with “national power enterprises further promote the implementation of views of electric power substitution (EPS)”, and “national power enterprises further promote the implementation of EPS notice”, the paper deeply studies business model of EPS, from the external market environment, strategic positioning, business system, key resource capacity, profit model and cash flow. First of all, the paper analyzes current status of EPS, and researches on business model and implementation steps. Then the paper analyzes contract energy management (CEM) business model, and deeply researches on participation, benefit distribution and scope of energy-saving benefit sharing, energy-saving effect guarantee, energy expenses entrusting. Finally, the paper discusses value-added services (VAS) provided by the power enterprises, including three aspects, which are energy efficiency improvement service, electricity diagnosis service and energy saving transformation service.

articleTitle: Learning from time-synchronized power system measurements with rare anomalous event records to detect PMU data manipulation attacks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: PMU data manipulation attacks (DMA) which maliciously modify the synchrophasor measurements in power systems, is an emerging type of cyber-attack aiming to mislead the control center into taking erroneous control actions. Widespread application of PMU produces a vast amount of time-synchronized historical operating data, making it possible to turn to machine learning approaches to detect the attacks. However, anomalous events occur rarely in practice. To construct a balanced training dataset, where normal and anomalous instances need to be evenly extracted and labeled from historical operating records, is sure to cost plenty of human efforts and may introduce uncontrollable experience errors. In this paper, we design a novel detection model with Synthetic Minority Over-sampling TEchnique (SMOTE)-based data augmentation and Edited Nearest Neighbors (ENN)-based data cleaning technique to reconstruct the imbalanced training dataset into a balanced one to train the subsequent XGBoost classifier. Experiments show that although rare anomalous historical event records are needed, our model is still able to effectively detect out DMAs in power systems.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of secondary controlled virtual synchronous generator with dynamic droop for microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a dynamic droop mechanism is proposed to damp the synchronizing oscillation that exists in a virtual synchronous generator based distributed generator system without varying the steady-state active-power-loop droop coefficient. In order to eliminate the steady-state error introduced due to load changes or generator trips, a distributed secondary controller based on extremum seeking is employed so that microgrid frequency can be restored to nominal value. Besides, the small-signal model of virtual synchronous generator system is presented under d-q reference frame where virtual synchronous generator is deployed as a PV node. Moreover, the linearized system model of virtual synchronous generator with dynamic droop mechanism is derived and its advantage is discussed. Finally, a modified IEEE 14 bus microgrid system is established in Matlab/Simulink platform. Simulation results demonstrate the validity and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research and application of subtilized customer clustering algorithm in power marketing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Customer oriented diversification service lacks effective and accurate grouping under the background of the new electricity reform. In this paper, a logic regression model based on probability clustering is proposed to realize the refinement of the grouping of arrears risk in the electricity risk prevention and control business. Through the analysis and positioning of customer groups, refining, induction, and segment customer characteristics, it can achieve the purpose of customer refinement. And then develop a precise differentiation service strategies and effect evaluation method. Example analysis shows that the practical conditions of the model are already available, and the model can be used as an important support for high quality service and lean management of power grid.

articleTitle: Synergetic control strategy for interconnected distribution network via AC/DC/AC converter improving renewable energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the growing penetration of Renewable Energy Sources (RESs) in the distribution network, the power flow maybe feedback to the superior grid during the peak generation hour of RESs. This does not fit the current technology of protection system, which may result in fault operation. To solve this problem, a new interconnection structure via AC/DC/AC converter for neighboring low voltage distribution network is proposed in this paper. A synergetic control strategy is proposed along with this new interconnection framework to improve the consumption of RESs. The synergetic control strategy is composed of two innovative parts, the buffer threshold based mode switching method and the control command solver. Finally, the proposed framework and algorithm are validated through the simulations.

articleTitle: Research on optimal configuration model of city's bus route electrification
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Nowadays public transportation electrification process has been under impassioned discussion. As the main and important part combining power network and transportation network, the public transportation electrification is not only a necessary road to build low-carbon and green city but also a key to realize energy internet. With high penetration of electric buses(e-buses), the charging load would has significant impact on distribution network. This paper firstly investigates the characteristic about bus operation and proposes an optimal configuration model of city's bus route electrification considering ordinary and fast charging modes. Next, a case study is carried out to prove the validity of proposed method. Finally, the paper concludes results and recommends some future's research scopes.

articleTitle: An AC/DC alternating power flow algorithm based on forward-backward sweep method for the distribution network with SST
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Solid state transformer(SST) is an energy flow operation device of Energy Internet, in order to research the operation of SST and its effect on the power flow calculation in distribution network, an AC/DC alternating power flow algorithm based on forward-backward sweep method(FBSM) for the distribution network with SST(DNWS) is proposed. In this paper, the steady-state model and control methods of SST are analyzed in detail. Then, the DNWS is partitioned into three parts: AC system 1 connected to SST, SST and AC system 2 connected to SST according to its structural features. In this network, the overall distribution of power flow is calculated by the algorithm in which the DC power flow calculation is nested in the AC power flow calculation that is based on FBSM. Elaborating the ability of power flow regulation of SST and SST's control methods, the algorithm can calculate the control variables and state variables of SST and can take into account the SST loss more accurately. Finally, the validity and correctness of the algorithm are verified by the example results.

articleTitle: Short-term wind power probabilistic forecasting considering spatial correlation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power probabilistic forecasting is of great significance to the operation and dispatch of the power system. However, most researches have focused on how to predict wind power using local information rather than spatial correlation information of multiple wind farms in a region. In this paper a short-term wind power probabilistic forecasting approach considering spatial correlation is proposed. Originally, a set of explanatory variables highly correlated with the target variable is selected by calculating mutual information. Next, the principal component analysis can help to reconstruct the data and reduce the dimension of the explanatory variables. Finally, the conditional kernel density estimation is introduced to predict the short-term wind power of the target wind farm. Case studies on the dataset of Global Energy Forecasting Competition 2014 verify that the proposed approach can achieve better performance than traditional approach.

articleTitle: Performance optimization and evaluation of V2G in regulated and deregulated microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an economic dispatch model with probabilistic modeling is developed for regulated microgrid. Due to the fluctuation of solar and wind plants' output, an empirical probabilistic model is applied to predict their hourly output.
