According to distinctive characteristics of wind and solar plants, the parameters for probabilistic distribution are further adjusted individually for both type of power plants. On the other hand, with the growing trend of Plug-in Electric Vehicle (PEV), an integrated microgrid system must also consider the impact of PEVs. Not only the charging loads from PEVs, but also the discharging output via Vehicle to Grid (V2G) method can greatly affect the economic dispatch for all the micro energy sources in microgrid. Firstly, this paper presents an optimization method for economic dispatch in regulated microgrid. Simulation is also performed to evaluate the performance of V2G in deregulated energy trading market. In this case, the trading market is considered as a noncooperative game. The simulation results in both cases reveal that PEVs with V2G capability can be an indispensable supplement in modern microgrid.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of active distribution network based on demand respond theory
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable power source into the distribution network, maintaining system reliability has been a challenging issue due to the uncertainty and volatility characteristics of renewable power source. Based on the robust optimization theory, this paper proposed a multi-stage robust optimal scheduling of active distribution to maintain the voltage within the allowed range as well as develop the operation of distribution network. This methodology applies the demand responds method into the model in order to make full advantage of elastic load adjustment. The proposed method is accomplished in three phases. In the first stage, in order to determine the uncertain parameters, renewable energy output uncertainty is described by uncertain set. Meanwhile, the extreme scenario method is adopted to cut down the field of sets. In the second stage, the elastic load is used to moderate the load fluctuation by applying demand respond theory. In the third stage, based on the bi-level planning, distributed generation's (DG's) reactive output adjustment cooperates with traditional voltage regulation method, which reduces the regulating times of switching device operations and system network loss. Furthermore, the economy and stability of system operation improve significantly. Finally, the efficiency of the built model is analyzed using the PG&E 69-bus system.

articleTitle: Enhancing the damping ability of wide-area power system by employing time delay
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Time delay in wide-area damping control has been a big barrier in engineering application of power system stabilizer (PSS) based on wide-area measurement system (WAMS). Unlike conventional viewpoint that time delay is detrimental to system stability and should be disposed of or compensated additionally, in this paper, time delay is considered essentially neutral and introduced into the proposed wide-area PSS structure. By employing the extra time delay in the wide-area PSS to make the total time delay of a control loop match the optimal value, the lead-lag compensation block can be removed from the classical PSS, and the damping effect will be enhanced remarkably under a definite feedback gain. Simulation results on the 10-machine 39-bus New England test power system confirm the concept that a delicately designed time delay can be beneficial to system stability. The wide-area PSS employing delay matching block performs satisfyingly in low-frequency oscillation suppression under constant and random time delays for a wide range.

articleTitle: Operation and correlation of VSC-based technologies in city center power grids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of urbanization, the power consumption in cities is increased, and the distribution of power equipment and power load is also more concentrated. However, the city power grids normally suffer from uneven power flow distribution and high short-circuit current level. In cases of peak load periods, some substation transformers may encounter overload conditions while some nearby transformers are only lightly loaded. Such a dilemma may be solved by the use of power electronics devices based on voltage source converters (VSC) technologies. VSC technologies are capable of optimizing the system power flow and provide fast and flexible control capability. The paper studies the viability of applying VSC in urban grid transmission systems, and further considers the correlations of VSC based HVDC links and FACTS devices.

articleTitle: Dynamics investigation of flywheel energy storage system in discharge mode for future energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An investigation on bursting dynamics in a voltage-current dual-loop controlled Flywheel Energy Storage System (FESS) operating in discharge mode is presented in this paper, providing novel insights into the effect of two-timescale characteristics on the safety and stability of energy conversion and transmission of FESS. Based on singular perturbation theory, a two-timescale approach is proposed to separate the FESS into the fast and slow subsystems. Stability analysis of the transient fixed points indicates that the FESS shifts from the spiking state to the quiescent state when the slow variables cross the bifurcation point of the fast subsystem. Mechanism analysis reveals that the root cause of the bursting dynamics is the voltage instability of the FESS. Moreover, the stability boundaries of key parameters are derived, and application requirements of the proposed approach are also discussed, guiding the extension of the approach to engineering applications and dynamics analysis. Constant voltage discharge experiment is performed based on the FESS test bench built in Key Laboratory of Smart Grid of Ministry of Education, Tianjin University, which validates the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Low frequency voltage fluctuations in electrical vehicle-grid system based on Luenberger-observer's multivariable control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Vehicle-grid system voltage fluctuation frequently occurred when multiple EMUs are put into operation simultaneously. The phenomenon often lead serious voltage distortions, even bring about electrical locomotives traction blockades. Aiming at this phenomenon, the Luenberger observer's multivariable control strategy (LOMC) is adopted on CRH3 electric multiple units (EMUs) in this paper. First of all, the LOMC main structure is deduced and researched. Secondly, the main part of the control system can be deduced by mathematical method to obtain the optimal control parameters. Thirdly, established the state space model and calculated the feedback matrix. At last, the vehicle-grid system simulation model and tested simulation are established by putting parameters into the model. It is proved that the LOMC has better dynamic characteristics and effectively reduce fluctuation of the traction network.

articleTitle: Formal modeling and verification of flexible load control for power grid CPS based on differential dynamic logic
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a formal modeling and verification method of CPS flexible load control strategy based on differential dynamic logic theory. HybridUML is used to construct the model for critical control process of flexible load in power grid. Based on the differential dynamic logic theory, the formalization protocol is created using the automatic hybrid reasoning tool KeYmaera, and the differential dynamic logic calculus rules are applied to formalize the system attributes. The effectiveness of the method is verified by instantiating the typical application scenario of flexible load.

articleTitle: Probabilistic static voltage stability evaluation of microgrid with droop-controlled distributed generations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Islanded microgrids is vulnerable to instability owing to its small scale and low inertia. To analysis the probabilistic static voltage stability of islanded microgrids with droop-controlled distributed generations (DG), a method based on singular value decomposition and probabilistic load flow is adopted. The deterministic load flow model of the islanded microgrid is presented considering the philosophy of droop-controlled DGs and static voltage/frequency characteristics of loads. Newton-Raphson approach is adopted to solve the flow equations. Through singular value decomposition of Jacobian matrix of the load flow calculation, the minimum singular value can be obtained as the index of static voltage stability for IMG. And the right singular vector corresponding to the minimum singular value is also analyzed to indicate the sensitive voltages and areas. Monte Carlo method is performed to simulate the stochastic characteristics of intermittent DG output and load power and the probabilistic characteristics of minimum singular value as well as the right singular vector are obtained. The proposed method is verified on an islanding microgrid modified from IEEE33 system.

articleTitle: Long-term transnational power transaction model considering political risk for Northeast Asia in presence of global energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of the global energy internet, the interregional optimal allocation of energy is achieved through interconnections between countries. It is possible to realize transnational power transaction with the reform of power market in various countries. In this paper, a long-term multinational power transaction model is set up under the centralized matchmaking transactions, which aims at maximizing the social welfare while the bidding mechanism and interconnection constraints among the countries. Furthermore, we decompose an annual contract transactions into the optimal monthly sub-contracts based on monthly load forecasting to minimize the total generation cost and power shortage penalty. Finally, the test on the practical Northeast Asia, including China, South Korea, North Korea, Japan and Mongolia, are studied and the simulation results show that the social surplus will increase after these countries are interconnected, but the interruption of the noncritical transmission channel will decrease the value.

articleTitle: A two-stage stochastic programming approach for operating multi-energy systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper provides a two-stage stochastic programming approach for joint operating multi-energy systems under uncertainty. Simulation is carried out in a test system to demonstrate the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed approach. The test energy system includes a gas subsystem with a gas source and a gas storage facility, and electricity subsystem that includes a coal-fired power plant, a combined heat and power unit and a power-to-gas facility, and a conventional district heating subsystem.

articleTitle: Multi-sources coordination and operating optimization in micro energy internet considering loads dynamic response
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering various loads, multiple energy and complex energy flow existing in energy Internet, it is important to coordinate different energy resources including adjustable loads and power generators to optimize the system operation. Thus, in this paper, cooling/heating loads dynamic schedulable model characterized by carrier temperature is developed due to its time-delay changing. Besides, driven by energy consumers' interests, two types of flexible electric loads are classified and modelled under time-of-use price: power adjustable loads and timeslot transferrable loads. Then a micro energy internet (MEI) optimal dispatch model is designed, which takes both different loads dynamic responses and multi-energy complementary coordination into consideration. The objective of the optimization is to minimize total costs for system operation. Furthermore, multi-energy interconnection scenario of an industrial park in Tianjin is used in case study. The results show that the proposed strategy has better performance in improving MEI operating economy.

articleTitle: The dynamic assessment method of urban electric vehicle service network's service capability
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The urban electric vehicle service network is the basic support system to provide energy for electric vehicle (EV). Evaluation of the service capability of urban EV service network is of great importance to the rational construction of EV service network and the large-scale promotion and the popularization of EVs. This paper, based on the cloud model comprehensive evaluation method and analytic hierarchy process, the three-level nine-index charging station service capability margin index system and the three-level six-index urban charging station weight estimation index system are established. The service capability evaluation of the EV service network is evaluated according to the evaluation result of typical charging station and the weight of the typical charging station in the service network. In order to realize the dynamic evaluation of service network service capability, it is necessary to update the evaluation system parameters in real time according to the development of electric vehicle and the change of charging demand. This paper proposes an EV demand growth model based on the improved grey forecasting method and the support vector machine to predict the number of EVs. Energy efficiency maximization principle is used to predict the charging load of charging stations. According to the charging forecast results of charging stations, the quantitative parameters of the charging piles needed in charging station in the evaluation system are update in real time to form the dynamic assessment system of EVs service network's service capability.

articleTitle: Coordinated optimal dispatch of microgrid based on demand side response and energy estimation of energy storage device
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When microgrid operates in isolated mode, if the capacity of micro sources and energy storage devices are insufficient, it is impossible to ensure the power supply for all loads in microgrid. In order to improve power supply reliability of microgrid, and to generate electricity by using renewable energy as far as possible, a dispatch strategy of microgrid operation based on demand side response and energy evaluation of energy storage device is proposed in this paper. In this strategy, aiming at microgrid operating in isolated mode, firstly, the power and surplus energy of energy storage are estimated according to the supper short-term power prediction of micro sources and loads, and secondly, the different scheduling strategies for all kinds of loads are implemented on the basis of the estimated result and demand side information. Through the optimization of shiftable loads and the shedding of interruptible loads with different grades, the goal for continuous power supply of the important loads and the shortest power-off time of rest loads is achieved. The simulation cases verify the correctness and effectiveness of the strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Optimal regulation on micro energy grid based on time-shifting agricultural load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To achieve its PV local consumption, the traditional agricultural greenhouses in Gansu Province and its energy supply system are intelligently reformed and demonstrated. The PV wisdom agricultural greenhouse micro energy grid based on time-shifting agricultural load is proposed. This paper compares the scheduling of micro-sources before and after agricultural loads transfer and the daily integrated cost. To allocate the heating equipment rationally and economically, an accurate calculation model of thermal load in greenhouse is constructed. In the paper, based on a new learning factor second-order oscillating culture particle swarm optimization algorithm Simulation is suggested. The simulation proves that the scheduling of the time-shifting load can reduce the system daily integrated cost and verify the correctness of the model and algorithm, meanwhile realize the economical and rational utilization of various energy flows.

Author Keywords: second-order oscillating culture particle swarm optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Research on the conceptual model of smart energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy is crucial to human beings. However, our most widely used energy, fossil energy, is exhaustible and endangered. Nowadays, the situation of world energy is tending towards the renewable energy, which is abundant but requires specific technologies to utilize it more effectively, or more cleverly. A new concept - Smart Energy System has been proposed as an integration of Information System and Energy System. It adopts advanced technologies coming from plenty of fields includes Information Technology, Intelligent Control and Optimization Technology, Modern Energy Technology, etc. To propel forward the Smart Energy System, domestically and world widely, we must have a completed establishment of standards. To set up a standardization for a Smart Energy System, we need to explicitly figure out its conceptual model, essential features, theoretical basis and technical requirements, environmental conditions, etc. This paper concentrates on the description of world energy situation, the introduction of Smart Energy and the study of the conceptual model for a Smart Energy System.

articleTitle: A secure communication framework based on chaotic system array and its application in Internet of Energy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Information communication technology(ICT) is the key issue of internet of energy(IoE). It's important and necessary to improve the information security statue. As chaotic signal is noise-like, unpredictable and sensitive to the variation of initial conditions and structure parameters, using chaotic system to build secure communication system is feasible and reliable. In this paper, a framework of secure communication system that is constructed with chaotic system array is proposed and analyzed. Different types of chaotic systems with unique structure parameters were used to form an array which generating chaotic signals for secure communicating. Chaotic signals in the array are partial or complete used to modulate/mask the message needed transmission. The encryption algorithm may be jointed while processing the message before emitting it, which can promote the secure communication system secure statue comparing to the conventional cryptosystems. The simulation verification of the secure communication system with plain-image show it works on a high performance. Moreover, this cryptosystem can be achieved with chips, DSP, FPGA, micro-computers and programming language. The application of secure communication system within chaotic system array in IoE is worth a further research.

articleTitle: The review of theoretical research on correlation theory containing renewable energy in energy system integration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accompanied by the continuous development of renewable energy in energy system integration, correlation theory is applied widely and broadly. Ignoring the correlation between variables makes the result lack of relevance. In contrast, taking into account the correlation makes the calculation model more perfect and logical and the calculation results more realistic and scientific, which lays a more important foundation for system planning and operation. Therefore, basic correlation theories are proposed and introduced firstly, then the applications of correlation theory in energy system integration are combed and summarized based on the existing research. Besides, the key technologies of correlation theory in the application of power system are put forward. Finally, in order to promote the further application in energy system integration, the development prospect of correlation theory is further explored.

articleTitle: Design of an iterative bidding mechanism based regulation service contract market including energy storage
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Great challenges has been put on ancillary services in electric power system, especially with the penetration of renewable energy generation. Bulk battery energy storage systems (ESS) has gain a worldwide population due to its high quality of regulation in recent years. In this paper, we focus on design of regulation service contract market, which is applicable for both traditional generators and ESS. To guarantee market fairness and make full use of high quality regulation resources, group bidding is introduced, meaning that resource acquisition is carried out through several bidding sections with different requirements for regulation performance. Transaction model in each section is established. Then, iterative bidding mechanism is also used so that market members are licensed to negotiate with each other, which makes final market clearing prices close to real regulation cost. A numeral example is studied to illustrate feasibility and merits of the proposed market mechanism, and then market benefit under this market mechanism for BESS is analyzed briefly.

articleTitle: Subjective and objective evaluation method of cloud computing in power system under the background of energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper discusses the business mode problem of Cloud Computing application in power system under the background of energy internet. Firstly, the predicament and difficulties of Cloud Computing technology promotion in power system are presented. Secondly, combined with the background of energy internet, this paper has made a comparison between the fourth element of the business mode of producer, consumer, product market, factor market and value proposition, value production, value submission, value acquisition in the microeconomic, and then the evaluation index system of the business mode in power systems is put forward. In addition, an objective and subjective mixed weighting method of analytic hierarchy process and entropy method is proposed. Finally, the business mode of Cloud Computing technology application in power system is analyzed from the aspects of construction, investment and operation. It is respectively concluded that the optimal model, which are the investment mode of contract energy management, the construction mode of equipment supplier and integrator, and the operation mode of resource leasing. This commercial model can provide a certain reference for the promotion and extensive application of Cloud Computing technology in power system under the background of energy internet.

articleTitle: Forward and flyback converter that can realize secondary BOOST or BUCK function
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It's known to all that higher voltage gain is indispensable before grid connecting of renewable energy. Furthermore, auxiliary electronic equipment of electric vehicle also requires relative low rated voltage to ensure regular service. In fact, BOOST-BUCK DC-DC converter (also called Cuk DC-DC converter) could realize ascending and descending of voltage. However, in order to ensure secure operation, electrical isolation measure needs to be adopted as well. Forward converter and Flyback converter are ordinary isolated DC-DC converter. Therefore, combinational Cuk-Forward and Cuk-flyback DC-DC converter are theoretically feasible to meet above requirements. In this paper, modeling and simulation of the two combinational converter have been manipulated with OrCAD-Pspice software. The result shows that the principle of Cuk-Forward and Cuk-flyback DC-DC converter is absolutely accurate. Moreover, the harmonic of output voltage, input current, and voltage stress of switch could also be reduced by optimization design of circuit parameters.

articleTitle: State estimation based transmission line fault locating with sequence distributed parameter models
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a novel phasor-domain dual-ended transmission line fault locating method enabled by sequence distributed parameter models and the state estimation algorithm. The method only requires fundamental frequency phasor measurements. Best implementation requires GPS synchronization at both terminals of the line. The method first models the transmission line with fault in sequence domain with distributed parameters, to accurately consider the effect of charging currents. Second, the state estimation algorithm is adopted to make full use of the redundancy in the fault locating problem and to cross check the estimated fault location. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the method has better accuracy than legacy fault locating methods, independent of fault types, locations and impedances.

articleTitle: Load shedding control strategy for power system voltage regulation in distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the impact of disturbances in power system voltage stability. An advanced method is introduced using sensitivity analysis to preserve the voltage within the secure limits when the power system faces disturbance. The objective is to compute firstly the static sensitivity index during small disturbance, without considering the difference between static and dynamic load shedding. Then, obtain the dynamic sensitivity index when a large disturbance occurred in the system. Finally, describe the difference between static and dynamic load shedding during large disturbance. Simulation was implemented on IEEE-33 test bus system, the results showed that this method is reasonable and efficient.

articleTitle: Analysis of energy internet development influencing factors based on interpretative structural model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet (EI) is featured by integration of renewable energy, Internet and information communication technology (ICT). Developing EI is the inevitable choice to optimize the allocation of energy assets, improve the efficiency of energy utilization. However, high investment cost, long construction period and high technical requirement of EI lead to various and complex influencing factors during the whole process of development. This paper uses the interpretative structural model (ISM) to analyze the influencing factor system which covers economic condition, natural environment, technical support and policy, and build multilevel hierarchical directed graph which is used to describe the level classification and effect relationship of these factors. Influencing factors can be divided into the ultimate factors, original factors and processing factors in this model. And corresponding management and strategies for EI's development are formulated based on different factor attributes and detailed analysis.

articleTitle: Research on two-stage planning method of electric vehicle charging station based on immune algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With its popularization, electric vehicles have played a critical role of people's trip. Combined with the concept of chain of the travel, the charging demand of electric vehicles is predicted. On this basis, a multi-objective model for the optimal planning of EV charging station is developed with the purpose of maximizing the covering traffic flow and minimizing the loss of time during charging and maximizing the average utilization rate of charging stations. The immune algorithm is implyed to work out the model to choose the optimal solution. Finally, a scheme selection model is builded in the base of maximizing annual income of operators of charging stations to determine the best scheme. The results of the example showed that the proposed method, under the premise of considering interests of charging station operators and electric vehicle drivers, is effective for the site and location selection of charging station, to a certain extent, making up for the lack of other charging station optimization method.

articleTitle: Design and application of energy management system for sodium sulfur battery
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the control center of the energy storage system, the energy management system is responsible for data collection, operation analysis and control of energy storage inverter, energy storage batteries, meters and other equipment which achieves energy management and optimization. Based on the design of sodium-sulfur battery energy management system, the three-layer network structure of energy management system is discussed. The advanced analysis, control, evaluation and basic support function is demonstrated from four aspects: the operation control and evaluation, communication management, real-time data processing, historical data processing. Furthermore, the software design process and implementation are analyzed by combining with the typical functional modules. Sodium sulfur battery energy management system has been used in Shanghai smart grid integrated demonstration project. Taking the 200kW sodium-sulfur battery energy management system as an example, the practice and application which concern the real-time data acquisition, historical data analysis and optimization operation control are analyzed in the engineering project.

articleTitle: Operation and control of a new grid-connected PV systems based on common DC bus
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a new three-phase grid-connected PV system based on common dc bus, this system is connected to the grid by cascaded multi-level DC/AC converters (CMCs). PV array strings will be connected to boost converters which are connected to a common DC bus through separate interfacing circuits. Dual-active-bridge (DAB) converters are employed to this system, which can provide galvanic isolation. The low voltage side of each DAB converter is connected to the common DC bus, and the high voltage side is connected to the CMC. In this system, the output power of the PV arrays will be unbalanced once the operating states of the PV arrays are not identical. The unbalanced output power will lead to the asymmetric of the grid-side currents of the CMC. In order to achieve the symmetric of grid-side currents of the CMC, a zero-sequence injection method is presented to balance the grid-side currents. A 10kV/4.5MW PV system with the proposed control strategy is built in PSCAD/EMTDC. Time-domain simulations are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed system topology and control strategies.

articleTitle: Fault location in active distribution network based on the change of current phase
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The growing penetration of the distributed generation (DG) makes the traditional passive distribution network change to active distribution network. A new fault location method is proposed in this paper based on the change of the current phase, which can be used in active distribution network. Specifically, a fault model of the invert DG is proposed, then the active distribution network model is established. The current phase difference between the two ends of the distribution line are calculated for both the normal operation and fault conditions. The relationship between the current phase and the location of the fault is summarized. A fault location criterion is proposed based on the change of the current phase difference. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method is verified using the practically measured data and the fault simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis model for peak load regulation capacity of power system with multi-energy resources involved in system regulation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The most fundamental difference between wind power and conventional energy is that the wind power has following characteristics: intermittent, volatility and lack of schedulability. As a result, when large-scale wind power introduces in energy system, it will have a great impact on the peak load regulation capacity and the stability of power system. In order to making up the randomness and volatility of the wind power, the energy system has to arrange conventional units to make compensation for it. And the power system's accommodation capacity of wind power depends on the capacity and ability of comprehensively coordinating adequacy resources in the whole power system. Based on deep analysis of key factors influencing accommodation capability of wind power, this paper presents an analysis model comprehensively considers that increasing the capacity of hydroelectric units and the peak load regulation capacity of heat-supply units, building transmission line to send the wind power out and strengthening the demand side response to consume more wind power. This model considers the characteristics of various power generations and such constrains as the balance of power load and system reserve. The auxiliary effect of transmission line and the demand side response are also taken into account. This model takes the minimum system operation cost as objective function to arrange all kinds of power units, then making a deep analysis of the peak load regulation capacity of the energy system. Test system was used to verify the rationality and feasibility of the proposed models and algorithm and the results of this paper may provide some suggestions for the energy internet.

articleTitle: Stochastic DG capacity assessment for active distribution networks considering the optimal reactive DG outputs and OLTC operation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed a method basing on the Monte-Carol simulation to deal with the stochastic DG (distributed generator) capacity assessment problem. In this work, a newly published OLTC(on-load tap-changer) linearization model is applied to the DG capacity assessment problem. And, how the OLTC and DG's reactive output affect the DG capacity assessment result is analyzed in the case study. By using Monte-Carlo simulation method, we can get the DG capacity assessment result in different sceneries and calculate the exact risk of solar energy abandon with certain DGs' capacity in ADN(active distribution network).

articleTitle: Coordinated heat and power dispatch of industrial park microgrid considering distributed heating and indoor comfort constraint
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of low-carbon heating and photovoltaic (PV) accommodation in the energy supply system of industrial park, a new method of coordinated heat and power dispatch is proposed, which considers distributed heating and indoor comfort constraint. First of all, the basic architecture for the integrated energy microgrid of industrial park is constructed, and the heat balance model of buildings considering the building envelope and external environment is established; then, the models of various components in integrated energy microgrid are developed; furthermore, a mathematical model of coordinated heat and power dispatch is established, which considers the economy of PV accommodation under the indoor comfort constraint, and a solution method based on genetic algorithm is proposed; finally, the validity and practicability of this method is verified in a typical case analysis.

articleTitle: A control strategy of hybrid energy storage system in bipolar-type DC micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a coordinated control strategy for the hybrid energy storage system (HESS) to stabilize the DC bus voltages in bipolar-type DC micro-grid. The hybrid energy storage system consists of the lithium battery and the super capacitor for their complementary performances of high energy density and high power density. And voltage balancer is also used to coordinate with hybrid energy storage to balance the power on two DC buses. In order to smooth the working current of the lithium battery and avoid the high-frequency harmonic interaction between two DC buses from voltage balancer, the super capacitor is adopted as an energy buffer to compensate the ripple power. The output power of the lithium battery and working state of voltage balancer are controlled separately by measuring the relationship between two sets of super capacitors. Meanwhile, the response of the lithium battery and voltage balancer to the super capacitor is correctly implemented by adjusting voltage reference values of DC buses. In the end, simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle robot-based testbed for future grid's evaluation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The recent penetration of distributed green energy, distribution intelligence, and plug-in electric vehicles (EVs) calls for a better information organization in an Energy Internet. Such an information system usually considers mostly the static grids. In this paper, we propose a test-bed not only for the static grid but also for the dynamic devices such as electric vehicles. To reduce the physical size of such a test-bed, we design the robot to have two wheels. To avoid human interruption to the test, we replace the manual charging procedure with wireless charging. To enable the EV robot for self-balancing with its two wheels, we implanted the EV robot with a control algorithm based on a neural network. To provide the EV robots with charging instructions, a joint optimization is carried out by considering both the economic factor on the customer side and the grid security constraint on the utility side. Numerical results demonstrate the testbed's capability of handling many EV robots.

articleTitle: Research on network optimization in LTE power wireless private network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the problems of electric power wireless communication and to serve the power consumer better, the network optimization in electric power system are analyzed, and multiple network optimization methods are proposed. It makes a detailed analysis of the parameter configuration and coverage of the wireless network optimization in power system. The network optimization scheme provides a technology support for electric power communication access network construction and late operation, and lays the foundations for popularization and application of LTE power wireless private network.

articleTitle: Study on propagation characteristics of high frequency signal in 10 kV single core crosslinking polyethylene power cable
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to deeply understand the propagation characteristics of high frequency signals, such as partial discharges in cables, lightning impulses and switching transients, and for improve the measurement and location accuracy of power cable partial discharge signal, based on the classical transmission line theory, a mathematical model of 10 kV crosslinking polyethylene (XLPE) power cable is established in this paper. The transmission line equations of established model are set up and solved using Kirchhoff's law to obtain the characteristics of power cable wave. By means of comparison and analysis on characteristic parameter curve between the established model and classical transmission line model, the feasibility and accuracy of established power cable mathematical model in this paper are verified.

articleTitle: Simulation studies of DC-connected photovoltaic power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a DC-connected photovoltaic (PV) power system. The system topology and working principle of each component are illustrated. The control scheme of the system including the steady-state strategy and soft start/stop strategies is proposed. A simulation model of the system is established in Matlab/Simulink software environment according to its topology and control scheme. In addition, the steady-state and dynamic characteristics of the system are studied through time-domain simulations under several test cases.

articleTitle: The finite element analysis of magnetic storm geoelectric field based on the three-dimensional electrical structure
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Three-dimensional model of earth conductivity structure could further rationally manifest the spatial distribution of magneto-telluric field under condition of magnetic storm. In this paper, it is hypothesized that field source triggering geomagnetic disturbance is surface current with certain height away from the ground surface. Through analysis and calculation of spatial distribution of magneto-telluric field through finite element method according to different field source frequencies by adopting three-dimensional modeling for earth conductivity structure, it is revealed that different electrical structures and field source frequencies have influences on spatial distribution of magneto-telluric field. In view of the considerations of traditional concept into the east-west component of electric field intensity, the north-south and east-west components of electric field intensity are discussed respectively in this paper, thus providing basis for more accurately evaluating earth surface potential and planning power transmission corridor.

articleTitle: Application of a novel virtual synchronous generator technology in islanded microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A novel virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control strategy is proposed by adding the “swing equation” of the rotor and the “virtual swing equation” of the voltage control to the active loop and reactive loop based on the droop control in this paper. The islanded microgrid with this VSG method not only has damping and inertia in active loop and reactive loop as the traditional synchronous generator, but also can compensate the voltage drop caused by droop control and the line impedance. Most importantly, the VSG method proposed in this paper can share the load accurately in proportion to the power ratings of different islanded microgrids without meeting the impedance matching conditions. This paper introduces the principle of the novel VSG control strategy, establishes the mathematical model of this VSG method and analyzes the requirements of different islanded microgrids with this VSG control method running in parallel operation to achieve accurate proportional load sharing in detail. MATLAB/Simulink simulation results of an islanded microgrid running independently and two islanded microgrids running in parallel operation based on this VSG method are given. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Wide area and broadband measurement system for modern power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of distributed clean energy, HVDC and FACTS, power electronic equipments such as SVC/STATCOM, China's power grid has developed into a large-scale complex power grid. The problem of subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) has become more and more prominent in the modern power system, and many SSO events have happened in China. Furthermore, the possibility of the ultra synchronous oscillation(USO) caused by the power electronic devices is also possible theoretically, but none of the existing measurement systems can offer any useful information about it. In addition, the low frequency signal, such as the DC signal at HVDC substation, and the high frequency signal, such as harmonic and interharmonic component, are not measured in typical wide area measurement system(WAMS). This paper is to introduce a novel wide area and broadband measurement system (WABMS), which is composed of advanced phasor measurement units(PMU), communication network and control center. Besides the function of synchrophasor measurement, this system can also synchronously measure the DC, harmonic and interharmonic signal, record the original waveform continuously, and send the synchronized information to the control center. WABMS is able to monitor the broadband signal from 0Hz to 3000Hz, and can be used for state supervisor of fundamental frequency, harmonic and interharmonic component. Especially, for the prominent SSO problem, this system can detect the SSO event and identify the SSO source.

Author Keywords: Wide Area and Broadband Measurement System(WABMS)

articleTitle: Testing system of voltage traveling wave fault location technique
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traveling wave fault location technology is not affected by transition resistance, line structure and other factors, so it is popularized in the power grid application. In order to ensure the accuracy of the fault location system put into operation, it is necessary to carry out the research on the test technology of traveling wave fault location system. First, the technology and composition of voltage traveling wave fault location system were analyzed. Then, aiming at the shortcomings of the existing test methods, a voltage traveling wave fault location system test platform was built. The power cable lines were selected as test line which reflecting the distributed parameters. Through the laboratory equipment, the different types of grounding fault were simulated. The test results showed the test system is close to the grid operating environment, which can effectively test the positioning accuracy and function of the voltage traveling wave fault location system.

articleTitle: A new method of traveling wave protection based on directional energy ratio
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability in traditional relay protection, a new method of traveling wave protection based on directional traveling wave energy ratio was proposed in this paper. Firstly, some basic principles of traveling wave were introduced. Secondly, the transmission characteristic of directional traveling wave was analyzed, the energy of positive direction traveling wave and negative direction traveling wave in a period of time after the fault were integrated and squared. Then, internal or external failure could be correctly identified by comparing the ratio of two calculated value with the threshold value. Finally, the fault line could be determined according to the judgment results of traveling wave protection device at both ends of the transmission line. The simulation model of 500kV transmission line was established by simulation tool PSCAD/EMTDC, simulation results showed the correctness and rationality of the proposed method, so that the reliability and practicality of traveling wave protection has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Optimal capacity of energy storage system for wind farms with adapting the scheduling
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an optimal capacity model of battery energy storage system (BESS) for wind farm integration with adapting the scheduling plan is proposed. By analyzing the characteristics of wind output, the equivalent cycle life of BESS considering the effects of irregular charge and discharge on cycle life is introduced to the optimal model. From the point of view of the maximum net benefits of the wind storage union system, an optimal capacity model of BESS with considering investment costs, operating benefit, and wind curtailment saving is proposed based on the unit commitment. Thus, a more reasonable model is achieved with considering the influence of BESS providing reserve capacity on wind output uncertainty and the adaptability of BESS charge/discharge process to the scheduling plan. Finally, results based on the above analysis are listed to show the effect of equivalent cycle life and the reserve degree on the optimal BESS capacity. A foundation is laid for allocating BEES capacity of wind farm in matching with the dispatching operation.

articleTitle: Research on regional fast charging piles planning method of EV based on driving characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, the planning of electric vehicle(EV) charging piles usually adopts the analogy methods, which would bring great deviations due to the lack of considering the influence of regional driving characteristics and the scale of electric vehicles. In this paper, a three-state probability model with four parameters was proposed. The number of fast charging piles was calculated based on various regional driving characteristics. Calculation results of the fast charging pile in typical areas are also calculated which can provide reference for the planning department.

articleTitle: Test analysis of practical quantum VPN gateway for electric power telecommunication security in energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric power communication security is an important support for the development of Energy Internet, secure transmission protection of core and sensitive business data is the vital task of electric power telecommunication network. Quantum secret communication systems rely on quantum key distribution (QKD) mechanism. As the core equipment in quantum secret communication system, quantum VPN achieves data encryption and decryption with quantum key to improve the cipher security of traditional VPN, which can effectively enhance network security of communication in Energy Internet. In this paper, the working mechanism of quantum key distribution and quantum VPN (QuVPN) equipment is firstly described for the commercial quantum secret communication system based on polarization modulation. The simulation experiment structure of quantum VPN is designed, and the experimental environment is established by using the practical QKD equipment, quantum VPN and network tester. The most important performance characteristics including throughput, delay and encryption algorithm of quantum VPN are tested and statistically analyzed, and the verification of secure network transmission with quantum key is implemented. The test results can provide some technical reference for extensive application of quantum VPN in power grid production and management informatization business.

articleTitle: A coordinated control strategy for suppressing transient power fluctuation of power conversion system and stabilizing AC bus voltage
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The PV / Storage microgrid (MG) is one of the main forms of effectively use of Solar energy. Energy storage based power conversion system (PCS) is responsible for maintaining the power balance and voltage / frequency in the islanded MG. However, the power input or output of PCS and the instantaneous stress of the converter current will be increased greatly when the load is suddenly changed, which may result in the PCS over current fault and power imbalance, and the bus voltage and frequency oscillation of MG, will threaten the system stability. In this paper, a coordinated control strategy for PCS and photovoltaic (PV) inverter based islanded hybrid MG is proposed to suppress the transient power fluctuation of PCS and stabilize the AC bus voltage. The differentials of active power output of PCS is calculated and used to compensate the d-axis current of PV inverter. In this way, the PV system is controlled to change the power output with PCS simultaneously, so as to achieve the purpose of suppressing PCS transient power fluctuations and stabilizing the AC bus transient voltage. The hybrid MG is simulated by MATLAB / Simulink, the effectiveness of the coordinated control strategy is verified by simulation results based on different scenarios.

articleTitle: Dynamic scheduling optimization model for virtual power plant connecting with wind-photovoltaic-energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to promote wind power and solar power as the representative of the development of the distributed energy grid, this paper based on the wind power, photovoltaic power generation, gas turbine, the energy storage system and incentive model to build a virtual power plant (vpp) demand response, introducing the theory of conditional value at risk (cvar) and confidence method to describe the vpp operating uncertainty, and operating income maximization as the objective function. Vpp routine scheduling optimization model is established. Then this paper further to determine the threshold value of vpp operating earnings. Using cvar theory to describe the vpp operating uncertainty factors in the objective function, confidence method is applied to convert the constraint conditions including uncertainty variables, which run the risk of vpp stochastic scheduling optimization model is established. Improved ieee30 node system is chosen as the finally, the simulation system, the simulation results show that the price type of demand response can gently electricity load curve, energy storage system and incentive mode demand response can increase the vpp operating income. This means that the cvar theory and confidence method can be used to describe confidence vpp operating risks, thus by setting the threshold value and the confidence to reflect the decision makers for risk attitude, thus helping the risk control.

articleTitle: Chance-constrained programming model for reference network with wind power integration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of volatile wind power generations, power system operation and planning face the problem of increasing injection fluctuations and uncertainties. In this paper, chance constraint expressions are used to characterize the wind power uncertainty, and then a new chance-constrained programming model for reference network with wind power integration is proposed to ensure the expected wind power utilization. In the proposed model, the objective function is minimizing total power generation cost and transmission investment cost, and the constraints are the safety operation technical requirements under intact operation state and the preconceived contingency operation state. The sample average approximation (SAA) method is used to develop a deterministic approach for the proposed model. Numerical analysis shows the potential benefit of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Cyber-physical security assessment and simulation based on graph database
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the operation of power grid increasingly depends upon the support of strong communication network. The power system consisting of grids infrastructure and communication equipment is a typical cyber-physical system(CPS). In recent years, power accidents that information-side failure impacts on physical operation happen at times. In order to simulate the impacts of information failure on grid operation, we develop a cyber-physical simulation tool for the secondary-voltage control of power system to implement the reasonable analysis and evaluation of the influence of different types of information failure on voltage control effect. In this paper, the graph database is introduced to construct the basic cyber-physical data model as an important part of the simulation tool, whose graphical modeling and management is friendly for users. In addition, the importance of different types of information is analyzed with the tool. It can be seen that the voltage information is more fragile and critical than the non-independent generator reactive information.

articleTitle: Research on LCC-MTDC and STATCOM technology for wind farms integration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed the line-commutated converter based multi-terminal HVDC(LCC-MTDC) combining with the static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) for doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farms integration in the context of Northwest Grid (NG) in China. The control strategies design was approached from two aspects. One was aimed to the ac system on the rectifier side. To coordinate the wind farm, STATCOM and rectifier, the inverse system method was introduced to design the controller in view of the nonlinear characteristic of STATCOM. Meanwhile, the control strategy for the rectifier was proposed to balance the active power in the subsystem and ensure the dc link voltage of STATCOM constant. On the other hand, the single-point voltage control strategy suitable for LCC-MTDC was conceived to guarantee the stable operation of the system by considering the control characteristics of both rectifiers and inverters Simulations carried out in PSCAD/EMTDC have proven that the proposed control strategies possess favorable control performance and fast response speed.

articleTitle: The research of minimum starting-up units mode considering voltage stability
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presented a method of unit optimization considering voltage stability, which based on the actual engineering application. In order to keep the safety and reliability of power system operation and the quality of power energy, the power balance analysis, power flow analysis, voltage stability analysis, load balance analysis and power exchange are adopted to determine the optimal unit commitment of power system. The results of unit optimization of Shanghai grid of different load levels show that, the proposed method provide a great of helps to solve the problem of unit optimization. It is also an effective mean to ensure the stability of power system running.

articleTitle: A novel transient-voltage based fault protection method for VSC-MTDC systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage source converters (VSCs) are highly vulnerable to DC fault current. Fast and reliable fault location and protection methods are necessities in VSC-based multiterminal DC (VSC-MTDC) systems for its safe and reliable operation. In this paper, a selective transient-voltage based fault protection method is proposed. The protection method first uses fast overcurrent criterion as the starting element. Then based on the boundary characteristic of the supplemental inductors, the transient-voltage difference between the internal fault and the external fault is used to locate the fault line. And the extraction of the transient-voltage is achieved by wavelet transform. The proposed method is based on local information, it can identify the fault line quickly without communication between protection units at different locations. The methods has no auxiliary directional criterion and additional fault pole selection criterion. Besides, this method can be realized with very low sample rates, and it is rather strong against various fault resistances. Corresponding simulations were carried out, verifying its feasibility and validity.

articleTitle: A multiport energy hub for the connection of multi power flow: A simulating case
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper addresses a kind of multiport energy hub that can be used to manage the battery storage system and the PV panel. And the dc loads and the ac loads can link with this energy hub directly. Furthermore, we introduced the control strategies for both grid-tied mode and islanded mode, considering the economic efficiency. Finally, the simulations are used to demonstrate the proposed system.

articleTitle: A voltage stability control strategy of urban energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under fault conditions, power electronic based equipment usually provides little support to the grid. To address this issue, this paper designed a new type of micro-grid stability controller, which aims to help maintain the voltage level of urban energy internet through the coordination of demand side resources including energy storages, electric vehicles and distributed generations. By analyzing the impedance ratio of distribution networks, a new type of voltage support control strategy is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by using simulation analysis and physical experiments.

articleTitle: A novel control strategy to smooth power fluctuation of hybrid offshore wind and tidal power generation system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at improving efficiency and reliability of offshore renewable energy power generation, hybrid offshore wind and tidal power generation system was proposed. A novel control strategy was presented in this paper to smooth the power fluctuation which is caused by the wind power fluctuation. The wind turbine operates with the maximum power point tracking method, and the tidal turbine can be used to compensate the wind power fluctuation on short time scales. The tidal base power coefficient is identified to describe the compensation ratio of the tidal power. The tidal target power can be determined by choosing the value of tidal base power coefficient. By tracking the tidal target power, the tidal power generation can compensate the power fluctuation, and the power output of hybrid offshore wind and tidal power generation system can be smoothed. Simulations are performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed smoothing strategy.

Author Keywords: hybrid offshore wind and tidal power generation system

articleTitle: The three-phase unbalanced overvoltage suppression method based on double-loop PI control for distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In traditional non-effectively grounding distribution network, the unbalance of three-phase parameters, heavy single-phase load and ferromagnetic resonance may all contribute greatly to the overvoltage of neutral point, which damage the reliability of power system seriously. However, the traditional over-voltage suppression method needs to measure the line-to-ground parameters and the suppression accuracy is poor, and may also adversely affect the relay protection system. In this paper, the method of injecting current based on three-phase unbalanced overvoltage suppression device is proposed to suppress the neutral point voltage to zero. The double closed loop control method is proposed, the proposed method owns fast response speed and high precision without measuring the parameters of the distribution network. Lastly, simulation and experimental results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The research on the harmonic depression based on the grid-connected photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes the voltage/current double-loop control PWM method to depress the harmonic. After that, the PID controller's parameter design method is researched to depress the harmonic better. At last, the output current of the inverter is analyzed through the GCPV model accomplished in MATLAB considering the change of the light intensity. The result is good(the harmonic content is within the scope of the standard) and the dynamic performance of the GCPV is well when adjusting the PID controller's parameters. The simulation results prove the effectiveness and value of this paper's harmonic depression method.

articleTitle: Dynamic SOC estimation method of energy storage battery against load power change
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing definition of state of charge (SOC) cannot calculate under the circumstance of variable current or long-time heavy load discharge. Accordingly, it is necessary to propose a SOC definition based on energy theory. SOC is divided into static SOCs and dynamic SOCd to be applied the calculation of SOC in varied cases of energy storage battery. On this basis, considering the stored energy during the operation process is reduced constantly and the load power changes, dynamic SOCd estimation method is proposed. On a basis of experimental data on batteries carrying varied power loads, the algorithm fits the energy function of battery energy release with the changes of load power. According to the related standards, standard load is chosen. Refer to the definition of SOCS proposed in the preamble, the present stored energy of battery is calculated, the residual capacity from battery discharge until cut-off condition is solved, and estimation of dynamic SOCd is realized finally. As common energy storage equipment, the vanadium redox flow battery (VRB) is cited for experimental verification. The experiment proves that the method is easy to be implemented with less error.

articleTitle: A design of the common platform of wireless communication based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: We present a design of the common platform of wireless communication based on FPGA. The platform, developed by us, allows researchers to modify transport protocols on any layer of an OSI reference model, from physical layer to application one, thereby it is feasible to implement multiple wireless communication protocols on different layers.

articleTitle: Effect of rectifier alpha min limiter on dynamic response of HVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Rectifier Alpha Min Limiter (RAML) is a standard configuration in the control system of modern HVDC systems. Considering the fact that RAML could be a double-edged sword to the satisfying operation of the AC/DC hybrid power system, this paper makes a detailed assessment of RAML. First, the RAML control logic is introduced. Secondly, an HVDC system model which has the same control logic as that used in a real HVDC system is built in PSCAD/EMTDC, based on this model, the effect of RAML on the dynamic responses of the rectifier side is studied. Finally, the sensitivity of the dynamic responses of the rectifier side to the parameters of RAML is investigated. The analysis results indicate that theoretically, by increasing RAML_MAX or U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">set</inf>, or by decreasing RAML_DEC, the restoring speed of the DC voltage, DC current and the active power transferred by the HVDC system will be slowed down.

articleTitle: A novel RLMP model considering power system operation risk
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In construction of energy internet, using market methods for energy management is an important issue. In this paper, a novel risk based locational market price (RLMP) model is proposed. RLMP consists of four components: energy, congestion, loss and risk. The risk component which is not included in traditional LMP can reflect the risk level of power system operation. Compared with other prevalent methods, this paper takes into account not only transmission line capacity, but also its topological importance in calculating transmission line risk index.

articleTitle: Quasi-dynamic interactions between electricity systems and heating systems in normal operation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electricity systems and heating systems are more coupled than before. Interactions between systems become stronger and influence the performance of integrated energy systems greatly, especially when security is the concern. Steady state analysis methods were usually used in recent research of integrated electricity and heating systems, which are not able to accurately evaluate the interactions due to the slow dynamics of heating systems. This paper studies quasi-dynamic interactions between electricity systems and heating systems in normal operation. Interaction mechanism is analyzed, and transport delay is emphasized as an important feature of quasi-dynamic analysis in time dimension. The transport delay comes from the temperature propagation in heating networks and has significant influences on the quasi-dynamic interactions. The transport delay is quantified by quasi-dynamic models. Electricity systems and heating systems can influence each other when disturbances or actions occur. Control strategies also have great effects on the interactions.

articleTitle: Optimal planning of distributed generation allocation and capacity for loss reduction
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reasonable access of distributed generation (DG) is beneficial to improve the operational efficiency of the distribution system (DS). An optimization method is presented for the location and capacity of DG. Specifically, to determine the location of DG, the optimal local balance method for DG access is realized based on network loss sensitivity. On this basis, a DG capacity determined model with minimum network losses as the objective function is presented and the model is next solved with improved genetic algorithm. The benefit coefficient is raised to measure the access benefit of DG. Final, the proposed method is applied to IEEE 33-bus test distribution system, and it is shown by simulation results that the proposed method reduces the network losses with less DG.

articleTitle: A compensation method for averaged models of PWM converters in large-time-step simulations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The control systems, devices and phenomena are modelled in Transient Analysis of Control Systems (TACS), while the transient phenomena of the electric power systems are simulated in Electromagnetic Transients Program (EMTP). However, TACS and EMTP are solved separately with one-time-step error at the interface. This provides an efficient time-step solution, but numerical stability and accuracy problems associated with the one-time-step error may occur. In this paper, the accuracy of the averaged model (AVM) of pulse width modulation (PWM) converters in transient simulations with large time steps is analyzed. The control system of AVM is implemented in TACS, the electronic circuits of converters are modeled in EMTP. A proportional-derivative (PD) controller is used to compensate the time delay between TACS and EMTP. Large-time-step simulations are so supported, and the accuracy of AVM is improved with large-time-steps. Test cases including a two-level three-phase ac-dc converter are simulated to demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of MMC DC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the basic principle and mathematical modeling of the DC transmission system, which the control core is modular multilevel converter (MMC), the DC transmission system is divided into three control systems: system level, converter station level and converter valve stage level, and this three control levels were analyzed in depth. And then the corresponding control strategy is put forward for the two kinds of HVDC systems with both active and passive power supply. Finally, the RT-LAB simulation software is used to build the control simulation platform model of the MMC DC transmission system, By analyzing the AC load and AC voltage of two kinds of mutation control system response strategy and system conditions, verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on closed loop test system for HVDC measuring equipment in flexible HVDC transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the lack of test means of HVDC measuring equipment in flexible HVDC engineering, this paper proposes a closed loop test system for HVDC measuring equipment, which combines the closed loop method of AC electronic transformer and the analysis of the principle and the structure of HVDC measuring equipment. The system solves the technical problems of its interface protocol and the synchronous processing of AC and DC signals. The test platform of closed loop test system for HVDC measuring equipment has been developed. The proposed system provides a simple and practical solution for the field test of HVDC measuring equipment.

articleTitle: A multi-objective based capacity optimization design of standalone microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-objective optimal configuration model of distributed generator capacity aimed at solar power, hydropower, diesel power and battery based microgrids is proposed, the model takes economy, environmental benefit and power supply reliability into consideration at the same time. Under the established control strategy, the adaptive weight particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the model in order to obtain the capacity of the distributed generators in the microgrid. In example analysis part, an example of a western area of China is given to design the distributed generator capacity of the microgrid. The analysis of the results shows that the multi-objective optimization can achieve the best balance of economy, environmental benefit and power supply reliability, the analysis of the results also verifies the rationality and superiority of the proposed model and scheme.

articleTitle: Distributed control of multi-zone commercial buildings for demand response
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) system in commercial buildings usually consume a significant amount of energy. Therefore, it is essential to take some measures to make HVAC system operate in a more energy-efficient way. This paper employs a Resistance-Capacitance (RC) model for each zone in a multi-zone commercial building. An optimization problem is formulated to reduce the sum of zone temperature deviations and building power consumption tracking error. This paper puts forward a distributed control strategy using HVAC system in a typical multi-zone building for demand response. The proposed approach combines the advantages of balanced user comfort and energy demand reference following. In addition, to accommodate the power fluctuation issue caused by the time-varying supply-demand changes in power grid, a High-Pass-Filter (HPF) is adopted to smooth the power fluctuations, as well as providing a stabilization effect to some extent. Simulation results certificate the effectiveness of the advanced distributed control strategy.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of multi-segment message bus in platform of SOA based supervisory control system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the platform of supervisory control system based on SOA, message bus provides the facilities of data exchange between different processes in different computers as an important middleware. With the continuous expansion of application scope and system scale, the quantity of data via message bus increases rapidly. It is urgent to improve the message bus performance to provide better quality of service. Furthermore, the new generation of supervisory control system carries out partitions according to the function or the region into cooperative subsystems for flexibility. Message bus needs to be redesigned to meet the new requirements. In this paper, the technologies of message bus involved in the platform of supervisory control system are studied. And a new version of message bus which is suitable to multi-subnet environment, is designed and implemented with cross-platform and high performance. Firstly, the paper describes the introduction of message bus in the platform of supervisory control system. Secondly, the target architecture is proposed by identifying the major limitation in current message bus and studying the requirements for new generation of the supervisory control system. Thirdly, the paper discusses the key technologies related to performance, reliability and QoS in message bus, and gives the mechanism of solution.
