Finally, subsystems and modules are analyzed in detail and the software is developed as well.

articleTitle: A two-layer active power control scheme in a DC grid for contingency situation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A two-stage active power control scheme by droop-controlled DC grids for energy internet system when one converter is out of operation is proposed in this paper. In the first layer, the DC-link voltage of each DC terminal is analytically deduced according to the analytical power flow model in a meshed DC grid to make sure power support during the contingency situation. However, in the second layer, it can alter the concerned control parameters including the power set points and DC droops based on the DC-link voltage calculated in the former layer. The proposed hierarchical scheme can fast track the power change during the contingency situation such as loss of one converter. A typical four-terminal DC grid was modeled and verified in the DIgSILENT/PowerFactory to illustrate the two-laryer scheme.

articleTitle: Analyzing success rate of electricity acquisition in SPLS and its improvement scheme
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power loss rate, as a key economic and technical indicator of the operation of power system, measures the ability of electricity company management. The construction of the Synchronous Power Loss System (SPLS) has solved a series of problems such as the reading limitation of traditional meter and the monthly fluctuation of the power loss rate. This paper analyzes the electricity acquisition in the information collection system, and also analyzes the phenomena of terminal device, power supply and communication channel for the failure of data acquisition. The managed and technical suggestions are discussed to improve the success rate of real-time acquisition. Taking the local hydropower plants in Zhejiang Province as an example, through the installment of wireless signal amplifier and the transfer or additional establishment of the metering points of power plants, the capacity of acquisition technology and ability of company management have been enhanced. The average success rate of power plant electricity acquisition has increased by nearly 10 percents over the previous year, which improves the construction and the integration of SPLS significantly.

articleTitle: An optimization method to improve the transmission capability of AC/DC system with hierarchical access UHVDC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A reactive power/ voltage control sensitivity metric of reactive power devices to high-end or low-end inverter station buses of hierarchical access DC at different faults is defined. An index to evaluate the values of dynamic reactive power devices for improving voltage stability during transient process is proposed. Based on the index, an optimization problem of maximizing the reactive power reserve capacity for improving transient voltage stability is formulated. The method is proven to be effective with the actual case of North China Power Grid.

articleTitle: Hierarchical control algorithm of energy router based on bus voltage and SOC of battery
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the problem of power fluctuation and the instability of direct current (DC) bus voltage carried by the access of multi-device to the power system, a hierarchical control algorithm based on the voltage of the DC bus and the status of charge (SOC) of battery is proposed. The voltage stability of the DC bus and the balance of the dynamic power could be realized through the strategy proposed. Adjusting the working mode and control strategy of each unit based on the voltage of DC bus and SOC of battery, can also lead to the flexible switch of the devices from property of source to load in the side of low voltage. The traditional topology of energy router is improved at the same time by integrating the photovoltaic (PV) generation, storage battery and other devices into the energy router. The stepvariable MPPT algorithm based on the power-voltage (P-U) differential curve can ensure the efficient utilization of PV energy and achieve a richer power distribution. The hierarchical control algorithm of energy router proposed is finally carried out and verified in MATLAB/Simulink. Simulation result shows that the smoothly switch of different modes, the voltage stability of the DC bus and the dynamic balance of the power can be well achieved.

articleTitle: Disturbance source location method of low-frequency osillation considering information loss of key nodes
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The low-frequency oscillation (LFO) caused by local disturbance source is a serious threat to the safe and stable operation of power system, and locating the disturbance source online based on wide area measurement system (WAMS) is an important method to control the accident. However, the configuration of phasor measurement unit (PMU) in power system could not meet the observability requirements of the overall grid so far, so the missing data of key nodes is a mishap in disturbance source locating. In this paper, a disturbance source locating method for low-frequency oscillation considering the missing data of key nodes is proposed based on combining the supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) and PMU system. Firstly, the dissipation energy of low-frequency oscillation is defined, and the physical mechanism of its directivity is analyzed. Then the missing data of key nodes will be compensated by curve regression analysis with the data of SCADA and PMU system. The results of the example in Central China Power Grid show that the proposed method can meet the requirements of locating the disturbance source accurately, and it has a certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Frequency characteristics of fault transients for HVDC transmission line with frequency-dependent distributed parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of the widely used current system and the new traveling wave protection, at the same time proposed problems in the raveling wave protection and proposes faulty analysis method for these problem: starting from the frequency domain transmission system, depth analysis of the transient component propagation of the DC transmission line that mainly including the characteristics of frequency-dependent parameters of the DC line and the border composition by filter system. Thence the paper proposes effective band that caused by failure difference which presence between outside and inside the line. At the end, we hope that the analytical methods could provide a reference value for DC circuit transient protection.

Author Keywords: DC transmission line traveling wave protection

articleTitle: Research on movable charging pile technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid development of electric vehicles, in addition to strengthening technical research, improve battery life, convenient charging facilities is very necessary. At present, for electric vehicle users, the biggest obstacle to install charging piles in residential parking spaces is from property, and property companies generally refuse to install charging piles for safety reasons. In this paper, a new solution is proposed to replace the original fixed charging pile into movable form. The charging pile is separated from the foundation and connected and fixed with a screw and a lock head. The electric connection adopts the form of air plug, when the charging part is not charged, the small door is opened when charging, and the charging pile is connected with the live charge. The charging pile on the site is relatively low, with the same fixed type, but only when the vehicle in the parking spaces at night charging just installed charging pile body, can reduce the risk of charging pile, the day is just a concrete foundation, and is provided with a lock, so it will not lead to children's shock problems. Small footprint, good safety, so you can reduce the concerns of property companies.

articleTitle: Research on energy storage cells equalizer based on direct equilibrium topology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the power lithium-ion battery devices is used in the fields of electrical power system as energy storage device, in order to meet the requirement of voltage levels, they are usually used in series to achieve the appropriate voltage level. Because of inconsistency of the parameters of each cell, the voltage among the monomers becomes unbalanced which decreases the effective capacity and the cycle life of the battery pack. Based on the analysis of the existing topologies, a equilibrium topology based on multi-winding transformer is proposed, this equilibrium topology can realize energy transfer directly among any monomers in no more than two steps. A equalizer of six monomers is built for power lithium-ion batteries, and the equalization effect of three switching modes and the overall equalizer is tested and analyzed in different inequalization conditions. Experimental results show that six-cell equalizer can equalize power lithium-ion battery pack accurately and reliably, and realize energy transfer among any monomer.

articleTitle: A game-theoretic application for EHV cables and overhead lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Extra high voltage (EHV) lines have been used to interconnect many grids. However, what the proportion of underground cable and overhead line over an EHV line should be has not gained enough investigations. In this paper, a new game-theoretic framework is proposed to understand how customers choose the proportion of underground cable and overhead line over an EHV line, such that both the expenditure of voltage sag and the cost of construction can be minimized. We theoretically prove the existence of Nash equilibrium (NE) for the proposed game, and propose a best-response based learning algorithm to achieve the NE. Moreover, we study how the NE is affected by the distance. The simulation results verify our mathematical analysis and the effectiveness of our model.

articleTitle: Research on the direct power trading mode of power demand of charging facilities in China
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric vehicle charging service, it is also facing the problems of single profit model and slow investment recovery, which is not conducive to the sustainable development of the entire industry. This paper discusses the feasibility of charging facility power demand participating in large user power trading and the consumption of new energy surplus power from the perspective of reducing operating costs, proposes the mode of bundling charging facility electricity demand to participate in direct large user power trading, and estimates the profit space of participating in the power trading.

articleTitle: Power hardware-in-the-loop validation of post-primary voltage control scheme
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The concept and experimental validation process of the Web-of-Cells (WoC) based Post-Primary Voltage Control (PPVC) developed in EU FP7 project ELECTRA IRP is presented in this paper. The main objective of PPVC is to provide an optimal and local voltage control replacing the conventional secondary and tertiary voltage control. The Power Hardware-In-the-Loop (PHIL) setup and the experimental results comparing the PPVC approach to traditional voltage control techniques are presented and discussed. The PPVC has demonstrated lower number of tap-changes and faster response to topology changes. To avoid simulation overrun in real-time environment, a slower simulation step is adopted for the electrical network model than the converter and grid emulator controller models in the Simulink model. The PHIL test conducted gives insight to the potential obstacles that may arise with increased number of cells and increased number of nodes in the network.

articleTitle: Optimization of integrated energy supplying system in grid-connected island
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the ever-increasing pressure of environmental protection in industrial development, the high utilization methodology of integrated energy in industrial parks has become an emerging researching focus. In Southern China, several near-land islands have been considered as potential area for industrial construction. In this paper, an effect algorithm to optimize the potential energy supply plants of Grid-Connected islands is proposed. With the real time simulation and operation analysis to related example, the effectivity and rationalization is testified.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Performance and limitations analysis of multi-infeed VSC-HVDC systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Faulty characteristics analysis on HVDC transmission lines with frequency dependent parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, most of the transient protections for HVDC transmission lines utilize the rising rate of traveling wave to constitute the protection criterion, which is lack of sensitivity because of the significant attenuation to the high frequency signal due to the frequency-dependent characteristics of long lines. This paper employs pole-zero method to analyze the frequency characteristics of the transient signal for faulty HVDC transmission line. It is discovered that the transient signals are consist of “position main frequency components”, which is generated by fault position, as well as “boundary frequency components”, which is generated by the boundary filters. The different characteristics between internal and external faults are mainly determined by the pass frequency band of the reflection coefficient and the choke frequency band of the refraction coefficient. Therefore, the feature band for distinguish internal and external fault is from the cutoff frequency of the stop band to the highest frequency of the pass band. Due to the zeros of the voltage in the feature band, the fault information in voltage will be counteracted. However, the differences of the current in the feature band are significant for there are no zero points in feature band. The simulation results by PSCAD associated with the typical HVDC transmission system show that the differences of the current between internal and external faults are obviously.

Author Keywords: Transient Protections for HVDC Transmission Lines

articleTitle: Study on decentralized coordinated control for damping the subsynchronous oscillation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper designs a decentralized coordinated additional DC controller with optional structures based on decentralized coordinated optimization algorithm in order to damp subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) of the system. Furthermore, the concepts of modal controllable degree and modal observable degree are employed in the design process in order to choose the control feedback signals and installed points of controllers in the design process. Finally, simulation with PSCAD/EMTDC shows the better effectiveness of the coordinated control for damping the SSO.

articleTitle: Research on influence of distributed generation on distribution network loss and evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed generation (DG) is an important component of a smart grid. A large number of distributed power supply access to the distribution network will bring great challenges to the operation and control of the distribution network. At the same time, the evaluation method of DG access to distribution network is very scarce. According to the change of the network loss after the DG is connected to the actual distribution network, the influence of the DG on the distribution network loss is obtained, so as to guide the operation of each distributed power supply to achieve the purpose of reducing the loss. And the evaluation method of system influence index is put forward. The analysis results show that the index and the evaluation method can play a good role in actual projects.

articleTitle: Alert correlation analysis based on attack path graph
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Alert correlation analysis is trending to be an im-portant part of the cyber security currently. However, the existing approaches have shortcomings to analyze the alerts effectively. In this paper, an approach is proposed to perform alert correlation analysis based on the alert attack path. To handle the raw alerts effectively, the filtering and aggregation methods for big data processing was performed. Alerts were correlated according to the knowledge base and the correlation likelihood. An attack path construction algorithm was performed to obtain the attack paths for a specified victim IP. To present the attacker's strategies visually, an alert correlation graph was constructed to correlate the alerts in a special scope and merged according to the alert types. In addition, we implement the prototype and evaluate the effectiveness and usability of the database provided by an IDS applied in State Grid Corporation of China. The results demonstrate that the approach proposed in this paper improves the efficiency and accuracy in analyzing the attacker's strategies.

articleTitle: Study on regional hydropower accommodation and improvement measures in power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hydropower is an important part of energy internet, as a principal type of sustainable energy. The promotion of hydropower may help to improve the power source structure and improves the safety, reliability and flexibility of the power system. However, the increasing congestion of the regional hydropower accommodation limits the wider use of hydropower. In this paper, an index system is developed to assess the regional hydropower accommodation. On this basis, an analysis method is proposed to find out the specific reasons of the congestion and the improvement measures by analyzing the relevance of source-load characters and delivery flowgate. The method is proved to be universal and practical through a case study in Western China where the hydropower is the dominant energy. The study is capable to provide necessary suggestions to the safety operation and planning of regional power system and has engineering application value.

articleTitle: Analysis on environmental impact evaluation methods of 1000kV ultra high voltage alternating current transmission line pilot project
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In China, the western energy base is far away from the eastern load center, therefore, long distance and large capacity transmission power grid gradually become the inevitable trend of development, and make a significant contribution to the construction of the global energy internet. 1000kV UHVAC transmission project has a profound and significant impact on the economic benefits, social environment, natural environment, ecological environment and future development. In this paper, an example has been taken for 1000kV UHVAC transmission project which is Inner Mongolia construction and management. By analyzing the environmental features of Inner Mongolia, the environmental impact evaluation index system has been established which is suit for the area, and provided the strongest support for subsequent UHV project.

articleTitle: Analysis of power large user segmentation based on affinity propagation and K-means algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power large users are the key users of power supply enterprises, and their potential value and development trend in power market environment are closely related to the profit of power supply enterprises. In order to identify valuable user behavior and value characteristics, a large user segmentation method based on Affinity Propagation(AP) and K-means algorithm is proposed. First of all, from the existing indicators to extract the key sub-indicators, and consider the recent and long-term power consumption rate of electricity, put forward to assess the development potential of large users of the breakdown of indicators; Secondly, the AP and K-means are combined to solve the problem and finding the initial clustering center and the number of clusters, at the same time, it avoids the problem that the K-means clustering is easy to fall into the local optimum; finally, the user data of a region in Zhejiang Province is analyzed and verified, and the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: Study of the reactive power and influence on AC grid in startup process of voltage source converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC distribution network is the basic supporting component of the future Energy Internet. A variety of power supplies, load, energy storage devices can be integrated to DC distribution network and it will act as energy management unit in Energy Internet. Due to of the large amount of DC capacitors contained in voltage source converters, the consumption of reactive power in the startup process needs to be calculated specifically. This paper introduces two basic charging strategies, and the numerical expressions of reactive power in different charging strategies are deduced. The current-limiting resistance will affect reactive power and completion time of charging significantly. Simulation results show that AC voltage will be affected seriously by the oscillation of reactive power, which leads to amplitude drop and waveform distortion during mode switching.

articleTitle: Studies on mixing and separation of multiple insulation fault UHF partial signals in GIS
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to explore the mixing characteristics of UHF partial discharge (PD) signals in GIS, the mixing characteristics of UHF signals in GIS are studied by antenna theory and electromagnetic field simulation software (XFDTD). Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that convolution is the basic relationship between PD current signal and single UHF PD signal. PD mixing signal is linear and instantaneous mixing of single PD signal. They are also linear and convolution of PD current signal. The reverse process of those mixing modes is also discussed based on blind source separation and find out that it is an over-complete blind source separation problem to obtain single UHF PD signal from mixed one, what's more, it can be approximated to conventional blind source separation when the layout of UHF sensors are very compact.

articleTitle: A numerical approach for macroscopic property simulation in global energy interconnection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of global energy interconnection (GEI) enables to optimally allocate energy resources and protect the environment. Nevertheless, the promotion of GEI is still faced with many practical difficulties and shows a great number of complicated dynamic characteristics. A set of emergencies that may affect GEI is defined and modeled by autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) intervention model in this paper. Then the system dynamics model describing the macroscopic property of GEI is established and the system flowchart is given. Since GEI has high-dimensional nonlinear characteristics, a numerical approach for GEI macroscopic property simulation is proposed. Improved Euler Method is adopted to solve differential and algebraic equations step by step. Effectiveness of the proposed approach is verified by the 911 Event using ARIMA intervention model and macroscopic property simulation of GEI in section IV.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of digital protection system considering time — Variant parameter and economic optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditionally analyzing the reliability of the digital protection system often selects failure rate, repair rate parameter, which have fixed values. However, due to the operating environment, operating mode and some external uncertain factors, failure rate and repair rate parameter are in a certain interval changeable. Therefore, this paper proposes a fuzzy parameter method, which uses the triangular membership function to fuzzify the failure rate and repair rate parameters. The fuzzy Markov model is established by using the digital protection system to analyze the influence of parameter variability on its reliability. At the same time, this paper establishes an optimization model which takes into account the reliability and economy. At the same time, the optima l reliability, the optimal failure rate, and the optimal rate of failure are put forward, and the economic efficiency of the system is also increased. The concept of excellent repair rate are also taken into account. That is, to ensure the reliability of the system under the premise of lower economic costs, the reliability of the parameters in the fuzzy interval on the value is used. Finally, the optimal reliability, optimal failure rate, optimal repair rate and optimal economic cost of the system are obtained by considering the parameter variability under the premise of considering the parameter variability.

articleTitle: Condition monitoring and reliability analysis of underground transformers
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of underground cavern facilities, the electrical power substation is now located underground instead of the conventional aboveground. The operating environment of the power system has therefore changed, which may directly degrade the heat dissipation capability of the power system. Power system components such as transformers and power cables generate heat as a consequence of ohmic and magnetic losses. To ensure the safe and reliable operation of underground power systems, the online condition monitoring and reliability analysis system (CMRAS) for cast-resin dry-type transformers was designed, test-bedded and studied in rock caverns. The CMRAS includes the condition monitoring and data retrieving, prediction, early warning and alarm for management of operational status of dry-type transformers in real time. As the harsher underground operation environment will impact the durability of the key components of the underground substation, aging analysis was conducted with algorithms developed to forecast failures and estimate residual life span of the dry-type transformers.

articleTitle: Coordinated control of energy storage devices and photovoltaic inverters for voltage regulation based on multi-agent system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic (PV) integration with high penetration has resulted in increasing problems of overvoltage and undervoltage in low-voltage (LV) distribution networks. This paper proposes a coordinated control scheme of energy storage devices and PV inverters to solve the voltage rise/drop issues. And the scheme is guided by voltage-power sensitivity. When the voltage exceeds the upper limit, the energy storage devices are charged instead of curtailing the active power of PV inverters, and the stored energy is discharged after making use of the reactive power of PV inverters when the voltage is less than the lower limit. What's more, in view of the situation that the number of monitoring devices is much smaller than that of network nodes, a voltage estimation algorithm is proposed, in which the feeder is divided into multiple regions and the voltage extremums of each region are estimated on the basis of voltage drop theory. Both voltage estimation algorithm and regulation scheme are implemented by a multi-agent system with a redundant communication scheme to improving the reliability. Finally, the proposed method is evaluated in a LV distribution network model in Matlab, and the results verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of cloud-based terminal user energy management system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of the Internet, various forms of energy are connected with each other, and a large number of end users are involved. With the introduction of a large number of distributed power supply, End-users not only consume power from grid, but also deliver power to the grid. Through the free multilateral internet technology, power generation, transmission and power grid will be closely linked. Advanced big data technology, cloud computing technology and information processing technology are used to achieve energy management of a large number of end user. Cloud energy management system has been established to provide energy management services for a large number of end users. In this paper, the home user is chosen as the representative of the end user. Based on the characteristics of the equipment and the electricity consumption habits of residents, a genetic algorithm is used to solve the optimal scheduling problem. The simulation results show that the method can effectively reduce the cost of electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Feasibility analysis and application of graph processing in Gauss and newton-Raphson power flow calculation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Graph processing is a new kind of parallel computing framework with superiority in dealing with massive data with graph structure and complex relevance. In the power system, the grid has a natural graph structure, and the relevance between bus states is very strong. Moreover, the rapid development and application of information technology has also brought the explosive growth of the amount of data for the power system. This paper discusses the application of graph processing in some power flow calculation methods. Firstly, the features of graph processing and the feasibility of some existing power flow algorithms in the graph processing system are analyzed in detail. Then the triangular decomposition of matrix and the forward substitution based on graph processing are proposed. Lastly, cases of different sizes are presented to verify the correctness of theoretical analysis and the features of graph processing.

articleTitle: Cyber physical system planning method based on risk equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cyber Physical System (CPS) is the depth fusion of automation technology, information technology and communication technology. The important feature of CPS is that nodes and physical units exist heterogeneity. Based on the data field theory, the paper establishes generalized node quality model of CPS and mathematically quantifies the differences between nodes. It defines gaussian potential node failure risk function of CPS and builds the risk equilibrium mathematical model of CPS according to the reliability of the system. Based on the proposed model, the paper utilized the improved binary genetic algorithm to seek the best risk equilibrium optimization method. Using the examples of IEEE-39 bus system and an actual intelligent distribution network, the results indicates that the proposed model can identify the nodes where CPS may be in risk. Meanwhile the CPS planning algorithm could promote the reliability of the topological structure and the efficiency of the CPS system.

articleTitle: Parameter aggregation of microgrid equivalent characteristic model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Microgrid consisted of different devices, such as distributed generations, various loads, energy storage system and various controller. With the increasing of number and capacity of microgrid, it will affect the planning and operation of distribution grid. Based on the equivalent characteristic model of microgrid, an equivalent aggregation method for the characteristic model is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the equivalent characteristic model of microgrid is transform to Z domain which is easy to be aggregation. Then, the Z domain pulse transform function is aggregated into high order model. Finally, the aggregated model is simplified to a low order difference equation and the parameters of equivalent model is identified by recursive damped least square algorithm. The proposed method will be proved through the experiments of distribution grid contains multi microgrid system.

articleTitle: A method for improving adaptability of LCL-type inverter to weak grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: LCL-type inverter has been widely used in grid-connected application for renewable power generation. In weak grid, mismatched grid impedance might lead to decreased system stability, or even instability. This paper investigates the stability issue by weakening impedance parameter mismatch. Based on system modeling of typical type II system, the mechanism between grid impedance and system stability is analyzed. A virtual inductor control method on grid side has been proposed, which reduces the influence of grid impedance mismatching on system stability. System performance has been analyzed through bode diagram and root locus, which theoretically shows that the improved method can release the grid impedance in a wider range, adapting better in the weak grid. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control has been verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Experimental research and parameter optimization for speed governing system of isolated network operation area
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The interconnection of power system is becoming larger and larger, and the operation control is becoming more and more complicated. In some special operation mode, the operation of the isolated network may appear after the fault occurs. If the parameters of turbine governor system cannot adapt to the special operating conditions, it will lead to the oscillation of the system. In this paper, a simulation study is carried out for a provincial power grid where there is an isolated network operation, and it is found that there exists a non-electromechanical oscillation risk. Then the parameter adjustment suggestions are given.

articleTitle: A novel approach for railway distribution network voltage traveling wave extraction
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Railway distribution network is the power supply for the railway station and signal equipment along the railway station, which is an important guarantee for the safe operation of the railway. In this paper, the transmission characteristics of traveling wave in railway distribution network are analyzed. Aiming at the problem of fault traveling wave extraction in railway distribution network, a novel method of extracting wave signal from transformer core wire and live display device is presented. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively extract the traveling wave head signal and can be used for traveling wave fault location. Based on this, a traveling wave positioning system for railway distribution network is studied. Experiments show that the system can effectively detect faults traveling wave signal to fault location.

articleTitle: Multi-objective transmission network planning based on multi-objective optimization algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper applies multi-objective optimization algorithms to deal with transmission network planning considering electricity market environment with ‘pool + bilateral trading’ mode and overload risk. In planning model of transmission network, transmission congestion management and overload risk management are considered as optimizing objectives to satisfy the demands of power loads as well as balance the benefits of all participants in power market. For solving the established transmission network planning model, the Pareto optimal solution of multi-objective function is adopted in this paper. Through testing the actual 18-node transmission system based on NSGA-II and MOEA/D algorithms, the results show that the optimal transmission network planning scheme can be obtained, and verify the correctness of the transmission network planning model in power market and the validity of multi-objective optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Dynamic equivalent impedance of photovoltaic plant and simulation analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for the dynamic equivalent impedance of grid-connected photovoltaic(PV) power plants which is built according to the topology of the grid-connected PV power plants. The simulation results are compared with the experimental results of the actual PV power plants by simulation with PSCAD/EMTDC and data processing with MATLAB to verify the accuracy of the model and the dynamic equivalent impedance. The error is below 6% which can meet the engineering application precision requirements. This method can clearly reflect the composition of PV power generation system structure, And the dynamic equivalent impedance model adapts to the volatility and intermittent of PV power generation, meet all kinds of environment and operation mode, Which proves that it has good practical reference value in optimizing control and relay protection.

articleTitle: Evaluation method for mutual support between regional power grid considering large-scale power loss
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The risk of large scale power loss is increasing in UHV interconnected power grid. All levels of dispatch center need to consider the ability in electric power support from adjacent power grid. When large scale power loss occurs, it needs to consider whether adjacent dispatch center can support and the support level for mutual support between regional power grids. The contribution level evaluation of regional power support is helpful to promote the large-scale transfer of power flow. The objectives and methods of regional power support is analysis, the emergency power response ability evaluation optimization model is established, and the regional cooperation contribution level evaluation index is proposed. The simulation results prove the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Research and application of “generation-grid-load-energy storage” coordinated control system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Control mode of distribution power grid dispatching was studied and frame of `Generation-Grid-Load-Energy storage' (GGLE) coordinating control system was built. This system took controlling resources into regulative scope such as distributed energy source, energy storage system and flexible load. On this basis, coordinated optimizing control strategy such as multi-source information fusion, feeder level load forecasting and operation control of distribution network was designed, thus enhancing the safe and reliable operation of active distribution network and diversifying the ability of load to participate in peak load regulation of power grid, which contributed to the reasonable allocation and consumption of distributed power supply. The GGLE coordinated control system has been successfully constructed in a 10kV switching station on Ninghai Avenue in Qinhuangdao, realizing a reasonable control of energy and load, and improving of the energy efficiency and power distribution reliability. The pilot project could be a basic guidance for large-scale construction of active distribution grid.

articleTitle: A cooperative control approach for the frequency friendly load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Demand side resources(DSRs) become indispensable for system operation to maintain power balance, when large scale of renewable generation penetrates into the electric power system. Recent studies have shown that the cooperative control is suitable for the control of DSRs, which distributed widely in the power system. In this article, a cooperative control approach that contains load aggregators and individual loads was proposed. In this approach, the clusters of frequency friendly loads(FFLs) can respond to the variations of system frequency efficiently in real time. A frequency tracking control strategy was adopted in the decision-making programs of load aggregators, and a consensus protocol was designed for the interactions among FFLs. In addition, A Kalman filter was implemented in the programs of aggregators to keep their load members from acting too much or too often. At last, the feasibility of this cooperative control system was discussed, and verified via simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal correction strategy for small disturbance stability constraints with perturbation method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a methodology of Optimal Power Flow (OPF) to ensure small-signal stability based on eigenvalue sensitivity matrix produced by active power perturbation. Firstly, by small signal stability analysis of power system, unstable oscillation modes are selected. Afterward a perturbation method is used to calculate the eigenvalue sensitivity matrix. Finally, Stability-constrained optimal power flow based eigenvalue sensitivity matrix is established to correct system stability. This model just adjusts the generator active power to improve system stability. Three cases confirmed the validity of the model and high efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: PV power smoothing in regional grid based on self-adaption wavelet packet decomposition
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed PV and their impact on regional grid have become an important research field over the last decade years. Aiming at this problem, a new smoothing method based on self-adaptive wavelet packet decomposition in hybrid energy storage system is proposed. It can adjust the wavelet decomposition level according to the change range of PV output power, so that the low frequency component of PV power can be extract accurately. The mechanism of voltage fluctuation caused by PV power changes is analyzed, and the wavelet packet decomposition level is determined by the voltage fluctuation degree, which eliminates the delay effect of real time wavelet packet decomposition. The simulation results show that the effect of using the self-adaptive wavelet packet decomposition is better than the traditional wavelet packet decomposition.

articleTitle: A comprehensive method for operation situation evaluation in active distribution network based on expert experience
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The operation situation evaluation is the basis of situation awareness in active distribution network (ADN). In order to reflect the satisfaction of distribution system operation state, a comprehensive method for operation situation evaluation in ADN based on expert experience is proposed. The evaluation system considers the safety, economics and environment of the ADN. A piecewise linear function which can reflect the change rule of the evaluation indicators is used to normalize the indicators, it considers the relationship between the cost and satisfaction of the indicators in different intervals. The reference values of the indicators are determined by the expert experience. Analytic hierarchy process is used to determine the weight of each indices. Finally, an actual example is used to test the proposed method and the influence of renewable energy and network topology on the operation situation of ADN are analyzed.

articleTitle: Energy and ancillary service joint dispatch of power system integrated with dynamic heating system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated dispatch of electric power system and central heating system will bring significant economic benefit in reducing operation cost and enhancing wind power utilization. This paper investigates the energy and ancillary service joint dispatch of integrated electric power system and central heating system. A system identification model describing the heat storage property of central heating systems is built. The heating supply is qualified through the supply water temperatures at heat exchange stations. An alternate decentralized solution is proposed so that the electric power system and the central heating system can be independently dispatched. Case studies on a test system proves the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A reliable routing method for transmission monitoring wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of wireless sensor network (WSN) routing reliability in the application of transmission monitoring, this paper proposes a reliable routing method for WSN Firstly, according to the communication quality and link quality of the transmission monitoring system, the Sink node is uploaded to the data. Then the optimal choice of the next hop node is realized according to the number of jumps of the adjacent node, the residual energy of the node and the reliability of the node. Finally, the simulation experiment proves that this method can reduce the packet loss rate and adapt to the application of transmission monitoring system.

articleTitle: Impacts of photovoltaic power variation under clouds and LVRT tield test on central power grid of Tibet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Tibet is known as the “Roof of the World” and is characterized by an abundance of renewable energy resources in the form of wind, geothermal, hydropower and, in particular, solar. Tibet power grid is a typical weak power system in terms of its network strength; however due to its abundant generating resources, power exportation to the neighboring grids takes a great proportion of its power output, which bring many challenges to the system stability. In recent years, a great threat on the Tibet power system security is posed by the large-scale development of photovoltaic (PV) power generation, and the main two aspects are: (1) the PV power output could drop about 50–70% within three seconds due to cloud cover; (2) the PV plants, without low voltage ride through (LVRT) inspection certification, have the risk to trip from the grid inoperation. This paper first presents theoretical and simulation analysis on the effects of cloud and LVRT capability on solar power outputs of the Tibet power system. The analysis results are validated by a LVRT field test on a typical PV plant in Tibet. Research results provide effective references for the power grid dispatching department on operating a power system with high penetration of solar power.

articleTitle: Reasch on IED configurator automatic modeling based on IEC 61850
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Data modeling based on IEC 61850 standards is the basis for the realization of intelligent substation automation. Traditional manual modeling methods need spending lots of time, and some current intelligent electronic device (IED) configurators are not suitable for applications. To improve IEDs' data modeling methods and IED configurators' modeling methods, an IED configurator automatic modeling method is designed in this paper. Based on object-oriented modeling technology of IEC61850, decompositions and combinations of IED logical nodes, constructions of IED modeling files and configuration processes are analyzed in details. Designing methods of IED configurators' functions and modules are summarized. The application of the IED configurator automatic modeling method in HZP511 line protection monitoring and control device is demonstrated. Results show that both of modeling workload and probability of error in modeling are greatly reduced compared with artificial modeling methods.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of electricity bill retrieving risk evaluation model for low-voltage users
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electricity bill retrieving has been recognized as one of the main ways to obtain economic benefits for power supply enterprises and it is also an important support for the sustainable development of power enterprises. As the society is increasingly developed, low-voltage users have become an important consumer group which has brought unprecedented opportunities for enterprises. In this paper, we propose a model based on the Topsis algorithm to evaluate the bill retrieving risk for low-voltage electricity users through constructing a bill retrieving risk index system and calculating the weight of the index with the improved Delphi method. Experiments show that this model can effectively evaluate the bill retrieving risk of low-voltage electricity users and precisely find high-risk ones.

articleTitle: An improved control method of high density distributed generation access to power distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the proportion of intermittent renewable in the distribution network increased, control of distribution network becomes more difficult. An improved control strategy that combining droop and anti-droop control method is put forward in the paper. The reference point of voltage and frequency adopts droop control method. In response to voltage and frequency adjustment, WTG (wind turbine generator), PV and Energy storage device adopt anti-droop control method. In those processes of DG start-up and stop, generator source change, line failure and load cutting, the strategy can adjust the power automatically between generator and load, suppress voltage and frequency disturbance, and maintain distribution network operation stability. The proposed strategy is verified to be valid in the transient process of the system through the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive decision-making method of heating project based on combined weight method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is effective to reduce haze in winter of northern China by changing the heat supply mode. Thus, the evaluation of heating project are essential. Firstly, a comprehensive index system for heating project was built. Secondly, a combined weight method based on interval analytic hierarchy process (IAHP) and interval principal component analysis (IPCA) was put forward to overcome the subjectivity of evaluation by IAHP. Lastly, the case study suggested that heating with electricity takes great advantage. The proposed decision-making method can evaluate the heating project effectively and provide scientific support for choosing heat supply mode.

articleTitle: Study on urban transport input in Beijing based on input-output model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study is designed to clarify the relationship between the input and output of urban transport system, which lays the foundation for the study of energy conservation and emission reduction benefits of urban transport system. Applying the input-output method, this paper draws up flow rate chart and makes modeling analysis on the input-output situation of urban transport industry in Beijing in accordance with Beijing 2017 Input-output Table, which emphatically analyzes the internal input features and the impact of technological progress on urban transport industry, especially on energy input.

articleTitle: Study on flexible DC grid based on H7-CSC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In flexible DC transmission, if the DC fault occurs, not only the 2-level voltage source converter(VSC) and the modular multilevel converter(MMC) based on the half-bridge submodule(HBSM) cannot suppress the DC fault current, but also the DC capacitor will increase the DC fault current. Furthermore, DC circuit breakers are too expensive. In order to overcome the issue that the converter can not block the DC fault current, this paper took advantage of the unidirectional conductivity of current source PWM converter(CSC) which is a dual with VSC, studied H7-CSC topology which can greatly reduce the CSC loss, and provided the modulation and control strategy of H7-CSC. In addition, the start-up control strategy and the DC fault treatment strategy of DC network consist of H7-CSC were proposed; the three terminal DC network simulation model was set up which composes a line-commutated converter(LCC) as a rectifier and two H7-CSCs as the inverters, then simulation verification was carried out in PSCAD/EMTDC. The results show that the DC network model proposed by this paper can achieve the smooth start-up, stable operation, DC fault removal and system restart. This model realizes DC fault removal through the control of each converter, without DC circuit breaker, which provides new ideas for the development of DC power grid in the future.

articleTitle: Energy consumption evaluation model of cogeneration units based on the reduced exergy and its application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A calculation model based on reduced exergy is established in this work to evaluate the energy consumption of the cogeneration unit, on this basis a 600MW cogeneration unit is taken as an example to make calculation and analysis. According to the calculation results, the reduced exergy efficiency of the cogeneration unit is found to be about 55%, which is more reasonable than the thermal efficiency and exergy efficiency. Whilst the reduced exergy efficiency can reflect the impact of the heating steam flow rate, the flow efficiency of the turbine and the heating parameter correctly.

articleTitle: Harmonic characteristics of distributed generation and electric vehicle integrating to the grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High penetration of distributed generation and electric vehicles has become an important feature of China's future power grid. However, it also causes serious harmonic pollution to the grid. In this article, we set up harmonic analysis model of distributed generation and electric cars, and then, using the Fourier transform method, measure the harmonic in grid including distributed generation and electric vehicle. This paper focuses on the research and analysis of the harmonic characteristics in grid with distributed generation and electric vehicles considering different access locations, access capacities and access modes. Finally, some suggestions are provided for power grid supervisors.

articleTitle: Variable parameter Kalman filter based dynamic harmonic state estimation for power systems with wind energy integration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of harmonic state estimation in power systems with wind energy integration, a variable parameter Kalman filter model based on historical harmonic information is proposed. In this model, the high frequency and the low frequency components of the historical harmonic wave is obtained through the wavelet filter. The Low-frequency component of historical harmonic is used to calculate the state transition matrix, and then a variable parameter Kalman filter algorithm is adopted to solve the model. The numerical experiment executed on the IEEE13-bus system showed that the proposed method improved the accuracy of the state estimation in the power systems with wind energy integration compared with the classical Kalman filter method.

articleTitle: Optimal operation of multi-energy systems in distributed energy network considering energy storage
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-energy system in distributed energy network consists of distributed heating, cooling, generation and other sub systems. This paper presented a multi-objective optimal scheduling strategy of multi-energy system which based on load forecast data and tight coupling for the relationship of supply and demand. According to different load characteristics, heat and cold energy storage energy hubs were designed. The multi-objective optimization strategy included that operational economic and comprehensive energy efficiency as multi-objective. The multi-objective model was performed based on two partial and global optimization scenarios in distributed energy network, which solved though the improved NAGA-II algorithm. A case study shows are carried out to examine the performance of the optimal scheduling strategy, which can effectively manage multi-energy in distributed energy network.

articleTitle: Dynamic tariff method for congestion management in distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This thesis puts forward a congestion management way for distribution networks considering electric vehicles (EVs) and heat pumps (HPs). Congestion caused by large-scale integration of EVs and HPs in distribution networks can be alleviated by using dynamic tariff (DT). A bi-level optimization model for distribution system operator (DSO) and load serving entities (LSEs) is established. In the upper model, DSO calculates the DT using the minimum operation cost as the objective function, which includes line distribution constraint that takes into account network losses and voltage constraints. In the lower model, LSEs use the minimum purchase cost as the objective function. Based on the basic price and DT, LSEs will re-develop the load plan and transfer part of the loads to the non-blocking period to reduce the obstruction of the distribution network and alleviate the operation pressure of the power grid and ensure the security operation of the grid. The proposed model is applied to the IEEE 33-bus distribution grid and the effectiveness of the advanced DT method is examined by three case studies.

articleTitle: A reliable approach to eliminate distributed capacitive current of transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transmission lines with high voltage generate a distributive capacitive current which have negative impact on differential current protection during faulty conditions. In order to remove the harmful and negative effects of distributed capacitive current on differential current protection, a novel scheme based on Bergeron's model is proposed in this article. Differential criterion is built with the same amount of currents that is computed from both ends to the set point. Implementation of the differential current protection under low sampling frequency proved that the criterion is correct for practical execution. The calculation of distributed current at the set point has been achieved using a unique procedure of cubic spline data interpolation point at each sampling interval under low sampling frequency. PSCAD simulation results in frequency domain show that this novel scheme for differential current protection is not affected by harmful effects of distributed capacitive current as compared to traditional differential current protection. Moreover, novel scheme has certain advantages such as high sensitivity, fast action speed and high reliability.

articleTitle: Decentralized security-constrained economic dispatch for global energy internet and practice in Northeast Asia
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of global energy internet is becoming more and more vital to this world, in which multi-area economic dispatch (MAED) is a fundamental and essential problem. Decentralized MAED can reduce the dimensions of large-scaled problem and protect the privacy of each sub-area, which is widely studied in recent years. In this paper, a fully decentralized algorithm based on Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) and Power Transfer Distribution Factor (PTDF) matrix is proposed, which can cancel the multipliers updating coordinator and the variables of voltage angles. Numerical example of Northeast Asia energy internet is given to test the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal operation and location of heat pumps in the integrated energy systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Nowadays, renewable energy source has widely penetrated into power system. In order to satisfy the different kinds of demands such as heat and electricity in city region, an Integrated Energy System (IES) is supposed to be established. In this paper, an operation model for Heat pump (HP) and combined heat and power (CHP) based integrated electrical and heating system is fully analyzed. This model aims to get the minimum loss including the heat loss and power loss by transforming satisfied electricity to heat. Meanwhile, the optimization method for heat pump installation location selection is also provided. An IES with 11 electrical buses and 11 heating nodes are chosen to study the specific optimized problems. 2 typical different kinds of wind power are chosen as study case. Through the simulation results, the effectiveness of the proposed optimization method is verified.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of global energy interconnection digital research platform
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Global Energy Interconnection (GEI) is an original solution proposed by China to address the global challenges of clean energy, climate change and sustainable development. As an ambitious vision for energy industry, the construction of GEI will face a lot of challenges. The research on environment, economy, energy, electricity, politics, finance, and other fields involving GEI must be improved. Thus, a comprehensive platform is required to supply data and tools for GEI research. This paper proposes the design idea, realization method and applications of the GEI digital research platform. By solving the problems about data, simulation, management and display, the platform improves the GEI analysis and research capabilities, meanwhile strongly supporting the construction of advanced think tank, promotion of GEI concept, and the landing of developing strategies.

articleTitle: User-oriented power sale strategy for power grid corporations under the background of energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of energy internet, a user-oriented power sale strategy of power grid corporations is proposed. Firstly, participants and the situation of power sale market are introduced. The advantages possessed by power grid corporations are analyzed. By using these advantages and the technologies of energy internet, smart power sale platforms can be built by power grid corporations. Platforms have functions of power sale and ancillary service, on-line and offline information interaction channels with users. Depending on the platform, power grid corporations can adopt user-oriented power sale strategy. Power demands of users are collected. Information of users is managed and analyzed by using big data technology. Differentiated power utilization packages and ancillary services are provided to users. A power sale mode with user feedback will be formed. The strategy can increase the power purchase viscidity and power usage satisfaction of users, and enhance the market competitiveness of power grid corporations.

articleTitle: Coordinated operation of energy router with distributed devices
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy router is the core equipment of the energy Internet, which undertakes the power conversion and new energy access in the energy system. Therefore, an energy and information integration energy router structure is designed. The core of its power conversion is the solid-state transformer (SST), which can be connected to a variety of distributed devices, including photovoltaic (PV) system, energy storage unit, wind unit, etc. A control strategy of SST and energy storage unit coordinated operation based on dc bus voltage is presented in this paper, in order to realize the system operation of multiple distributed devices in the energy router. The operation mode and energy equation of the energy router is analyzed and the control strategy of multiple subunits in the energy router is studied in detail to ensure the stable operation of each sub-unit and the smooth switching among different modes. Finally, the simulation example of the energy router is carried out on the MATLAB platform, and the simulation results verify the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed coordinated operation strategy.

articleTitle: Featured town energy internet design based on the flexible demand response resources
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet is a higher level concept of energy utilization, and it is also the basis to promote a new round of energy revolution. Under the different scales and different scenarios, there are some differences in the operation form and mode of Energy Internet. According to the planning and design of Energy Internet demonstration projects in China's first featured town, putting forward the design idea of Energy Internet based on the concept of multi-energy virtual power plant (VPP), putting forward the integration approach of energy system based on the high reliability and flexible demand response resources, putting forward the multi-participant Energy Internet trading mechanism, which provides some reference for promoting the construction and application of Energy Internet.

articleTitle: Analysis and damping control of DC voltage oscillation in AC/DC hybrid distribution system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The complex impedance characteristic of DC network in AC/DC hybrid distribution system is easily to induce high-frequency oscillation. This paper reveals the influence of the DC line on the stability and upper limit of transmission power of the system by researching the relationship between the DC distribution line and the dominant eigenvalues of the system. A distributed active damping strategy is proposed, and the sensitivity of the active damping controller to the oscillation under different access positions is analyzed. Finally, time domain simulation verifies the correctness of the theory and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Intelligent energy ecosystem based on carbon neutrality
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a new concept of energy ecosystem over traditional energy system by introducing carbon material cycling from carbon neutrality perspective. Based on energy application pattern in modern society from industry, transportation and building, we derived a four steps road map for sustainable energy ecosystem development, which are defined as Digitization of Energy, Network of Energy, Internet of Energy and Intelligence of Energy. Due to the shortage of massive energy storage, sustainability is difficult to be built upon existing multi-energy network that is vulnerable to the large intermittence of renewable. Instead, proposed ecosystem can introduce the possibility to store and distribute energy into the carbon material to build a controllable carbon cycle into energy system. Thanks to the cloud-fog-mist platform development based on the latest IoT technology, a fractal control structure is derived to be able to include distributed intelligence algorithms across energy ecosystem, as found in the self-sustained natural ecosystem.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle smart charging network under the energy internet framework
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of energy internet facilitates the precious intelligent control of EV smart charging network, and therefore bringing economic benefits to the power grid and the customers. The strategies for integrating network of charging service into the energy internet and the construction strategy of EV smart charging network are proposed. The technologies and hardware is presented to form the construction principles in typical charging scenarios. And then the business model is established on the condition of technology development and existing hardware platform, aiming to improve promote the smart energy utilization and the application of energy internet.

articleTitle: Research of PMU data transmission mechanism in smart grid based on NDN
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The continuous development of smart grid makes its applications showing more characteristics of a large amount of data, business-rich, some applications' higher requirements and extensive coverage. The wide-area control system and distribution network-related applications which based on the PMU data, have critical real-time requirement for data, the traditional TCP / IP network com communication is host-oriented, and can not support real-time applications so well, which makes the wide-area communication system under the large power grid greatly affected by the delay. However, the NDN network has better flexibility and scalability compared with the current IP network. Therefore, this paper analyzes the current status of the smart grid and the NDN network. Then on this bases, combined with PMU data using ndnSIM for smart grid environment, the NDN network is feasible in the application of smart grid is proved through delay, link failure recovery time and has obvious advantages compared to the TCP/IP network.

articleTitle: Island operation control strategy for BESS in parallel based on droop control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During island operation, Micro-grid requires that battery energy storage systems in Parallel can distribute power reasonably. As load increases, the energy storage system needs to expand capacity, while reducing power consumption, and realizing the plug and play technology. Based on droop control, this paper analyzed the factors that affect the power sharing when the energy storage system is connected in parallel, and designed the method of proportionally distributing the power of the energy storage system. Finally, this paper established the simulation model under Matlab/Simulink, and hardware-in-the-loop experiments were build on the RT-LAB platform. The simulation and experimental results are provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: A dynamic period partition method for time-of-use pricing with high-penetration renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Time-of-use (TOU) pricing has become an effective measure to incentivize demand response (DR) resources to interact with power grids and facilitate the accommodation of renewable energy. In this paper, a TOU pricing method is proposed considering dynamic time period partition. Distinguished from the conventional TOU prices fixed for a long term, the proposed time period partition is updated every day due to the volatility of high-penetration renewable energy, and determined based on the day-ahead system net load forecast. For practical implementation with minimal policy adjustment, the levels of TOU prices remain unchanged, and the daily time periods are categorized into three clusters using the Fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, i.e., peak, intermediate and valley periods. Then a day-ahead economic dispatch model considering DR is formulated to evaluate the impacts of the proposed TOU prices on the accommodation of renewable energy. Case studies based on a provincial power grid illustrates that the proposed method can determine the time period partition of TOU prices according to the system net load forecast, and effectively encourage DR resources to interact with power grids and improve renewable energy accommodation.

articleTitle: Fault section location method using wide area centralized structure based on modified hausdorff distance
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the small current neutral grounding system where a Single-phase earth fault, the transient zero sequence current of the sound section has high similarity while the transient zero sequence current on both sides of the faulty point has low similarity. Based on this, the Modified Hausdorff distance is applied to fault section location. The method utilizes the centralized structure built in the wide area measurement system to solve the issue regarding synchronous acquisition of transient zero sequence current signals, only acquires fault information of each section in the faulty line for the purposes of reducing the traffic of the communication system and centralizing the calculation of the decision-making center, describes the difference between the fault section and the sound section through Modified Hausdorff Distance, and finally determines that the section with Modified Hausdorff Distance greater than the threshold is the fault section. According to the simulation verification, the method produces accurate and reliable locating results and is not subject to fault angle, grounding resistance and fault position.

articleTitle: An improved DC power flow model with virtual transmission channel for restoring energy internet power flow solvability
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large scale power grid is the most important foundation of energy internet. Due to the scale of energy internet increasingly expands with high complexity, using conventional power flow model cannot achieve reliable convergence in all cases. In order to avoid energy internet power flow insolvability, a new improved DC power flow model with virtual transmission channel is proposed in this paper. This model takes into account the active power loss of power grid to reduce the calculation error of standard DC power flow algorithm. The active power loss of each branch is simulated with equivalent loads located at both ends of the branch. An iterative algorithm is adopted to calculate the equivalent loads. In order to overcome power transmission congestion which is one of the main reasons leading to power flow insolvability, a virtual transmission channel model is presented. Virtual transmission channel is parallel to the related transmission line or transformer where the active power flow exceeds rated value. Some virtual transmission channels may be added to the original network during iteration process. Plenty of actual calculation examples show that the proposed improved DC power flow model is practical and effective. Using virtual transmission channel can significantly enhance the power transmission capacity, and helps to restore energy internet power flow solvability.

articleTitle: Cost-effective optimization analysis of shore-to-ship power system construction and operation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to build a green port and achieve energy conservation and emission reduction in energy internet, the economic problems brought by shore-to-ship power system have attracted more attention than ever. This paper analyzes the construction and operation cost of the whole shore-to-ship power system from the point of view of economics. The corresponding mathematical model is constructed and the cost-effectiveness of grid companies, ports, ships and the government is analyzed by using the economic optimum principle. Then, the optimal shore-to-ship power price is calculated. At last, according to the proposed model, the relationship between the government subsidy rate, the shore-side power utilization time and the profits of all parties is analyzed, which provides reference for power grid company, port and government to promote shore-to-ship power system.

articleTitle: An improved droop control strategy for parallel inverters in microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper an improved droop control strategy for parallel inverters in microgrid was proposed.
