Aiming at the voltage sags problem caused by the introduction of virtual impedance, a double closed loop control method based on measured voltage feedback was employed for inverter control in the microgrid. Firstly, the frequency response character of the closed loop transfer function with virtual impedance and the inductive variation was analyzed in the frequency domain, indicating that the improved droop control method is necessary. Secondly, an improved droop control strategy based on inductive virtual impedance with measured voltage feedback was proposed. Lastly, the Matlab/Simulink simulation results show that the improved droop control strategy can not only solve the output voltage sags of the inverter, but also improve the accuracy of power allocation of droop control, maintain the system voltage and frequency stability. It is proved that the improved droop control strategy is effective.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of distributed integrated energy systems via Markov chain Monte Carlo
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed integrated energy system (DIES) is conductive to alleviate the energy shortage and environment pollution. As a basis for planning and operation, reliability evaluation is important for the development of DIES. Firstly, this paper established a reliability evaluation model of DIES based on an energy hub model, which can describe the complex interconnection between different power supply subsystems. Then, the impacts of dynamic behavior of thermostatically controlled load on the reliability evaluation of DIES is analyzed based on an electric water heater (EWH) model. And the reliability evaluation of DIES is carried out based on a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulation. The feasibility of the proposed method is validated by extensive case studies.

articleTitle: Design of energy internet based on information internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet (EI) has been proposed to be a main direction for future energy structure to solve the resources shortage and environmental pollution problems. Energy internet is a typical complex network in which power grid, gas grid and heat supply network are all coupled. Compared to the existing network, it is believed that information internet has the most similarities with the energy internet. In this paper, the research are attempting to build a reasonable and simple energy internet based on information internet. The construction of EI in different regions is discussed firstly. And then, inspired by the hierarchy of information internet structure, we also establish an EI hierarchy in 4 layers. Finally, in order to give a specific topology description, we focus on the transaction process in EI by using network science theory and give a detailed analysis of relevant parameters about the transaction in EI. By using the design idea of information internet, we focused on the problem that what EI will look like or should look like in the future.

articleTitle: Reduction method of outlet voltage of transformer with unbalanced three-phase load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to overcome the high volatility caused by single-phase voltage curve and improve the accuracy of judging whether the two substation areas belong to the same 10 kV line. The reduction method of outlet voltage of transformer with unbalanced three-phase load is proposed in this paper. Simulation models have also been built to calculate the outlet voltage of transformer. The results of simulation and reduction method have been compared. Results show that the results of reduction method are consistent with the simulation results. Although there exist differences between simulation and reduction method, but the differences are tolerable. It also can be concluded that the reduction method proposed in this paper has good adaptability.

articleTitle: Community detection in power grids based on Louvain heuristic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The statistical tools of complex network analysis and the development of complex network theory offer a new approach into the exploration of complex power grids. As the capacity of power grid increases, grid structure becomes more and more complicated and to some extent that will impair our perception of power grids. Hence in this paper we apply Louvain heuristic algorithm to detecting community structure of power grids. We find that IEEE 118-bus system is of significant strong community structure, with the modularity reaching 0.8. Besides, when we use reciprocal of reactance as the weight of edge, the modularity of the network is larger than that of homogenous weight of edge. This implies that reactance can help reveal the community structure. Community detection may shed light on our understanding on the configuration of the power grids.

articleTitle: Influence of N-1 contingency in natural gas system on power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing reliance on gas supply, the operating security of power systems is dependent on the natural gas system. Traditional contingency analysis of individual power system constraints is insufficient and may produce a large error. The aim of this paper is to study the impact of failures in natural gas system on the operating security of power system. In order to analyze it, the operating status of the power system and the anticipated contingency set of the natural gas system were proposed. Case studies demonstrated that the failure of natural gas system would adversely affect the operation security of power system. Therefore, coupled security analysis is of great significance.

articleTitle: A mixed logical dynamical model for optimal energy scheduling in microgrids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A typical microgrid consists of local power plants, renewable sources, energy storage systems, loads and communication units. It is designed to be operated autonomously or attached to a main utility grid, recognized as a promising application for energy system integration. This paper studies the optimal energy scheduling problem in microgrids which minimizes the total operational cost, subjecting to a number of operational and technical constraints. The proposed simulation framework is compacted to a mixed logical dynamical system which has advantages in terms of computational efficiency, compared with heuristic-based models. A case study of the optimal scheduling is performed on a centralized microgrid, and result shows the effectiveness of the proposed model in both grid-connected and islanded modes.

articleTitle: Smart bidding strategy of the demand-side loads based on the reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid reform of the electricity market in China, a more practical and smart bidding strategy is needed for the demand-side loads when they become the market participants. Based on the different regulation characteristics, a piecewise regulation cost model is established for continuous or discrete regulation demand loads. Meanwhile, considering the factors besides market demand and historical data, the paper proposes the intelligent bidding strategy based on an adaptive reinforcement learning model. The flowcharts for the process of bidding strategy was also proposed. Finally, the simulation results show that the bidding strategy is simple and easy to operate, which will further improve the decision-making ability of the demand side loads.

articleTitle: Data driven method for transient stability prediction of power systems considering incomplete measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a novel data pre-processing for data-based method of transient stability prediction considering incomplete measurements. Firstly, the statistical features are utilized as the input features, of which number is independent from the power system's scale. Secondly, the dataset is expanded considering the situations when some generator measurements are unavailable randomly. Next, a k-difference-neighbor method is used to reduce the number of instances. After that, a new dataset is generated as the training set to train a more robustness classifier. Case studies are conducted on the New England 10-machine 39-bus system and Northeast Power Coordinated Council 48-machine 140-bus system respectively to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Recursive clustering K-nearest neighbors algorithm and the application in the classification of power quality disturbances
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When identifying an unknown sample, k nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm requires calculating the distances between this sample and all samples in the training set. It cannot satisfy high real time situation, such power disturbance recognition. We propose a novel method to reduce the size of the training set for KNN algorithm. The proposed method is based on iterative clustering. Clustering the original training set, if the cluster only contains one class, the samples in this cluster is represented by the cluster's center; otherwise, we cluster again. Finally, the original training set is represented by the subset which consists of all cluster's centers. Experimental results show that the classifier become much simpler after sample reduction. For the problem of power disturbance, only 6.28 percent of the original training set requires to be reserved while the accuracy has no significant difference.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of PV power generation model parameter variation on power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper focuses on the influence of PV power plant model and parameters on the calculation of safety and stability of power system. Based on the actual situation of Xinjiang power system in 2016, this paper does research on the influence of PV model parameters on system frequency stability, power angle stability and voltage stability under the condition of PV access in high permeability was studied.

articleTitle: Research on flexible power multi-objective optimization plan method oriented to grid-connected intermittent energy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, clean energy power generation industry in China has been developing rapidly, but the absorption of clean energy and the economical and secure configuration of flexible power is a problem need to be solved. In this paper, according to the intermittent and fluctuation of clean energy, the security and economic operation of the power system, the planning of flexible adjustable power allocation is studied. The system upward and downward flexibility, the economical configuration of flexible and adjustable power and the network loss are put forward; the model based multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm (MOPSO) is established. The global optimal position is determined according to the particle crowding distance and the small probability escape mechanism is introduced to improve the searching ability of the algorithm. The actual example shows that the algorithm has a good convergence and variety of optimal solution, the multi-objective global optimization is satisfied successfully.

articleTitle: Energy systems and communication networks real-time simulation for controller hardware in the loop
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper we describe the controller Hardware In the Loop (HIL) capability of our laboratories. To allow for testing of multimodal systems highly interconnected through information technology both the energy aspects as well as the communication aspects are emulated or simulated in real-time. To allow testing of algorithms with various computational needs and input output requirements several prototyping platforms are considered. The use of the described capability is demonstrated through three examples.

articleTitle: A novel architecture of regional energy interconnected distribution grid based on power router technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional distribution networks have been faced with more and more challenges in recent years. To provide a system-level solution to achieve regional energy optimization scheduling, distribution generation connection, power quality improvement, custom power requirements and so on, this paper proposes a hierarchical system of regional energy interconnection distribution network based on power router technology for the newly incremental distribution network, which may be a transition formation between the traditional and future intelligent distribution networks. The proposed regional energy interconnection distribution network is divided into three different layer based on different functions. The first layer is centralized energy optimization layer to achieve original energy optimization scheduling. The second layer is distributed autonomous layer to connect different AC/DC voltage levels. The third layer is energy interface layer to provide multiple interfaces with plug and play functions. Based on the function and voltage level of different layers, structures of power routers used in different layers are also given.

articleTitle: Comprehensive assessment on development and application of solar technologies based on analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Solar energy is regarded as the most promising resource, and its application is critical to establish global energy interconnection. The paper sets up the AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) model for comprehensive assessment of solar energy technology, and assess the development and application of solar energy technologies, including concentrating solar thermal power(CSP), photovoltaic(PV) power generation, solar heating, solar cooling, solar fuels, etc. According to the comprehensive assessment results, the paper determines priorities, analyzes the advantages and drawbacks of various technologies, and proposes the countermeasures on the further developing of solar energy technologies.

articleTitle: Cointegration analysis between electricity consumption and economic growth in Fujian Province
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the new economic situation, more and more researchers began to pay attention to the electricity market. Government departments attach great importance to the growth of electricity consumption. This paper tries to investigate the relationship between electricity consumption and economic growth in Fujian Province China, using monthly data during January 2014 (2014m01) to May 2017 (2017m05). Investment, consumption and export data instead of only Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data is used to represent the economic growth, which indicates their individual effect on electricity consumption. Dickey-Fuller (DF) tests reveal that all the time series are non-stationary and individually integrated of order one. Long-run cointegration relationships between investment, consumption, export and electricity consumption individually are revealed by Engel-Granger (EG) tests. Furthermore, this paper shows that there exist unidirectional Granger causalities running from investment, consumption and export to electricity consumption based on Vector Auto-Regression (VAR) models, which are verified robust and can be used for policy analysis.

articleTitle: Integrated probabilistic energy flow analysis in natural gas and electricity coupled systems considering the randomness of wind power
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the probabilistic flow of integrated energy system (IES) composed of electrical power system and natural-gas system, considering the randomness of wind power. Firstly, the model of electric power systems (EPS) and natural-gas systems (NGS) is established, and the concept of pipeline admittance matrix and pipeline pressure drop is introduced in modeling the NGS. On this basis, The “Removing Compressor Technique” is proposed as innovation. The Newton-Raphson Method is presented to solve the steady state energy flow of the IES, considering the two inter-dependencies of the gas-fired generator and the moto-compressor. Finally, an integrated framework based on the Monte Carlo Simulation is presented to analyze the probabilistic energy flow problem, considering the randomness of wind power. Several case studies are utilized to show the operation status of the EPS and the NGS exert an influence each other and the proposed methodology is applicable in the IES.

articleTitle: Novel topology of combined AC-DC distribution network interconnected with renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid, the combined AC-DC distribution technology is attracting more and more attention. This paper presents a novel topology of combined AC-DC distribution network to solve the problem of the interconnection of the renewable energy and power distribution network. The combined AC-DC distribution network in this paper not only presents a novel mode of coupling and decoupling of renewable energy by using zig-zag transformer but also shows advantages in steady and transient state compared with traditional ac distribution mode. We simulated the novel topology by PSCAD. The simulation results prove the feasibility of the novel topology.

articleTitle: Availability of CHPs to provide primary frequency response in the great Britain power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reduction of total system inertia increases the system requirements for Primary Frequency Response (PFR). To mitigate this issue, future power system frequency stability requires response from not only the generation side, as has been the traditional method, but also from the consumer side through the use of flexible technology currently being developed. This paper investigates the availability of domestic combined heat and power (CHP) systems to provide primary frequency response in the poser system of Great Britain. This is achieved by setting a rate of change of frequency (ROCOF) as a trigger for CHP systems to provide PFR at different levels of response. The results show that domestic CHP could increase system frequency stability by providing additional PFR against frequency drops, with minimal adverse impact on the customers.

articleTitle: A missing data complement method based on K-means clustering analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a missing data complement method based on k-means clustering analysis by stretching and replacing energy load curve in proportion. The historical load data is classified in units of daily load vector considering the cycle similarity of energy load. The centroid vector of the corresponding clustering curve is stretched in proportion, and replacing the missing data. Simulation results show that the proposed missing load data complement method is more accurate compared to traditional linear interpolation method, and is able to improve the load prediction accuracy to a certain extent worked with support vector machine (SVM).

articleTitle: Framework and applications of WAMS light communication system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The dynamic response of distribution network is becoming more and more complicated, as the rapid development of renewable energy. Wide Area Measurement System light (WAMS Light) can monitor the distribution network synchronously. The communication of real-time and high-speed data has been put on the research agenda. Firstly, analyzes the existing communication network of distribution network, and proposes to use Long Term Evolution (LTE, 4G) for WAMS Light. Secondly, discusses the IEC 60870-5-101 and the IEEE C37.118.2 protocol, and puts forward suggestions for the WAMS Light protocol. Thirdly, studies the communication security, and suggests using DES and RSA algorithm based on Key Distribution Center (KDC) in WAMS Light. Finally, the main station has received the PMU Light data smoothly through a platform containing PMUs Light and simulated PMUs Light. This means 4G, WAMS Light communication protocol, DES and RSA based KDC can be used in the communication of WAMS Light.

Author Keywords: Synchronous phasor measurement unit light (PMU Light)

articleTitle: An integrated topology for battery charging and motor driving in electrical vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For a plug-in vehicle, the inverter and sensors used in driving circuit are not working during the battery charging. This paper proposed an integrated circuit to combine the inverter and charger. The three phase inverter can be used as a single phase rectifier in charging circuit. The circuit is reconfigured by a relay for the driving and charging operation. Space voltage vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) is used as a control strategy in driving mode. The simulation based on the topology prove that the circuit can drive the motor and charge the battery. This topology can improve the power density and reduce the circuit size.

articleTitle: Research on smart charging and discharging decision model of electric vehicle based on energy router
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an significant element of the energy internet, the energy router can provide the technical support for electric vehicle to participate in the direct energy transaction and power demand response. In this paper, the energy trading method of electric vehicle based on energy router is proposed, three discharging modes as V2G(Vehicle-to-grid), V2H(Vehicle-to-home) and V2V(Vehicle-to-vehicle) are considered and a multi-objective optimization model of electric vehicle charging and discharging decision is established, aiming at the optimization of user benefit and the minimization of peak and valley difference rate of the power system. The model is solved by using greedy random adaptive search algorithm. Finally, a highly modernized city with electric vehicles is introduced, and the smart charging and discharging decision model of electric vehicle based on energy router is analyzed. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: The effects of electric heating load on renewable energy generation utilization: Case study in North China
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric heating is getting the attention of China's central government, since it is an environmental-friendly alternative approach for scattered coal burning which is a chief reason for air pollution in China. From the perspective of power systems, the electric heating load can be utilized to solve the problem of renewable energy generation curtailment. This paper puts forward a novel unit commitment model considering the impacts of electric heating load as a kind of demand response resource. A case study is executed based on the situations in North Central area in China in 2030. Results show that the problem of wind generation curtailment and solar generation curtailment can be eased by virtue of electric heating load. Besides, the cost and emission per unit of electricity are also reduced.

articleTitle: Study on optimization of hybrid energy storage configuration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The randomness and volatility of the renewable energy bring instability to the operation of distribution network. A higher standard of planning and scheduling of the distribution network is called for along with the increasing load of the distribution network and the increasing spread of the peak and valley. In the distribution network, equipped with energy storage can reduce the impact of uncertainty, improve the flexibility of distribution network operation. The use of hybrid energy storage is more suitable for frequent occurrence of power load fluctuations in the distribution network. This paper focuses on the configuration of hybrid energy storage, and proposes a hybrid energy storage optimization method for calculating the parameter of power storage and energy storage in the distribution network. It can reduce the capacity of the transformers in the distribution network. At the same time, this paper also proposes a Wave shaping coefficient of the indicators used to optimize the cost of hybrid energy storage configuration and improve the economic benefit reasonably. The proposed allocation method is validated with numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: Power hardware-in-the-loop simulation of a distributed generation system connected to a weak grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The capability of distributed generation (DG) systems connected to weak grids has garnered increased interest in recent times. In this study, a comprehensive power hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) platform has been established, which is used to emulate a weak grid with an actual DG. In addition, a new interface algorithm that improves the stability of this PHIL platform is presented. Firstly, by establishing an impedance model of the PHIL platform with a DG, the system stability is analyzed. Secondly, to address the stability issues of the PHIL simulations, an interface algorithm (IA) is proposed and is set up on the real-time simulator. This algorithm is able to shape the combined impedance using an impedance model. Using the PHIL simulation, a more stable and accurate simulation performance is obtained. Finally, the proposed IA method is proved by the PHIL simulations.

articleTitle: Active islanding detection method for multi-inverter in power distribution system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation system gradually develops toward high density and multi-point access. However, the traditional islanding detection method, especially the active method, is not ideal for the detection of multi-inverter in distributed power generation system. In this paper, the Sandia frequency shift (SFS) is used to analyze the adverse effects of dilution and high load quality factor on the islanding detection. Then, it proposes an improved Sandia frequency shift method. The simulation model is established in MATLAB/Simulink environment. The results show that the detection method can achieve fast and precise islanding detection.

articleTitle: A detection method for response time of overall primary frequency regulation of power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a deep information mining is carried out for the frequency variation data curve during grid power shortage based on the grid frequency control mechanism. Considering the difference characteristics of system frequency response process with or without a governor provided for the grid, it is proposed to use the grid failure frequency data with a high sampling rate measured and recorded by phasor measurement unit (PMU) to calculate the maximum system frequency deviation and determine the actual action response time of overall primary frequency regulation (PFR) of grid by detecting the variation of the maximum frequency deviation. Both the simulation examples and the calculation results of actual grid data indicate that this method can provide relatively accurate references for evaluating the response time of overall primary frequency regulation of the grid.

articleTitle: Robust optimal protection strategy against false data injection attacks in power grids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of the optimal protection strategy with minimum protection cost against false data injection attacks, considering multiple power grid topologies. The model of robust optimal protection strategy, that can make power grids immune from false data injection attacks even if the grid topology changes, is first proposed. And then combining graph theory and recursive Bayesian estimation, we solve the model from the standpoint of pattern recognition. Finally, by testing on the IEEE 14-bus system, the correctness and effectiveness of our proposed robust optimal protection strategy model and its solving algorithm are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Multi-time simulation of electric taxicabs' charging demand based on residents' travel characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A model based on OD(Origin-destination) matrix was proposed to predict the temporal-spatial distributions of electric taxicabs' charging demands. Firstly, combined with the taxicabs' business operation characteristics, the desired routes of passenger travel were generated and trans-location of taxicabs was simulated based on this model, respectively. Then, the spatial-temporal distribution characteristics of taxicabs' charging demands and state conversions of SOC were analyzed by contrast of the difference of initial positions, Soc states, travel speeds at different traffic conditions and charging windows. Finally, based on the Monte Carlo method, the temporal-spatial distributions of electric taxicabs' charging demands were predicted. Moreover, the realization of this method was illustrated by taking a city where electric taxicabs have been popularized as an example, and the distributions of charging demands for regional electric taxicabs on the all day time axis were also calculated. The results can provide strong support for the large-scale electrification of taxicabs and the distribution network planning for their charging facilities.

articleTitle: Optimal strategy of combined operation of wind, solar and storage units
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, considering the new round of deregulation and reform of power industry and the rapid development of renewables in China, it is of great importance to study the optimal bidding strategy of combined operation of wind, solar units and energy storage systems participating in the electricity markets, thereby making the renewable generation companies more competitive and improving more renewable integrations. Therefore, the profit-maximization problem of joint wind, solar units and energy storage systems is established in this paper and various technical constraints of renewables units and storages are considered, to optimize the generation outputs and scheduling in the market-based environment. Then, numerical examples are implemented to validate the optimal scheduling problem of joint wind, solar units and energy storage systems and to analyze the advantages of optimal strategy of the combined operation mode.

articleTitle: A shunt capacitor detection method based on intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Focused on the problems that capacitor branches parameters cannot be calculated with unknown neutral point voltage, a shunt capacitor detection method based on intelligent substation is proposed in this paper. Using the information from intelligent substation, basic equation of shunt capacitor is firstly constructed in consideration of capacitor operating characteristics. Then, basic balance equation is solved with branch parameters rotated symmetry, and the largest change with initial capacitance group is figured out as a positive solution; Based on the calculation results shunt capacitor fault on-line monitoring method is accomplished not affected by the connection mode. Simulation results show that this method can alarm the fault phase capacitor correctly, not affected by the parameters initial deviation and external faults, and greatly improved the reliability of the shunt capacitors operation.

articleTitle: Dynamic reactive power optimization in weak sending-side systems: Method and case studies
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to transmit wind powers to the long-distance load centers in China, large-scale wind power centralized integrated into the weak sending-side systems becomes a major way to use wind energies, which causes a lot of voltage-related challenges. Dynamic reactive power (DRP) plays an important role in voltage problems due to the fast response in terms of the disturbances and contingencies. How to optimize the DRP devices to provide fast voltage support is crucial to the sending-side system. Therefore, this paper proposes a DRP optimization method for large-scale wind farms to compute the set value of all the DRP devices under normal conditions. The DRP computation can be completed by four steps exchanging information between the integrated stations and wind farms. The wind farms in Gansu Power Grid are used to test the proposed method, and the simulation results shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Energy cost reduction robust optimization for meeting scheduling in smart commercial buildings
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the electricity load of commercial buildings has been increasing rapidly, and the intelligent power consumption of commercial buildings has been an important area in demand response management (DRM). This paper investigates the problem of optimal meeting scheduling in commercial buildings. The optimization objective is to minimize the electricity payments of meeting rooms in commercial buildings with the meeting requirements satisfied. By considering the constraints such as consumption characteristics of meeting rooms and meeting time, the meeting scheduling problem in commercial buildings is modeled. Based on the deterministic electricity price forecasting, a deterministic MILP optimization model for meeting scheduling is established. Based on the probabilistic electricity price forecasting, a robust MILP optimization model for meeting scheduling is established with the incorporation of probabilistic electricity price. Simulation results of a numerical example verify the effectiveness of the proposed MILP model in solving the problem of meeting scheduling problem in commercial building.

articleTitle: A routing optimization model for EMS of power systems considering cyber-physical interdependence
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of smart grids makes the dependence of power systems on information systems increasing. However, the optimal routing of power communication networks does not mean the routing for power systems is optimal. Besides, power communication networks are different from ordinary, public communication networks, as the secondary system of power systems, the primary purpose is to ensure the reliability of power systems. Based on the cyber-physical sensitivity analysis, the importance of information flow can be evaluated. Then, a dynamic CPS optimal routing model distinguishing the importance of information flow is proposed to configure more reliable and shorter path to higher importance information flow. Case study on different scenarios of a modified IEEE 14-bus system demonstrates the validity of the proposed routing optimization model.

articleTitle: A two-stage robust optimization for coordinated planning of generation and energy storage systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study presents the coordinated planning of generation and energy storage systems to fill in the literature gap, and formulates the planning as a robust optimization that has proved its capability in handling uncertainty associated with the optimization model. The robust planning framework builds the planning task upon the security-constrained economic dispatch, and naturally adopts the min-max-min fashion that is then approached with the column and constraint generation decomposition method. Such a robust coordinated planning framework is demonstrated on an IEEE 30-bus network to justify its efficiency. The numeric study illustrates the advantage of the coordinated generation and storage planning in its comparison with the sole generation planning, while the robustness of the plan is evaluated through a post-planning simulation of different uncertainty scenarios.

articleTitle: Optimal operation of micro integrated energy systems considering electrical and heat load classification and scheduling
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an optimal operation framework for energy hub based micro Integrated Energy Systems (micro-IES) considering multi-carrier load classification and scheduling. The electrical load is classified as shiftable load and important load, as well as the heat load is made up of curtailment load and rigid load. The objective function aims to minimum the total operation cost related to electricity, natural gas and heat, while shiftable electrical load and curtailable heat load scheduling model are added into the constraints of optimization formulation. A detailed case study with the consideration of three different scenarios validates the performance of presented optimal operation model. The application of shiftable electrical load and curtailable heat load leads to lower multi-carrier energy consumption cost and lower peak power and heat load demand for micro-IES.

articleTitle: Sending end frequency and voltage under islanded operation mode of HVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Some large coal bases send power energy by high voltage direct current (HVDC) lines. Because the sending end systems of HVDC Transmissions are made up a few thermal power units, the sending end systems become island probably. It is necessary to research the frequency and voltage for these weak sending end islanding systems. In the paper, take Hu-Liao DC project as an example to carry out the researches. The first one is the change of the DC plan for the external-transmission, the second one is monopole emergency switch off sequence (ESOF) occurring in DC project, and the third one is three-phase short circuit fault occurring in the sending end. The results showed the frequency and voltage meet HVDC transmission. The control strategy can provide a reference for the power dispatching and production department.

articleTitle: Day-ahead microgrid energy management optimization scheduling scheme
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A day-ahead microgrid energy management optimization scheduling scheme is proposed in this paper. The object is to optimize the output power of DERs (distributed energy resources, DERs). The objective function includes operating cost and maintaining cost of lithium battery and fuel cell, the interruptible compensation of interruptible loads and electricity price. In day-ahead scheduling stage, a battery operating cost function is derived. The lifetime loss of lithium battery at different DOD (depth of discharge, DOD) is calculated as specific operating cost. Electricity price at different periods is considered. Operating cost of PV in two working modes is considered too. They are MPPT mode and controllable mode. In controllable mode, the output power of PV is controllable. According to day-ahead prediction of PV output power and load, the total operating cost is set as objective function. In case study, LINGO 11.0 is used to calculate the model whose data comes from the real lab-scale microgrid. The experimental result shows that the proposed scheduling strategy in this paper is reasonable.

articleTitle: Low carbon economic dispatching for power system integrated with large scale photovoltaic power generation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Developing low carbon electricity is a powerful measure to deal with global climate problems, which is also the internal motive force to promote the sustainable development of economy and society. As a clean energy, photovoltaic power generation has developed rapidly in recent years, which has a great impact on the energy saving and emission reduction of power system. In this paper, an economic dispatch model considering CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission is proposed, so that the carbon emission has become schedulable resource owned economic value. As the photovoltaic power generation has the characteristics of randomness and volatility, the spinning reserve compensation cost is introduced to the objective function in order to deal with the prediction deviation of photovoltaic power generation. On this basis, a low carbon scheduling model integrated with photovoltaic power generation is proposed. The model has been able to make the system operate economically and will effectively reduce carbon emission. Test results demonstrate the reasonableness and validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Architecture design of power system fault calculation based on cloud computing technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents an architecture of power system fault calculation based on cloud computing technology to solve the problems of the current fault calculation system, which is caused by the insufficient calculation ability. The existing fault calculation system can not meet the requirements of the calculating efficiency and accuracy with the expansion of power system. The concept, characteristics, advantages, structure of cloud computing and service oriented architecture (SOA), as well as the architecture of the proposed system are described in detail in this paper. Besides, the cloud computing technology and SOA are applied to the fault calculation system, reaching the elastic scaling of the calculation and storage, reliable disaster recovery of the system, and a higher interoperability. To validate the design, the proposed system is applied to an actual power system, and the operation effect has proved its feasibility and superiority.

articleTitle: Coordinated recovery strategy of AC and UHVDC interconnected system considering the power grid strength
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large transient power impact of UHVDC commutation failure has great influence on the security and stability of the power grid, becoming one of the most important threats to the safe operation of large scale AC and DC interconnected system, especially when the HVDC system is connected to the weak AC power grid, commutation failure can even cause system instability, leading to new energy tripping, system crash and other serious risks. A coordinated recovery strategy of AC and UHVDC interconnected system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the coupling characteristics of AC and HVDC system is analyzed, and then the impact of different disturbance on the power system recovery characteristics is taking into consideration. Secondly, an AC and HVDC system coordinated recovery strategy is proposed considering the AC power grid strength, by modifying the parameters of CFPREV and VDCOL to control the recovery speed of HVDC system after commutation failure, which can realize fast recovery of the interconnected system and reduce the impact of HVDC commutation failure on the whole system. At last, the effectiveness of this strategy is verified by the simulation of an actual large scale AC and UHVDC interconnected power grid.

articleTitle: Optimal bidding strategy for demand side considering customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Customer-side demand response is of great significance for better balancing the demands and supplements in energy markets. In this paper, we propose a new model approach of customer-side demand response in block bidding markets. Based on the model, a new strategy for combining shiftable load segments is proposed in order to get a long duration load segment for the purpose of reducing electricity purchasing price. The optimization problem of load segments combination is considered as a special box filling problem with deformable rectangle, which constrains that each rectangle is horizontally continuous and longitudinally movable. To solve this problem, the non-dominated sorting based multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (NGSA-II) with nonlinear constraints is used. We also model the degree of customer satisfaction as a standard for evaluating the combination solution of our strategy and analyzing the commercial behaviors of power-retailing companies from the perspective of economic sociology. The strategy is applied to an actual case. Simulation results show that the combination of load blocks can greatly reduce the price of electricity purchase and verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: An information security risk assessment algorithm based on risk propagation in energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional information Security Risk Assessment algorithms are mainly used for evaluating small scale of information system, not suitable for massive information systems in Energy Internet. To solve the problem, this paper proposes an Information Security Risk Algorithm based on Dynamic Risk Propagation (ISRADRP). ISRADRP firstly divides information systems in the Energy Internet into different partitions according to their logical network location. Then, ISRADRP computes each partition's risk value without considering threat propagation effect via RM algorithm. Furthermore, ISRADRP calculates inside and outside propagation risk value for each partition according to Dependency Structure Matrix. Finally, the security bottleneck of systems will be identified and the overall risk value of information system will be obtained.

articleTitle: A dual-module method for energy-internet-oriented distributed energy system planning
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper provides a kind of energy-internet (EI) oriented distributed energy systems (DES) planning method which is based on the simulation-evaluation and intelligent optimization dual-module planning model to realize optimized configuration of DES. Among them, the simulation evaluation module adopts two-layer bus-structure analysis method. The external bus structure is used to determine the energy flow and equipment power balance equations. The internal bus structure considers detailed network topology and parameters, as well as the special characteristics of electricity and heat network with independent simulation modeling. Through the thermoelectric decoupling iteration method, the dimension and the complexity of the system simulation will be effectively reduced. While the intelligent optimization module constructs a DES optimization problem and solves it through genetic algorithm. This paper improves the extension flexibility of the system optimal planning model with expected accuracy.

articleTitle: Hellenic transnational interconnection: Integrated scenario-based social-economic analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Global energy interconnection can be as modest as the electricity exchange and clean energy sharing among European countries, or as ambitious as the full integration of the power systems and markets across the continents worldwide. In Greece, several cross-border interconnections have already been commissioned, which are significantly contributed to the national security of supply and electricity market. In this paper, the Integrated Scenario-based Social-Economic Analysis (ISSEA) methodology is presented for social-economic analysis of the ongoing transnational interconnectors of Greece. Several technical and economic parameters are considered under the various specific scenarios developed for each project to evaluate the direct and indirect impact from both benefit and cost aspects. Analysis results show that the transnational interconnectors deliver significant benefits and contribute the economic development of related countries and regions.

articleTitle: Data validation and anomaly detection techniques for smart substations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Smart substation data quality has been a big concern for utilities since large scale Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) deployments. Data quality directly impacts the validity of the applications based on such data. This paper proposes a system including a model-less pre-screening step, a model-based SLSE step, and data-driven statistical method to detect anomalies. The pre-screening step serves as pre-filtering process validating the raw PMU data and setting the data quality flag. The modelbased SLSE uses the quality flags to determine which data to use. The SLSE makes use of the three-phase voltage and current phasors to do three-phase current LSE and three-phase zero-impedance voltage LSE. The SLSE estimates values for the measurements and performs error analysis to be sure they are good values. The statistical analysis includes 5 main processes. The implementation of these steps is explored in this paper. The proposed solution has been validated with simulated substation data. The work addresses data quality issues and hence benefits downstream synchrophasor applications, such as oscillation detection, voltage stability, and system control.

articleTitle: System dynamics modeling and simulation for global energy-economy-politics system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Global energy interconnection is the future platform for global energy allocation. An accurate description of macroscopic properties conduces to provide decision-making basis for the construction and planning of interconnection. Affected by a variety of factors, the energy problem is also an economy problem and a politics problem. Therefore, the relationships among energy system, economy system and politics system can be used to describe the macroscopic properties of global energy interconnection. Grasp and extract key factors in the systems to characterize system features. Through qualitative analysis, the causal relationships among key factors are determined. The quantitative analysis further indicates that most relationships are non-linear. A dynamic analysis model based on system dynamics is established. The model is multi-variable and non-linear. Based on the dynamic analysis model, the morphological evolution of systems is given over time to describe macroscopic properties of interconnection. The validity and rationality of the model are proved by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: A multi-objective evaluation method for distributed integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-objective mathematical model concerning the optimization of ecology, economy and environment benefits in a distributed integrated energy system (IES) is proposed. Compared with the traditional evaluation methods, e.g. Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), this method is based on the Pareto Front (PF) of the multi-objective optimization model, in which the multi-objective potential variant is defined to evaluate the potential of the system making the evaluation more convincing and indisputable. Moreover, to avoid the phenomenon that we generally tend to overweight the significance of energy's quantity and ignoring the quality, we utilize the Exergy Efficiency (EE) to amend the evaluation based on theories in thermodynamics. During operation simulation, a Multi-Objective Particle Swarm Optimization (MOPSO) algorithm is applied to the distributed IES. By this method, the PF of the multi-objective model can be easily found.

articleTitle: An emergency control strategy for DC grid with station fault blocking
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An emergency control strategy is proposed to solve the problem caused by station fault blocking in DC grid. The aim of this strategy is to make full use of the ability of regulating unbalanced power in DC grid of non-fault converter stations with different control modes. Firstly, the value of unbalanced power in DC grid is determined. Secondly, the adjustable power of nonfault converter stations in voltage control, voltage margin control and power control are calculated respectively. Thirdly, the method of adjusting the reference power of non-fault converter station in power control mode is put forward. Finally, a simulation model based on Zhangbei ±500 kV DC grid demonstration project in China is built in PSCAD/EMTDC for validating the effectiveness of the proposed emergency control strategy. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can not only reduce the impact on ac system but also improve the safe and stable operation of DC grid.

articleTitle: Icing thickness prediction of overhead transmission lines base on combined kernel function SVM
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Light icing of overhead transmission lines would cause huge hazards such as conductor galloping and line over load, while heavy ice would cause serious faults such as disconnection and tower falling down, resulting in paralysis of the grid. With the prediction of the icing thickness on transmission lines which can preclude the contingency caused by icing. This paper studies two types of kernel function (KF), the radial basis function (RBF) KF and polynomial (Poly) KF. The two kinds of KFs are applied to the support vector machine (SVM) to predict the icing thickness and then the results were compared. Based on the characteristics of RBF KF and Poly KF, a combined KF of weighting sum RBF KF and Poly KF is proposed. From the experimental results, the prediction performance of combined KF SVM is superior to single KF SVMs.

articleTitle: The analysis of distance protection operation characteristics of power system based on VSC-HVDC interconnection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the VSC-HVDC system has attractive advantages of high stability and controllability, it becomes a key development direction of the HVDC. Dynamic operation and controllability features of VSC-HVDC system differ a lot from that of conventional AC and DC transmission. During the grid fault, the VSC-HVDC export various short circuit current to AC system which can be a threat to the correct operation of distance protection. Based on the control principle of VSC-HVDC converter station, the voltage and phase features of the VSC-HVDC short-circuit current is analyzed. The measured impedance variation of the VSC-HVDC distance protection in AC side is also analyzed. The influence and interrelated factors of VSC-HVDC to distance protection are proposed. Digital simulation on PSCAD/EMTDC is done to verify the validity of the analysis.

articleTitle: Study on coupled planning of power grid and gas network considering P2G device
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the concept of energy internet is proposed, heating network, power grid and gas network will couple with each other tightly so that a closed energy network will be built. Additionally, as the gas demand increases and consumption of redundant electricity becomes more and more urgent, the P2G(Power to Gas) unit has been proposed as a way to store electric energy in the form of gas. In this paper, the collaborative planning of the integrated energy system considering CCHP(Combined Cooling Heating and Power) and P2G units is studied. Accordingly, an integrated energy system including CCHP and P2G units is established, also, a power planning is performed for the integrated energy system through the enumeration method and the genetic algorithm. Finally, economic benefits are evaluated and the influence of the capacity of thermal network on the operation economy of the hybrid system is studied with the numerical examples.

articleTitle: A novel urban rail transit system based on DC distribution and energy internet architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a novel energy internet architecture of urban rail transit is treated based on DC distribution. Renewable sources, cool/heat sources, electrical vehicles, braking energy feedback are added to the system. Flexible electricity trading strategies are included because of storage devices. It builds a DC distribution at the voltage level of 550 V to achieve efficient power transmission referring to the proportion of different loads in actual rail transit system. The efficiency and loss of the traditional AC system and DC system are calculated and compared. It shows that new design decreases the losses of conversion and cables and releases a large number of converters and rectifiers, which can promote energy conservation and environmental protection. The cost of cables and conversions also has a drop. The proposed architecture is supported by analysis, calculation and simulation.

articleTitle: Construction of smart distribution grid efficiency evaluation index system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Efficiency evaluation index system should be proposed because which is important for more efficient operation of smart distribution grid. The status of distribution network and the challenges of smart distribution grid are analyzed in this paper. The construction ideas of efficiency evaluation index system are proposed. On this basis, the criteria layer, the performance layer and the application layer of efficiency evaluation index system are proposed based on system analysis theory combination with AHP method. Theoretical basis for construction evaluation index are elaborated in this paper.

articleTitle: Nash bargain and complementarity approach based efficient/economic dispatch in combined cooling heating and power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to deal with the efficient/economic dispatch (EED) problem in combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) system. By equivalent transformation, the Nash's bargain criterion is utilized to determine a negotiation solution on the Pareto front. The proposed approach is utilized to the EED of a practical park-level CCHP. Case studies demonstrate its validity.

Author Keywords: Combined cooling heating and power system

articleTitle: Research on PV array output characteristics based on shadow image recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The randomly varying power output of PV generation has been a big problem in the operation of grid connected PV stations. Shadow is one of the main cause of output power variation, but it is often costly to detect the arbitrary shaped PV shadow by a large number of sensing elements with high accuracy. In this paper, the output characteristics of PV array is obtained by combining shadow image recognition and output curve simulation. Based on the analysis of partial shadow influence on the PV module's output, a fast PV array simulation method specific to every PV cell is proposed. Considering the features of PV array images, a shadow recognition algorithm is designed, which contains technologies of grid lines smoothing and local threshold segmentation. Simulation results on actually measured PV array images indicate that the proposed algorithm is feasible in PV shadow recognition, and the output characteristic of PV array under partial shadow can be acquired quickly and accurately by the new simplified simulation technology. This research achievement has the potential of lowering the requirement of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) and improving the forecast accuracy of PV generation.

articleTitle: A novel multi-microgrids system reliability assessment algorithm using parallel computing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the condition of multi-microgrids system, due to the location dispersion of microgrids, and the different characteristics of distributed generations and loads, the size of sampling in a reliability assessment algorithm is always huge, which influences computational efficiency. In this paper, based on the operation characteristics of a multi-microgrid system, a reliability evaluation algorithm based on the parallel computing algorithm of the multi-microgrid system is proposed. The algorithm can sample the operating state of each microgrid at the same time and consider the interaction between the various microgrids in a multi-microgrids system. The algorithm can significantly improve the calculation speed of the reliability assessment algorithm of the multi-microgrid system, which is of great significance to the reliability evaluation of the multi-microgrid system in the region.

articleTitle: Business model status of distributed power supply and its concerns in future development
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid development of distributed generation is an remarkable feature of smart grid. Business model can provide fair profits for participants, so it plays an important role in distributed generation development. This paper gives a brief view of the state of art of worldwide distributed generation developments, such as America, Europe Union and China. It should be noticed that China has a fast increase of installed capacity of distributed generation under the driving force of government. Nowadays, there are two main business models of distributed generation which are selling of power generation systems and accessories and power transaction service of distributed generation. For the business model of power transaction service of distributed generation, three subtypes are addressed. They are all power outputs to grid Model, and self generation for self using and residual power to grid Model. The self generation for self using and residual power to grid model is divided into rental service model, power purchase agreement model and space renting model. These three models are carefully analyzed and their advantages and suitable scenarios are suggested. With the support of technologies and the stimulation of polices in China, the novel business model of distributed generation will appear continually. With consideration of the advance of electric transform, the occurrence of technologies of Energy Internet and the current utility marketing tactics, three main concerns are given for discussion.

articleTitle: The design of multi-interface protocol adaptive conversion distribution network communication device based on wireless communication technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the distribution network access network lacks uniform standard, which makes the communication protocols of manufacturers are not compatible with each other, and dues to the different services and scenarios need to adapt to different communication devices and systems. These reasons lead to extremely difficult to manage and maintain the distribution network communication system, which seriously hampered the process of comprehensive information of the power distribution. In this paper, a wireless communication device for distribution network with adaptive multi interface protocol is designed in allusion to the problem of existing technology. This device has a variety of interfaces and protocol adaptive conversion function, which can adapt to the power distribution terminal with a variety of interface types and communication protocols, and it provides a strong support for constructing the unified access specification for the distribution communication network of the multi scene and service.

articleTitle: Modeling the temporal correlation of ultra-short term wind power forecast error based on copula theory
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing wind power penetration, the randomness and uncertainty of wind power forecast errors effect the operation of power system deeply. Therefore, a high-dimensional model of ultra-short wind power forecast errors and probability distributions of different time periods forecast error is proposed based on copula theory. Firstly, the parametric methods and nonparametric methods are introduced and used to fit the probability distribution of wind power forecast error. By comparing fitting accuracy of different fitting methods, KDE-based method with highest fitting accuracy is chose to fit marginal distribution of forecast error. Then, this paper models the temporal correlation of ultra-short term wind power forecast using copula function and obtains joint cumulative distribution function (JCDF) of forecast errors. Finally, the actual forecast error data of a wind farm located on Hebei province is used to verify the model. Comparing with the actual dependence structure, the method based on copula theory can effectively model the temporal correlation and detect zero dependence of ultra-short term wind power forecast errors. Thus the effectiveness of proposed method is proved by simulated results.

Author Keywords: ultra-short term wind power forecast error

articleTitle: Research on optimal operation method of pumping station based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional optimal operation method of pumping station had many shortcomings, such as strong dependence on the experience of engineers, high design and maintenance costs, and complicated operation. Based on the principle of machine learning, a set of optimal operation method of pumping station was established. According to this method, the pump characteristic curve data from SCADA were selected, and k-medoids algorithm was used to filter data noise. Then the BP neural network was used to train pump characteristic curve. Finally, the genetic algorithm was used to solve the minimum power consumption of unit water in pumping station. Experiments have proved that the method could automatically and effectively filter noise, and establish a higher precision model, and get the optimal solution. This method have realized the automatic operation of pumping station under weak manual intervention, and it had good versatility. After further research, it could be popularized and applied in engineering.

articleTitle: Study of relay protection modeling and simulation on the basis of DIgSILENT
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DIgSILENT PowerFactory, a simulation software application, is exclusively devised for electric power system and control analysis. Equipped with various electric component models, it has brought great convenience for the research and study of power system with distributed generation. This paper introduces the modeling principle, general framework, and various functional blocks in the simulation of relay protection based on DIgSILENT. By illustrating overcurrent and distance protection, this paper presents the process of the application of DIgSILENT to relay protection simulation and proves the effectiveness and progressiveness of the software in this field.

articleTitle: Research on the fault characteristics of HVDC with wind farm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: HVDC system are widely used in wind farm power transmission system. There are several HVDC project build in the world which are considered as a better transmission way for the bulk electric power. And the fault characteristics are more important factors which will affect the safety of converters of HVDC, the wind generator and the stability of the power system. This paper focus on the research of fault characteristic in HVDC System with wind farm based on the MATLAB/Simulink model, including LCC-HVDC and VSC-HVDC models. And a small experiment system of LCC-HVDC system with DFIG wind generation were building up, some basic experiments had been made on this experiment system.

articleTitle: Regional energy planning — An example of Suzhou Industrial Park
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy system planning is essential for the sustainable and low-carbon development of the society. Now the energy system planning in China is lacking in the coordination between power supply, thermal supply and gas supply, and is in less consideration of efficient and clean demand side management. This study reviews the current regional energy planning methodologies and the application progress. Then take Suzhou Industrial Park as an example in the paper, by selectively using the EnergyPLAN model and setting reasonable scenarios, so as to explore a more comprehensive and applicable objective analysis methodology.

articleTitle: A distributed power routing method between regional markets based on Bellman-Ford algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deregulation of power industry, large power users can buy electricity directly from power producers. For trades between different regional markets, it is necessary to research on the method to find the cheapest route for power exchanging. Moreover, as there exists no coordinator above regional markets, the power routing problem must be solved in a distributed way. Most previous research are based on power electronic transformers. Some research proposed EMS of subnetworks as energy routers, but failed to consider the power flow constraints or did not converge in some specific cases. Our method is based on the EMS of multiple markets, which saves cost by eliminating expensive electronic transformers and has high efficiency in systems with numerous nodes by considering the regional markets as generalized nodes. We take transmission costs and congestion costs into consideration, and uses Bellman-Ford algorithm to determine the cheapest route for power transmission between different regional markets and make convergence analysis about our algorithm. This method proves effective and convergent when there is no loop among the markets. A four-market loop-free case was used to illustrate the efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Investigation on anti-interference of Rogowski coil current transformers in smart substations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Rogowski coil current transformer is typically influenced by the high-frequency transient current generated during switching operations or short-circuit fault. This paper investigated the mass change process in a Rogowski coil transformer (differential, filtering, sampling, and integration) and analyzed the mechanism of the abnormal waveform generated in the transformer. Results showed that appropriate configuration of a low-pass filter placed before the collector reduced the amplitude of the high frequency component in the signal, resulting in attenuated amplitude of frequency components after aliasing. The filter also inhibited abnormal waveforms by increasing the sampling frequency of the sampler. Simulation results showed that the use of a fourth-order Bessel filter to suppress high frequency signals and increase sampling rate to 100kHz is feasible and effective. The approach proposed in this study is shown to improve the operational reliability of Rogowski coil transformers.

articleTitle: A simulation test device and simulation test method for control system of new energy remote tripping operation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of new energy distributed power generation technology, power system encountered a variety of problems, the development of micro-grid control technology requirements are getting higher and higher. On the one hand, scholars from all countries are actively studying more advanced control technology. On the other hand, when the existing control system can not stabilize the local micro-grid, you need a safe and stable control system that can trip on the new energy side in time. With the safety and stability control function of the new energy remote trip engineering system, which is characterized by a large number of devices, each station between the higher communication requirements, so to the engineering system simulation test has brought a lot of difficulties. Therefore, this paper presents a simulation test device for a new energy remote trip control system. At the same time, the RTDS simulation scheme of the system is proposed, which can be used for reference in the future development of new energy system.

articleTitle: Aggregation model of air conditioning load considering temperature sensor accuracy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The proportion of air conditioning load in power grid is increasing year by year, the cycle operating characteristics can be used to adjust the power demand, which can provide reserve capacity for power system. In order to describe the active power aggregated characteristics of air conditioning loads accurately, an accurate model should be established. On the basis of single air conditioning load model, the aggregation model for air conditioning loads is established by using Monte Carlo simulation method and according to the distribution characteristics of various parameters. The influence of the accuracy of temperature sensor parameters on the aggregated power characteristics of air conditioning load is analyzed. Simulation results show that the air conditioning load aggregation model considering the accuracy of temperature sensor is feasible and practical, providing the basis for the system load balancing control with the air conditioning loads.

articleTitle: Control strategy of excitation converter in Doubly-Fed Induction Generator wind power generation system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of power level in wind power generation system, the Doubly-Fed Induction Generator(DFIG) Wind Power Generation System has been applied more and more extensively because it's unique advantages. Excitation converter which is comprised of grid-side converter (GSC) and rotor-side converter (RSC) is a conjunction part between the DFIG rotor and the grid. This paper firstly introduces the function of the grid-side converter, and derives the control strategy based on the mathematical model of GSC. Then, two RSC power control strategies are derived based on the mathematical model of DFIG. Finally, simulation has been done to verify the excitation converter control strategy which is proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Optimization of continental power exchange under the framework of global energy interconnection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The global energy interconnection is a promising way to achieve sustainable use of global energy. A quantitative estimate of inter-continental power exchange can provide helpful guidance for implement of the global energy interconnection. This paper proposes a method based on time sequence simulation technology to optimize continental power exchange under the framework of global energy interconnection. An optimization model is proposed to maximize the global renewable energy power generation with considering the constraints of global power balance, global system spinning reserve, continental transmission capacity limit, unit power generation limit, limits of renewable energy curtailment rate, et al. To cope with the extremely large and complicated global power network, the aggregation method is applied to simplify the global power grid interconnection. The aggregated continental annual wind, solar power and load are incorporated into the optimization model as inputs. Hourly power generation of renewable, fossil, nuclear energy and continental exchanged power are then optimized. Case studies are conducted to obtain the optimal continental power exchange based on the data in 2016, and the influence of inputs on continental exchange power are quantified. Testing results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Real time fault monitoring and diagnosis method for power grid monitoring and its application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
