abstract: In Energy Internet mode, a large number of alarm information is generated when equipment exception and multiple faults in large power grid, which seriously affects the information collection, fault analysis and delays the accident treatment for the monitors. To this point, this paper proposed a method for power grid monitoring to monitor and diagnose fault in real time, constructed the equipment fault logical model based on five section alarm information, built the standard fault information set, realized fault information optimization, fault equipment location, fault type diagnosis, false-report message and missing-report message analysis using matching algorithm. The validity and practicality of the proposed method by an actual case was verified, which can shorten the time of obtaining and analyzing fault information, accelerate the progress of accident treatment, ensure the safe and stable operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Economic dispatch of power system including electric vehicle and wind farm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the measured data, the uncertainty of electric vehicle charging is considered. The time distribution of the charging load of the electric vehicle is obtained by the charging start time and the duration. The objective function aims at getting the lowest cost of coal consumption and the cost of valve point. The penalty function method is used to introduce the partial constraints into the objective function, and the optimal scheduling model with the electric vehicle and wind farm is established. Finally, the cuckoo search algorithm is used to solve the model, and the correctness of the model and algorithm is verified. The results show that the spontaneous charging of electric vehicle increases the peak-valley difference of the load, and wind farms can reduce costs.

articleTitle: A transient thermodynamic model of district heating network for operational optimization of the energy integration system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A transient thermodynamic model of the district heating network considering the topological structure of returning water network, the transient process of temperature variation and the time delay characteristics is proposed in this paper. The method of piecewise linearization adopted in this model not only considers the transient temperature variation for better model accuracy, but also reduces the complexity for solution through simplifying constraints of partial differential equations in the operational optimization model. The results of case study show that compared with the commonly used Time-delay model, the proposed model can lead to nonnegligible differences in the optimal solution of the operational optimization model.

articleTitle: Decentralized two-stage control for active power real time dispatch in islanded AC microgrids
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Microgrid is a typical small-scale cyber-physical system in which computing, communication, and control technologies are tightly integrated. A two-stage control framework is introduced for active power real time dispatch in islanded ac microgrids. Then a decentralized hybrid method consisting of two control schemes is developed. In the method, an adaptive droop scheme using local physical information is employed in the first stage to provide rapid control for frequency regulation. Based on the peer-to-peer communication in the cyber system, a consensus scheme is implemented in the second stage to realize frequency restoration and economic dispatch simultaneously. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on DFIG voltage control strategy considering small-disturbance voltage stability of microgrid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Small-disturbance voltage stability is of great significance for microgrid. To improve the small-disturbance voltage stability of microgrid including doubly fed induction generator (DFIG), DFIG reactive power control uses Q/V droop control and the integral logic loop. The reactive power limit corresponding to the DFIG active power in the case of variable wind speed is calculated, so that the integral logic loop and the Q/V droop control are limited. This paper finds the typical eigenvalues reflecting the voltage response characteristic of the microgrid via the small-signal analysis method. The influence on the locus of typical eigenvalues with DFIG different reactive power droop coefficient is analyzed. Through the parameter improvement, the adjustable range of DFIG reactive power droop coefficient is enlarged and the small-disturbance voltage stability of microgrid gets better. Finally, this paper establishes the microgrid model using the software DIgSILENT/PowerFactory. Simulation results verify validity and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on local consumption of distributed generation in distribution network with coordinated development of facility agriculture
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the widespread of distributed generation in the facility agriculture, the promotion of local consumption of distributed power is a problem to be studied. The background and the application of the distributed generation with the coordinated development of facility agriculture are introduced. The models of the loads and the photovoltaic system are established in a greenhouse. The load control strategies are proposed with the objective of maximizing the local consumption of the photovoltaic system. The software DIgSILENT PowerFactory is used for the simulation of the photovoltaic system and the loads while considering the loss of power in lines. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can make good use of the controllable load in the greenhouse and the electric power generated by the distributed generation can be effectively consumed.

articleTitle: Research on virtual inertial control technology for improving transient stability of DC distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the limited capacitance of the DC distribution network itself and the lack of spontaneous power support, the inertia of the DC system is usually low and the transient stability problem is more severe. In order to improve the transient stability of the distribution network, by coupling the rotational speed of the rotating motor and DC voltage, can simulate the DC capacitor charge and discharge process, and release the hidden kinetic energy potential hidden in the motor to provide power support for the DC system and improve the inertia of the system. By introducing the DC voltage change into the current control link of the synchronous generator as the correction current reference and the DC voltage as the improved control coefficient of the wind speed coefficient of the wind turbine, two virtual capacitive inertial control strategies are proposed to make the rotating motor fast response system voltage change. The time domain simulation is carried out in Matlab/Simulink, and the results show that the proposed control strategy can improve the system voltage response effectively under the voltage mutation condition.

articleTitle: A reliable distribution network structure with the use of electric energy router
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the widespread use of distributed energy and DC load (typical DC load: Data Center), more and more scholars research on the electric energy router, this paper presents a power distribution network with the application of electric energy router. Aiming at the distribution network with typical DC load data center, this paper is devoted to study the structure of the electric energy router used in power distribution network, analyze the advantages of the network structure and the cluster type of electric energy router; Compared with traditional AC distribution network, the reliability requirements of electric energy router are analyzed; The results verify that energy internet needs further study, the key role of electric energy router in energy internet and the reliability requirements of electric energy router. The research results have huge significance for the research of electric energy router and the development of energy internet.

articleTitle: Phase change materials(PCM) based multi-stage thermal energy storage(TES) and its application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Future energy systems face significant challenges in resolving global energy trilemma of clean supply, affordability and security. This calls for high penetration of renewables and electrification of heat and transportation. This paper concerns thermal energy storage (TES), which is expected to play an important role in addressing the energy trilemma. It summarizes our recent work on this area, covering TES materials, modules and applications. Our work on TES materials has been on composite materials, including materials formulation and properties characterization and fabrication. Our work on TES devices is covered the material formulation, exchanger developing and TES system building. The experimental study indicates that the thermal recovery efficiency is from 87∼91% for each TES exchanger. A multistage system with graded use of the thermal energy can enhance the thermal recovery efficiency up to 92%.

articleTitle: Research on photovoltaic power system of microgrid based on real-time simulation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Microgrid is becoming more and more important in energy using area, which has better consumption capacity of renewable energy and obtains better economic benefits. Solar energy makes the maximum proportion of energy on the earth and the photovoltaic system is an important part of the microgrid. Therefore, making full use of solar energy means much for the microgrid. The maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller in the Photovoltaic system is the key of solar energy using. Nowadays, digital simulation and real-time simulation can be taken use of carrying out photovoltaic power system research. However, accuracy of digital simulation is not convincing, so real-time simulation is applied to research on Photovoltaic system, which has the characteristic of accuracy together with rapidity. In this paper, theory of Photovoltaic system is analyzed including characteristics of photovoltaic cell and MPPT strategy. A real-time simulation platform RT-LAB is introduced in details, which concludes hardware, software and the simulation process of RT-LAB. Molding and testing of photovoltaic system on RT-LAB is carried out to researching on the efficiency of real-time simulation about solar energy using. The testing results show that the usage of RT-LAB can provide more veritable simulation results, and the MPPT strategy is reliable.
